title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
As an Assistant Project Manager (APM), you’ll work closely with Senior Project Managers and Project Managers to support the successful delivery of commercial HVAC and mechanical construction projects. This is an entry-level opportunity to build your project management career while gaining hands-on experience across all phases of construction.


You’ll work closely with project managers, project foremen, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and our coordination team to support project planning, scheduling, documentation, materials, change orders, and closeout. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experienced project professionals while developing the technical and business skills needed to grow in construction project management.

At Cannistraro, we exist to empower the life-changing impact of mastering a trade. Whether you’re working in the field, coordinating a project, or supporting project management, every role contributes to the craftsmanship, collaboration, and customer care that define our work.


What You'll Do

  • Support Senior Project Managers and Project Managers with the day-to-day management of commercial HVAC and mechanical construction projects.
  • Assist with preparing monthly job cost projections, project schedules, and manpower schedules.
  • Solicit bids from vendors and subcontractors and prepare information for review.
  • Assist with monthly job cost and cash flow projections.
  • Prepare change order estimates and purchase orders for review.
  • Maintain organized and accurate project files and documentation.
  • Prepare CECs for processing in CMiC.
  • Provide backup support for project invoice approvals.
  • Coordinate and release material and equipment deliveries.
  • Prepare and process submittals through CMiC.
  • Review and process bulletins and updated drawings.
  • Review and submit RFIs and coordinate drawing updates.
  • Attend project meetings with the Project Manager and assist with follow-up items and meeting minutes.
  • Work collaboratively with the Coordination team to develop and maintain project coordination schedules.
  • Attend coordination meetings with the Lead Coordinator as needed.
  • Support design-assist activities when applicable.
  • Collaborate with project co-ops to support timely completion of project closeout and O&M packages.
  • Ensure Foremen have the most current project information, including drawings, specifications, RFIs, bulletins, submittals, and schedules.
  • Support the review and management of project punch lists, working with Foremen and subcontractors to address outstanding items.
  • Obtain as-built drawing markups from field Foremen and work with the Coordination team to develop final as-built drawings for project closeout.
  • Maintain strong communication between the project management team and the field to help keep projects moving safely, efficiently, and on schedule.



What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Previous internship, co-op, or construction experience is preferred but not required.
  • Interest in building a career in commercial HVAC and mechanical construction.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Ability to learn quickly, manage shifting priorities, and stay organized in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in HVAC systems, mechanical construction, and the construction industry.
  • Familiarity with Massachusetts building codes and industry standards, including ASHRAE, NFPA, and ASME, as they relate to HVAC, is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, Navisworks, or CMiC is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with field teams, clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal project partners.



Why Cannistraro?

We invest in our people through training, coaching, and opportunities to grow. As an Assistant Project Manager, you’ll work alongside experienced professionals and gain exposure to the many different aspects of commercial mechanical construction while building the foundation for a long-term career in project management.

description:

## Data Rights and Classification Project Manager

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems

Poway

California

Job Summary

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

We have an exciting opportunity within our Engineering Services organization for a Project Manager IV – Data Rights and Classification. This position will report to the Senior Engineering Manager of Systems Engineering Process, Tools, and Data Rights, and will lead both the Data Rights document review team as well as the Software License Review and International Trade Compliance (ITC) engineering classification team.  The Data Rights document review team reviews technical documents and drawings to determine the appropriate Data Rights markings and assertions in order to protect GA-ASI and Subcontractor intellectual property as well as to ensure compliance with applicable FAR and DFARS regulations.  The Software License Review and International Trade Compliance (ITC) engineering classification team is responsible for reviewing all third-party software (TPS) requests for license obligations in order to facilitate more informed licensing decisions as well as for determining ITAR and EAR classifications for engineering drawings as part of the drawing release and configuration management process. Regarding the ITC responsibility, this role will work to reduce the existing classification backlog while establishing a sustainable and efficient process for future classification work. The successful candidate will bring deep Data Rights and International Trade Compliance (ITC) experience within aerospace and defense and partner closely with the existing ITC organization, Engineering, Configuration Management, Information Technology Services (ITS), Data Management, Contracts, and other business stakeholders. A key objective will be to establish and formalize scalable, risk-based data rights and classification processes that maintain regulatory compliance while improving cycle time and Engineering execution. This includes simplifying and standardizing current processes, increasing reuse of existing classification determinations, integrating classification into the engineering product lifecycle, and leveraging Teamcenter/PLM data, OCR EASE, automation, and Artificial Intelligence where appropriate.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Lead the Data Rights document review team responsible for data rights determinations and assertions in accordance with FARS/DFARS regulations
- Lead the Software License Review and International Trade Compliance (ITC) engineering classification team responsible for software license obligations review as well as ITAR/EAR classification of engineering drawings.
- Establish priorities, workload management, and performance metrics to reduce the existing backlog and maintain sustainable processing times.
- Provide subject matter expertise in FARS/DFARS data rights regulations as well as ITAR/EAR classification, including USML categories, ECCNs, and EAR99 determinations.
- Coordinate with Contracts, Data Management, Program Management, and other stakeholders to resolve data rights concerns and to improve the data rights process as needed.
- Partner with the International Trade Compliance organization to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements, company policies, and broader trade compliance objectives.
- Lead evaluation and redesign of the drawing classification process to simplify workflows, reduce manual activity, improve consistency, and establish an appropriate risk-based approach.
- Develop standardized classification methodologies, decision criteria, reference materials, and reusable classification libraries to reduce repetitive analysis.
- Integrate classification activities into Engineering development, Configuration Management, and drawing release processes.
- Collaborate with PLM, ITS, and Engineering stakeholders to evaluate opportunities to incorporate classification data and metadata within Teamcenter and other enterprise systems.
- Assess and optimize existing tools, including the Data Rights Database (DRD) and OCR EASE, and identify opportunities for workflow automation, Artificial Intelligence, intelligent search, and data analytics.
- Develop metrics to measure backlog reduction, cycle time, throughput, quality, rework, and reuse, and lead continuous improvement efforts.
- Develop and coach personnel and provide technical guidance as required.
- Maintain the strict confidentiality of sensitive and export-controlled information.
- Other duties as assigned or required.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

- Typically requires a Bachelors in Business Administration or related discipline and thirteen or more years of progressively complex experience in the project administration field with at least seven of those years in project management. May substitute equivalent experience in lieu of education.
- Must demonstrate an extensive understanding of project management processes and procedures, planning and scheduling methods, and budget management as well as the ability to organize, schedule, and coordinate workloads to meet established milestones and budgets.
- Must possess:
  - the ability to initiate, plan and manage projects.
  - the ability to identify issues, analyze and interpret data and develop solutions to a variety of non-routine issues of diverse scope and nature.
  - strong analytical, communication, documentation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  - the ability to work independently and lead in a team environment.
- Must be able to travel as required.
- Ability to obtain and maintain DoD Security Clearance is required.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, C++ (Simulations)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, C++ (SIMULATIONS)

As a Software Engineer on the Simulations team, you will design, develop, and test our in-house simulation software supporting all SpaceX flight systems. You will program the core simulation infrastructure and collaborate on the building of models of fluids, electronics, and multi-body physics systems. This is a high impact role where you will work across the engineering groups to build high fidelity simulations used to develop cutting-edge software and hardware. Our simulation software is critical to current and future mission successes including Falcon, Falcon Heavy, Dragon, Starlink, and Starship. SpaceX is looking for smart, motivated software engineers who enjoy taking on complex challenges, work well in dynamic environments and care about software best practices.

Help us build world class software that is critical to SpaceX mission to Mars.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and maintain the high-fidelity real-time simulation software used for all vehicles

title: Mission Operations Systems Engineer, Optical Inter-Satellite Link
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

As a Mission Operations Engineer on the Optical Inter-Satellite Link (OISL) team, you will own and execute the overall operational success of these payload and bus functions at a systems level and coordinate between engineering teams across ground, network, and space systems to achieve it. Because of the scale of the mission, you will be focused on driving automation and operational excellence — identifying areas of improvement and initiating changes to improve the productivity of the fleet and optical network.

You will coordinate and prepare for each launch and on-orbit demonstrations, design and conduct operational rehearsals, and drive automation efforts with scalability in mind, ensuring that the constellation functions at peak performance with little-to-no manual intervention. You will develop concepts for OISL network operation for missions and experiments, participate in launch and early operations, develop and perform analysis on system data, and identify areas and mechanisms for further improvement.

The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, have strong verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, be able to juggle multiple tasks at once, be able to work independently, and maintain professionalism under pressure. You should have knowledge in space system design, optical systems, and software engineering practices.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
* Design, conduct, and participate in operational rehearsals
* Coordinate and participate in all launch, early operation, and other critical activities
* Develop concepts for OISL network operation for missions and experiments
* Develop and perform analysis on system data, and identify areas and mechanisms for further improvement
* Drive automation efforts with scalability in mind, ensuring that satellite and constellation function operate at peak performance with little-to-no manual intervention
* Develop and execute integration vehicle test plans
* Work closely with software, hardware and systems engineers

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist

Greater Boston Area

Company Description

Newton Research is a fast-growing software start-up founded by repeat entrepreneurs and well-funded by blue chip venture capital firms. We are building the next generation of the closed loop media lifecycle, developing AI agents that leverage the latest in LLMs and generative AI with specialized knowledge. Our products generate actionable business insights for our customers and partners, assisting in each step of the media planning, buying and measurement lifecycle.

Role Description

This is a full-time Data Scientist role with Newton Research, Inc., working from our offices in Needham, MA. You will develop production-level models and algorithms, analyze data, design experiments, and interpret results. More importantly, you will work with engineering to encode those abilities into software and train Newton to think like a data scientist. The data science team is small, so your work reaches customers quickly and your judgment shapes the product. We value self-motivated individuals who collaborate well across teams and can present and defend findings to stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Build production-level models and algorithms for media planning, audience, measurement and yield problems
  • Design and interpret experiments, including deciding what a result does and does not support
  • Work with engineering to encode your judgment into Newton's agents
  • Contribute to the evals and benchmarks that tell us whether an agent's analysis is correct, not just plausible

Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
  • Strong foundation in data analysis, statistical modeling, causal inference, and machine learning concepts
  • Ability to evaluate a model, a causal experiment, or an AI-generated analysis and identify what it measures, where it fails, and how to verify it
  • Proficiency in Python, including data science libraries like pandas and scikit-learn
  • Strong SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience writing code that ships to production, or with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift, is a plus

Base Salary Range: $135,000-$165,000 + Equity

title: Senior Technical Animator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Animator based in Netherlands.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in developing advanced animation technology for ambitious AAA/AA+ game projects.
You will help shape character pipelines and runtime animation systems in Unreal Engine, with a strong focus on Animation Blueprints and Control Rig.
The role combines hands-on technical animation, character rigging, scripting, optimization, and creative problem-solving.
You will collaborate closely with animators, artists, engineers, and technical leadership to translate creative requirements into robust technical solutions.
You will also research new techniques, improve workflows, and help establish best practices across the animation pipeline.
As a senior contributor, you will provide guidance and mentorship to other technical animators while contributing to project planning and delivery.
The position is fully remote and offers the flexibility to work with an international game development team from anywhere in Europe.

Accountabilities

  • Contribute to the technical vision for character animation pipelines and runtime animation systems within Unreal Engine.
  • Design, implement, and maintain complex animation systems, with particular emphasis on Animation Blueprints, State Machines, and Control Rig.
  • Integrate new characters by creating and implementing Physics and Cloth assets and optimizing Level of Detail (LOD) settings.
  • Research, prototype, and introduce new technical animation techniques that improve animation quality, production workflows, and team efficiency.
  • Create and maintain high-quality character and weapon rigs in Maya using internal rigging tools and established technical standards.
  • Skin high-density characters while ensuring high-quality and efficient deformation.
  • Modify and adapt Python-based rig definitions to accommodate unique character requirements while maintaining consistency across the codebase.
  • Work closely with engineers and other technical specialists to resolve complex technical challenges and ensure animation systems remain performant and stable.
  • Partner with the Technical Animation Lead and Director to translate artistic and gameplay requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance, feedback, coaching, and mentorship to junior and mid-level technical animators.
  • Document technical animation workflows, standards, and best practices to promote consistency and quality across projects.
  • Track progress, contribute to task evaluation and scheduling, and communicate upcoming priorities effectively.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in technical animation within the games industry, including experience operating at a senior level.
    • Proven experience shipping at least one AA+ game title in a technical animation role.
    • Expert-level knowledge of Unreal Engine, particularly Animation Blueprints, State Machines, and Control Rig.
    • Strong understanding of dynamic asset systems, especially Physics and Cloth assets.
    • Demonstrated expertise in Maya character rigging and skinning, particularly for realistic characters and high-density assets.
    • Strong proficiency in Python tools programming and the ability to modify and maintain Python-based rigging systems.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with artists, animators, engineers, and technical leadership.
    • Strong problem-solving abilities and an interest in researching new technical approaches and improving animation workflows.
    • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a distributed, multidisciplinary team.
    • C++ proficiency is desirable.
    • Experience with procedural animation techniques is an advantage.
    • Passion for and knowledge of the Action-RPG or Soulslike genre is desirable.
    • A gameplay portfolio demonstrating relevant technical animation and rigging work is expected; creature-related work is particularly welcome.
    • Applicants must have the right to work in the country where they reside.

      • Benefits:

      • 5-month freelance contract with an immediate start.
      • Fully remote work arrangement.
      • Flexible working schedule with core collaboration hours from 10 AM to 4 PM CET.
      • Opportunity to work on ambitious, high-profile game projects with cutting-edge animation technology.
      • Collaboration with talented international artists, animators, engineers, and game development professionals.
      • Opportunity to contribute to advanced Unreal Engine animation systems and modern technical animation workflows.
      • International and diverse remote working environment.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to welcoming people regardless of background, identity, age, disability, or social status.
      • Opportunity to work from the Netherlands while collaborating with a distributed European team.
      • Freelance compensation structured around a daily rate in EUR, with the rate determined based on experience and engagement terms.

title: Electrical Assembler II - Skilled Assembler - Day Shift
description:
The Electrical Assembler II is designed for individuals who have mastered foundational assembly skills and are ready for more advanced electrical work. This position independently performs conduit installation, component wiring, cable preparation, and electrical assembly tasks while interpreting engineering drawings and meeting production requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

· Demonstrates proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and drawings.

· Demonstrates proficiency in accurately measuring, cutting, bending, and installing 1/2-inch and 3/4-inch EMT conduit for enclosure assemblies, maintaining proper spacing, alignment, and workmanship standards.

· Demonstrates proficiency in crimping compression lugs and ferrules in accordance with company quality and workmanship standards.

· Assists with pulling and routing wires for electrical devices through wireways and other designated pathways.

· Demonstrates proficiency in the installation of cable and wire protection materials around sharp edges, corners, and other potential abrasion points, and understands when and where such protection is required.

· Successfully assembles and wires control boxes according to electrical schematics, drawings, and company standards.

· Strips, terminates, and properly labels wires within control panels in accordance with Hennig standards, assembly procedures, and quality requirements.

· Demonstrates working knowledge of the operation and application of two-way, three-way, and four-way electrical switching circuits.

· Demonstrates proficiency in fabricating and terminating DLO cable and 500 MCM wire assemblies.

· Operate power/hand tools, measuring devices, and instruments used for assembly.

· Accurately use measuring and leveling tools, including tape measures and levels, for conduit and component installation.

· Demonstrate safe operation and proper use of scissor lifts, boom lifts, and ladders.

· Follow all safety procedures, quality standards, and work instructions during assembly and installation activities.

title: Account Receivable Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Account Receivable Specialist is responsible for ensuring accuracy and efficiency of operations In Billing, Accounts receivable and Collections. The roles and responsibilities related to accounts receivable (AR) encompass various tasks aimed at managing and collecting payments owed to the company for goods or services provided.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Process accounts and incoming payments in compliance with financial policies and procedures.
  • Perform day-to-day financial transactions, including verifying, classifying, computing, posting, and recording accounts receivable data.
  • Prepare bills, invoices, and bank deposits.
  • Reconcile daily and month-end accounts receivable balances with the general ledger to ensure all payments are accurately recorded and properly posted. Investigate outstanding invoices, make collection calls, negotiate payment terms, and process lines for collections, when necessary, under direction.
  • Enter and maintain data in accounts receivable general ledger accounts.
  • Verify discrepancies and resolve clients' billing issues.
  • Facilitate invoice payments by sending reminders and contacting clients.
  • Conduct credit reviews on orders placed on hold.
  • Perform credit evaluations to determine eligibility for credit limit increases and adjustments to payment terms.
  • Review new customer accounts to assess creditworthiness and assign appropriate credit limits and net terms.
  • Generate financial statements and reports detailing accounts receivable status.
  • Deliver weekly and monthly reports such as:

o Monthly Aging Analysis – Accounts Receivable (AR) & Rebates

o Weekly Overdue Tracking – AR & Rebates

o Weekly Collections Report – AR & Rebates

o Weekly Collections Forecast – AR & Rebates

o Timely Invoicing Report – AR

o Invoices Issued per Week Report

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field
  • Equivalent experience of 1–3 years in Accounts Receivable or Billing may be considered

Work Experience (Required/Preferred):

  • Experience in Billing, Collections, and Rebates
  • Accounts Receivable processing and reconciliation
  • Customer service and client communication

Years of Experience:

  • 1–3 years of relevant experience

Communication Skills:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

MS Office Proficiency:

  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel

Other Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of proven experience as an Accounts Receivable, Billing, or Collections Staff
  • Solid understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting principles
  • Ability to calculate, post, and manage accounting figures and financial records
  • Hands-on experience using spreadsheets and accounting or proprietary software
  • Ability to record, track, and analyze financial data using accounting systems and spreadsheets
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills to identify discrepancies, analyze financial data, and resolve issues efficiently
  • High degree of accuracy and strong attention to detail

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll take responsibility for the day-to-day leadership and development of the support team while helping ensure technical issues, escalations and major incidents are handled effectively.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Leading, coaching and mentoring your direct reports and the wider support team
  • Running regular 1-on-1s, setting expectations and supporting individual development plans
  • Managing performance, productivity, output and service quality
  • Supporting the onboarding and development of new engineers
  • Managing team rostering, scheduling, leave and resource requirements
  • Driving employee engagement, recognition and retention
  • Handling and supporting complex technical escalations
  • Acting as an escalation point for engineers across multiple customer environments
  • Owning major incident management from initial response through to resolution
  • Coordinating technical resources, customer communication and internal stakeholders during incidents
  • Ensuring incidents and requests are resolved within agreed SLAs
  • Running post-incident reviews and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Using Service Desk metrics and reporting to improve team performance
  • Driving greater proactivity across monitoring, tooling, documentation and support processes
  • Identifying recurring technical issues and helping eliminate root causes
  • Maintaining accurate information within the ITSM platform
  • Working alongside senior engineers, service delivery and technical leadership
  • Assisting with customer service delivery and presales activities when required
What You’ll Bring

This role needs someone who understands that great technical leadership is about more than being the smartest engineer in the room.
You’ll need the technical credibility to support your team, but just as importantly, you’ll enjoy coaching people, solving problems, improving processes and creating a high-performing support environment.

Ideally, you’ll bring:
  • 2+ years' experience leading or mentoring an IT support team, ideally within a Team Leader capacity
  • Recent experience within an MSP, MSSP or Systems Integrator environment
  • Strong hands-on technical troubleshooting skills
  • Experience managing technical escalations and major incidents
  • A good understanding of ITIL principles and service management
  • Experience using Service Desk metrics to manage performance, output and quality
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM / ticketing platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience conducting 1-on-1s, coaching engineers and managing performance
  • A genuine interest in developing technical people
  • A proactive mindset towards service improvement and automation
  • The ability to remain calm and organised when things get busy
Technology Environment

You don’t need to be an expert in every technology, but you’ll need a strong technical foundation across modern MSP environments.
You’ll work with technologies including:
  • Microsoft 365
  • Azure
  • Entra ID
  • Intune / Autopilot
  • Windows Server
  • VMware and virtualisation
  • Networking
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery
  • Modern Workplace
  • ITSM and monitoring platforms
  • Microsoft security technologies
  • Scripting and automation
  • SharePoint and Teams
  • Cloud and infrastructure environments
⭐ What's In It For You?

Step into genuine technical leadership – Lead and develop engineers while remaining connected to the technology and customers.

$90K-$110K Base + Super + Bonus – A strong package with additional incentives and investment in your development.

Training and certifications – Continue developing technically and professionally with structured training and certification support.

Build a high-performing team – Coach engineers, improve performance, develop future senior engineers and help create an environment where people genuinely want to work.

Make an impact – This isn't simply about keeping the lights on. You'll have the opportunity to improve processes, tools, monitoring, documentation and the overall way the support function operates.

Modern technology exposure – Continue building your knowledge across Microsoft Cloud, Modern Workplace, infrastructure, networking, automation and security.

Career progression – Develop towards broader opportunities across Service Delivery, Technical Operations, Service Management, Technical Leadership and senior operational roles.

Supportive, people-first culture – Join an environment that genuinely invests in its people, encourages development and recognises great work.

Hybrid working – Enjoy flexibility while still being part of a collaborative Melbourne-based technical team.

If you love technology but have discovered that you get just as much satisfaction from helping other engineers become better at what they do, this could be a cracking opportunity.

This is your chance to lead from the front, develop a talented team and have a genuine influence on how an MSP delivers great service!

Referral Bonus! Know someone who would be perfect? Refer them and receive $2,000 if they’re successfully placed!

title: Tech Business Developer III, Decarbonization Strategy & Standards, WW Sustainability
description:
The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon's scale, speed, and ability to build, invent, and simplify a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

The Decarbonization Strategy team is seeking a Tech Business Developer III to identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships that advance Amazon's decarbonization objectives. In this role, you will own the management complex, cross-functional business development opportunities — from evaluating and managing partner relationships to tracking and reporting on their business impact.

You will define and execute BD strategy with limited oversight, working across Amazon's Sustainability Science & Technology, Finance, and Public Policy teams to drive outcomes with cross-organizational impact.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development instincts with fluency in decarbonization frameworks and the external landscape of standards, policy, and market mechanisms. They will bring experience managing complex stakeholder ecosystems and translating evolving external developments into actionable strategies that inform internal roadmaps and business priorities.

A key dimension of this role involves engaging with external standard-setting bodies and industry coalitions shaping GHG accounting methodologies and supply chain emissions frameworks.




Key job responsibilities
• Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships and complex cross-functional deals that advance Amazon's decarbonization strategy; own the full partner lifecycle from sourcing through ongoing relationship management.
• Develop and execute business development strategy that complements broader program and product goals; gather and synthesize partner feedback to inform priorities and direction.
• Engage with external standard-setting bodies, industry coalitions, and technical working groups relevant to GHG accounting, supply chain emissions, and related decarbonization frameworks to bring Amazon’s expertise to these forums.
• Build and maintain relationships with a diverse external ecosystem including standard setters, academics, civil society organizations, and industry leaders.

• Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader for both internal and external audiences; communicate complex topics clearly across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership.
• Partner with internal product and service teams to surface market and partner insights that inform future development priorities.

title: Full Stack Application Developer
description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Full Stack Application Developer to join our rapidly growing and innovative cybersecurity team! The Full Stack Application Developer will support our agile software development practice, supporting an environmentally focused Federal Government client. The agency's programs aim to promote environmental sustainability and protect the natural resources of our planet. As part of this contract, we will be supporting the agency's efforts to develop and maintain information systems that facilitate the tracking and reporting of environmental data. Our team will work closely with the agency to ensure that the information systems are secure, compliant with accessibility standards, and support the agency's business processes.

The Full Stack Application Developer will be a member of a software development team and ensure the successful delivery of software applications. The successful candidate will have strong communication skills, be able to work closely with business analysts, scrum masters and other stakeholders, and have a passion for delivering high-quality software products.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Experience

  • Experience: Minimum of 7 years as a Full Stack Software Developer.
  • Cloud Technology: Experience with cloud services, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS), to manage scalable and secure applications.
  • Front-end Technologies: Proven experience in developing and maintaining web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks such as React or Angular.
  • Programming Languages: Strong knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js
  • Database Management: Strong experience with databases, particularly PostgreSQL, focusing on database design, optimization, and management.
  • Event Driven Architecture: Experience with implementing an event-driven architecture; Specific experience using RabbitMQ is highly desirable.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent abilities to effectively communicate and collaborate with team members and stakeholders.
  • Software Development Methodologies: Solid understanding and practical experience with Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Passion for Quality: A strong commitment to developing high-quality software products.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred but not required.

Responsibilities

  • Participate with the software development team in all phases of the Agile software development life cycle (SDLC), including planning, design, development, testing, and deployment
  • Work closely with business analysts, project managers, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and ensure the successful delivery of software applications
  • Ensure that projects are completed on time and within budget
  • Ensure that software development methodologies and best practices are followed and that code is maintainable, scalable, and testable
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of technical documentation, including design documents, user manuals, and release notes
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and trends in software development and provide recommendations for new tools and techniques that can improve the development process
  • Have an understanding of UX and UI design principles

Methodologies and Tools:

  • Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Project management tools (Jira, Trello)
  • Collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams or Slack
  • Version control systems (Git, Bitbucket)
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) tools (Jenkins, CircleCI)
  • Software development languages and frameworks (Node.js, Typescript, React)
  • Web development languages and frameworks (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
  • Database management systems and languages (PostgreSQL)
  • JavaScript Object Notation (JSON)

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions is a security-focused IT solutions provider with public clients nationwide. Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. As a company, we are just as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class IT solutions, all while enjoying an unparalleled work-life balance. We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. We hire people we respect – and we trust them to deliver results leveraging their expertise. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment as part of a stellar team of professionals, then we invite you to apply online today.

Benefits Snapshot (includes, but not limited to)Valiant pays 99% of the Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage for Full-time EmployeesValiant contributes 25% towards Health Coverage for Family and Dependents100% Paid Short Term Disability and Life Insurance Policy for Full-time Employees100% Paid Certifications401K Matching up to 4%Paid Time OffPaid Federal HolidaysWellness & Fitness ProgramValiant University – Online Education and Training PortalFSA programs for: Medical Costs, Dependent Care, Transit, and ParkingReferral Bonuses

The salary range for this position is a general guideline and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. It has been benchmarked in relation to the scope of the role, market rate, and internal equity. The salary for this role is expected to be in the $125,000- $135,000 range. Where a candidate falls within the band can be determined based on one or more of the following: skillset, experience level, achievements, education, geographic location, security clearance, involvement in corporate tasks, and other non-discriminatory factors. In addition to the base salary, this role will include benefits as described above. Valiant reserves the right to adjust the salary range, experience requirements, and position responsibilities at any time without prior notice.

Remote Work Policy

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that align with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status, in accordance with applicable law.

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods of time and consistent operation of a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as, personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

title: [쿠팡] CX Program Manager (경력 5년 이상)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

CCX Planning 팀은 CX 성과 지표를 관리하고, 조직 목표를 달성하는데 전념합니다. 데이터 기반으로 현재 상황을 분석하고 인사이트를 도출하며, 목표를 달성하기 위한 종합적인 계획을 수립합니다. 주요 이해 관계자와 긴밀히 협력하여 전략적인 솔루션을 제안하고 효과적인 실행을 지원합니다. 또한, 조직의 문화 활동을 지원하여 최고의 조직으로 성장하는데 기여합니다.

업무 내용

  • CCX performance metrics 수립, 관리, 분석을 통한 insight & action item 도출
    • 고객 여정(Customer Journey) 분석 및 데이터 기반 Pain Point 발굴
    • CX 개선 프로젝트를 end-to-end로 기획, 실행 및 성과 관리
    • 비즈니스 우선순위를 기반으로 CX 로드맵 수립 및 실행 관리
  • 주요 이해 관계자로부터 비즈니스 우선순위를 명확히 이해하고 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 관련 데이터를 분석을 통해 효과적인 솔루션 제안 및 이행
  • Ad-hoc 프로젝트성 업무에 참여하여 개발, 데이터, 프로그램, 운영팀 등 여러 부서와의 협업을 통해 프로젝트 추진하여 최고의 고객 경험 창출에 기여

자격 요건

  • PM / 프로젝트 관리 경력 5년 이상 있으신 분
  • 디테일에 민감하며 심층 분석에 대한 의지가 있으신 분
  • 분석적이며 구조적인 사고의 보유자로서 여러 데이터에 대한 이해도가 높고 인사이트를 도출하실 수 있는 분
  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경/업무를 즐기고 멀티태스킹이 가능하신 분

  • 다양한 이해관계자 관리 능력 있으신 분
  • 소비자 지향적 사고방식 지니신 분

우대 사항

  • 재무 / 컨설팅쪽 유관 경력이 있으신 분
  • 프로젝트 기획 / 운영 경험이 있으신 분
  • 비즈니스 영어가 가능하신 분
  • CS 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

You will own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for a suite of analytics capabilities, including dashboards, charts, benchmarking, and predictive LTV.

You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to turn complex data into actionable customer insights.
You will also investigate data issues, develop meaningful metrics and benchmarks, and identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
The position offers significant autonomy, with responsibility for making product decisions, experimenting rapidly, and delivering measurable business impact.

title: Drone Assembly Operator
description:
Fotokite develops autonomous, high-endurance tethered unmanned aerial systems to help firefighters and public safety teams save lives.


Fotokite systems allow first responders to quickly and easily gain situational awareness after arriving at emergency scenes: our autonomous one-touch launch/land system makes operation simple and safe; the dual color and thermal camera payload provides situational awareness from the system’s aerial perspective; and actively tethered flight means the system can be flown without a certified pilot, and can be left flying for as long as the situation requires.


The Drone Assembly Operator will work with a team of engineers and other technicians to build the organization’s newest products. This position performs hands-on assembly of electro-mechanical sub-systems and provides input to the engineering team to assist them with developing and refining the manufacturing process of these products for low-volume, in-house production and eventual hand-off to the commercial production line.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assemble complex electro-mechanical sub-systems, including testing, troubleshooting, and repair.
  • Build products following work instructions and drawings with precision and consistency.
  • Troubleshoots issues and communicates them to other technicians and/or the engineering team
  • Provides feedback and observations related to the assembly process in the form of red-lined drawings and written communication
  • Maintains an organized workflow and workstation
  • Receives and inspects components
  • Conducts indoor assembly tests according to established procedures
  • Monitors and reports on all aspects that relate to the quality of components and assemblies
  • Tracks component inventory as it relates to build schedules
  • Performs other duties as assigned


EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent and 2+ years of related experience are required
  • Ability to assemble complex electro-mechanical systems using engineering assembly drawings
  • Demonstrated keen eye for detail, a technical aptitude, and a desire to learn
  • Experience handling ESD-sensitive components, as well as working in an ESD-safe environment following ESD-safety best practices preferred
  • Proven record of proactively working to meet production timelines
  • Working experience with common spreadsheet and word processing tools, such as G-Suite and/or MS Office
  • Experience working for an international company is a plus
  • Fluency in English and German is required, any other language is a plus

title: Director of Rehabilitation
description:
Overview

Why Join Reliant Rehabilitation?

Joining Reliant means becoming part of a team that makes a real difference in the lives of patients and residents across a variety of care communities. As one of the nation’s largest contract therapy providers, Reliant offers unmatched clinical support, professional development, and growth opportunities.

Our leadership team began their careers as therapists, and we take pride in promoting from within. You’ll be supported by a dedicated clinical team that provides ongoing training, proven protocols, and hands-on guidance — ensuring therapy is delivered effectively for patients and in full compliance to support our partners.

With operations in 44 states and more than 900 communities nationwide, Reliant can match your location, schedule, and career goals, wherever your path leads.

What We Offer:

• Competitive compensation packages

• Medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance

• 401(k) with employer match

• PTO Share and Buy-Back Programs

• Maternity and Paternity support program

• Continuing education, mentorship programs and clinical leadership development

• Tuition loan repayment assistance Program

• Flexible scheduling options

Responsibilities

Position Summary:

The Director of Rehabilitation (DOR) is responsible for leading and managing the rehabilitation department to ensure resident care needs are met while aligning with the company’s financial goals and regulatory requirements. Through effective leadership and strategic oversight of staff, clients, and referral sources, the DOR drives excellence in patient care, employee engagement, customer service, and financial performance. This role upholds professional standards and fosters positive relationships with facility staff and clients, representing Reliant Rehabilitation’s commitment to quality and service.

Key Responsibilities:

• Assign patient scheduling and delegate departmental responsibilities to staff as needed

• Supervise, train, evaluate, and support team members to enhance performance and maintain high standards of care, in collaboration with the Regional Director of Operations and Human Resources

• Participate in the recruitment and interview process for departmental staff

• Ensure compliance with Reliant Rehabilitation and facility-specific policies and procedures

• Oversee documentation practices to ensure accuracy, clarity, compliance with payer requirements, and a comprehensive reflection of patient status and outcomes

• Promote collaboration and effective communication across departments to support team cohesion and operational efficiency

• Maintain open communication with facility administration regarding departmental goals, initiatives, risks, and achievements

• Represent Reliant Rehabilitation’s therapy services to the public and medical community

• Participate in interdisciplinary meetings including utilization review, quality assurance, resident care conferences, admissions, department head meetings, and community education planning

• Monitor and manage departmental revenue and expenses to meet budgetary targets

• Establish and implement departmental goals and strategies to drive success

• Ensure timely and accurate completion of MDS reporting and billing documentation

• Foster professional growth through collaboration, self-study, and continuing education

• Maintain a valid state license (as applicable) and stay informed on industry trends and regulatory changes

• Provide or oversee therapy services as needed, including resident screenings, evaluations, treatments, and documentation in accordance with state and federal guidelines

• Maintaining confidentiality as appropriate and ensuring compliance with the state practice act in the state(s) where you are licensed.

Qualifications

Qualifications/Licenses:

• Must hold a degree in Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, or Speech-Language Pathology from an accredited institution; OR For Rehab Technicians: a high school diploma, GED, or equivalent is required

• (2) years of experience as a Physical Therapist, Physical Therapist Assistant, Occupational Therapist, Occupational Therapy Assistant, Speech-Language Pathologist, or Rehab Tech.

• Must possess a current and active license in one of the following disciplines, if serving as a therapist: Physical Therapist, Physical Therapist Assistant, Occupational Therapist, Occupational Therapy Assistant, or Speech-Language Pathologist

Please note rate range is an estimate and may vary based on skill set and location(s).

title: Systems Engineer – Missile Seeker
description:
DESE Research, Inc. is seeking a motivated and experienced Systems Engineer (SE) to work closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers to ensure the successful design and manufacturing of a missile seeker to meet the performance, reliability, and safety requirements of the seeker system. A successful candidate will be responsible for development and adherence of the requirements and the interfaces of a complex software system with the rest of the missile seeker.

The successful candidate will:

  • Apply an interdisciplinary, collaborative approach to plan, design, develop and verify complex lifecycle balanced system of systems and system solutions.
  • Evaluate customer/operational needs to define and coordinate system performance requirements, integrate technical parameters and assure compatibility of all physical, functional and program interfaces.
  • Perform various analyses to optimize total system of systems and/or system architecture.
  • Perform analyses for affordability, safety, reliability, maintainability, testability, human systems integration, survivability, vulnerability, susceptibility, system security, regulatory, certification, product assurance and other specialties quality factors into a preferred configuration to ensure mission success.
  • Develop, maintain, and identify improvements for the planning, organization, implementation and monitoring of requirements management processes, tools, risk, issues, opportunity management and technology readiness assessment processes.
  • Resolve cross-functional technical issues.

Position Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with system requirements and specifications of the design and development of the software for the missile seeker.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including electrical, mechanical, and software engineers, to integrate the software into the overall missile seeker system.
  • Define and document the software's architecture, interfaces, and operational characteristics.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations, and testing guidelines in the design and implementation of the software.
  • Designs or develops, maintains, and identifies improvements for the planning, organization, implementation and monitoring of requirements management processes, tools, risk, issues, opportunity management and technology readiness assessment processes.
  • Support test plans and procedure development to verify the functionality and performance of the software system.
  • Support the troubleshooting and resolution of any technical issues or anomalies related to the software during development, integration, manufacturing, and testing phases.
  • Collaborate with project managers to establish project schedules, milestones, and deliverables related to the software.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in gimbal assembly technologies, industry trends, and best practices, and apply this knowledge to enhance the performance and capabilities of our missile seeker system.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor, Master, or Doctorate of Science degree in a related Technical Field (i.e. engineering, computer science, mathematics, or physics)
  • System engineering experience (2+ years) including software test, architecture, and interface development and definition and requirement derivation
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to missile seeker systems
  • Security clearance or the ability to obtain one may be required, depending on the nature of the project.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in design and development of software for missile seekers or similar precision tracking systems
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and techniques for electronic assemblies, including PCB design and fabrication.
  • Proficiency in using engineering software tools for modeling, simulation, and analysis (e.g., CAD, FEA, MATLAB, etc.).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex systems and troubleshoot technical issues.

Typical Education/Experience:

  • Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 2 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD+4 years' related work experience, Master+7 years' related work experience). In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

About DESE

title: Senior Program Management Specialist [L5] (CS Escalations PMO)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Escalations PMO는 CS Escalation 조직의 안정적인 운영을 지원하며, 고객 이슈 및 VOC 기반의 운영 현황 분석을 통해 데이터 기반 의사결정을 지원하고 다양한 프로그램 및 프로젝트를 기획 및 수행합니다.
주요 운영 지표와 에스컬레이션 데이터를 분석하여 조직의 운영 현황을 파악하고, 고객 서비스(CS) 개선 관점에서 업무 프로세스 및 정책 개선 과제를 발굴 및 추진합니다. 또한 업무 표준화와 시스템 개선을 통해 운영 효율성을 높이고, 고객 만족도 향상과 리스크 최소화에 기여합니다.
나아가 데이터 및 AI 기술을 활용한 업무 자동화와 운영 고도화 방안을 발굴하여 CS Escalation 조직의 생산성과 대응 품질을 향상시키고, 지속적인 운영 개선을 지원합니다.

업무 내용

  • 고객 서비스 전반 분석 및 서비스 개선 과제 발굴·기획
  • 데이터 기반 의사결정 지원 및 프로젝트 기획
  • SQL/Python 기반 데이터 추출, 분석 및 운영 리포팅
  • 생성형 AI를 활용한 업무 자동화 및 운영 효율화 기획 및 실무
  • LLM(OpenAI, Claude, Gemini 등)을 활용한 Workflow 및 프로세스 개선

자격 요건

  • 데이터 분석 및 업무 개선 프로젝트 수행 경력이 3년 이상이신 분
  • 고객 서비스 개선 또는 서비스 기획 경력을 3 ~ 5년 보유하신 분
  • SQL을 활용한 데이터 분석 및 인사이트 도출 경험이 있으신 분
  • Python 또는 데이터 자동화 도구 활용 경험이 있으신 분
  • 생성형 AI(LLM)를 업무에 적용하거나 자동화 프로젝트를 수행한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자와 원활하게 협업할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • 고객 서비스 시스템 구축 또는 서비스 개선 프로젝트 경험이 있으신 분
  • AI Agent, RAG 등AI 솔루션 구축 또는 프로젝트 경험이 있으신 분
  • Power BI, Tableau 등을 활용한 고객 데이터 기반 서비스 분석 및 시각화 경험이 있으신 분
  • 업무 자동화(Power Automate, Zapier 등) 플랫폼을 활용한 실무 경험이 있으신 분
  • 생성형 AI(ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude 등)를 활용한 프로젝트 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Systems Engineer - Cloud and Security
description:
Salary: $100,000 per year

We've Got Your Back — and We Want Someone Who's Got Ours

Business IT is a Christchurch-based Managed Service Provider and Managed Security Service Provider, supporting businesses across New Zealand and Australia since 2003. Security isn't an add-on for us — it's built into every environment we manage, aligned to recognised standards like SMB1001, and treated as core to the job rather than optional extra work. What our clients tell us they notice most is our commitment to finding a solution, not just a fix — getting to the root cause, documenting it properly, and making sure it doesn't happen again. That's why clients who've been with us for 10, even 20 years say the same thing: they trust us because we take ownership and follow through.

That kind of trust doesn't happen by accident. It's baked into how we work: People First. Own It. Keep Improving. Make IT Simple. Better Together. If those sound like buzzwords to you, this probably isn't the role. If they sound like how you already operate, keep reading.

The Role

We're after an experienced Systems Engineer who wants more than a queue of tickets — someone who wants to own outcomes across cloud, security, infrastructure, and project delivery, and be trusted to make the calls that go with that.

Day to day, you'll be:

● Resolving complex Level 2/3 issues — the ones that need real troubleshooting, not a script

● Delivering infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Azure, and cybersecurity projects

● Administering M365, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, and Entra ID

● Implementing and managing security solutions across client environments

● Running upgrades, migrations, and change management properly — not just quickly

● Working directly with clients to understand what they actually need, not just what they asked for

● Spotting security risks and helping clients fix them before they become incidents

● Writing documentation that the next person can actually use

● Mentoring less experienced engineers when they need a hand

● Sharing the on-call roster and scheduled maintenance work

What Good Looks Like Here

We hold everyone — including ourselves — to a standard, not just a job description. In this role, that means:

● You escalate risks early, rather than hoping they resolve themselves

● You document as you go, so the next engineer isn't starting from zero

● You communicate before someone has to chase you, especially when a deadline's at risk

● You take the win-together approach — sharing knowledge, asking for help, and not hoarding the tricky fixes for yourself

● You challenge inefficient processes constructively, instead of just working around them

Where AI Fits In

AI is part of how we work here, not a slide in a strategy deck. Tickets arrive pre-triaged, with the device and client context already pulled together, and an AI agent qualifies inbound support calls before a technician even answers. The point isn't fewer engineers — it's engineers who aren't burning their day on the repetitive parts. We do the same for clients, helping them adopt AI properly across their own businesses — with the right guardrails around data, security, and usage policy — rather than just switching something on and hoping for the best. You'll work with these tools from day one and help shape how they develop.

What You'll Bring

● Solid experience as a Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or senior technical support role

● MSP experience (this matters — the pace and variety here rewards it)

● Strong Microsoft 365 administration skills and Azure experience

● Working knowledge of Intune, Entra ID, and modern device management

● Strong cybersecurity best-practice experience

● Confident troubleshooting across Microsoft server, desktop, networking, and cloud

● Genuinely good communication — you can talk to a stressed client without jargon and without condescension

● A full New Zealand driver's licence

Extra certifications and security-focused experience will be viewed favourably — but attitude and ownership matter just as much as the checklist.

What You'll Get

● Competitive salary based on experience

● Fully funded training and certifications

● Exposure to modern Microsoft cloud, security, and AI technologies — not legacy patch-and-pray

● Genuine variety — different clients, different problems, different projects

● Real career progression, not just a title change

● A team that actually backs each other up

● The chance to influence outcomes, not just execute tickets, in a business small enough that your voice counts

Ready?

If you want a role where cloud, security, infrastructure, and client relationships all matter — and you want to work somewhere that holds itself to the same standard it expects of you — apply now with your CV and tell us why you'd be a good fit for the Business IT team.

title: Equipment Specialist
description:
Position Summary

Odyssey Systems has an exciting opportunity for a Equipment Specialist providing support to the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center/Airborne Warning and Control System (AFLCMC/HBS/WIW). The Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS) Division, has the collective Air Force Materiel Command (AFMC) mission responsibility to deliver airborne Battle Management Command & Control (BMC2) capabilities that support joint, allied, coalition, humanitarian, and homeland defense operations. Modernization efforts enable continued involvement with worldwide operations by revitalizing legacy mission systems, replacing aging computer architectures, integrating multi‑sensor data fusion, and improving global expeditionary readiness and availability. Additionally, the Division assists in the planned divestiture of the E‑3 platform and in shaping development of follow‑on capabilities for future airborne C2 systems.

This is a full time Hybrid position located at Tinker AFB, OK.

*Position Contingent Upon Contract Award*

Responsibilities

Duties include, but not limited to:

  • Review and recommend changes to program-unique specifications to include system specifications, development specifications, and product specifications for both hardware and software, for proper format, content, and compliance with program requirements and standards
  • Maintain a current drawing package for all modifications and ensuring the latest version of drawings are on file
  • Ship and transmit drawing packages and their revisions
  • Provide technical support and analysis on field, depot and modification program issues
  • Prepare or assist with preparation of Time Compliance Technical Orders (TCTOs) to support configuration changes and inspections
  • Support execution of CCB and subordinate board (e.g. Technical Review Board) directives by partnering with the Technical Content Managers to manage the publication and distribution of technical order changes
  • Support engineering plans and OSS&E baselines by performing configuration management tasks (including management of DRs, AFTO 22s, and AFTO 252s)
  • Produce monthly DR, AFTO 22, and AFTO 252 performance metrics
  • Support the configuration control function to include receipt, dissemination, processing, tracking, and providing recommendation for the final disposition of Advanced Change Study Notices, ECPs, Requests for Deviation/Request for Waiver, Deficiency Reports (DRs), Airworthiness Directive Notes, Service Actions, Service Bulletins, Aircraft Service Changes, Notices of Deficiency, and Quality Control Plans (QCPs)
  • Review change proposals management impacts, and compliance with Government requirements; provide recommendations for Government review and disposition and assist in the preparation and conduct of CCB and related subordinate boards; and assist in maintaining change proposal files and providing historical information
  • Attend and support FCAs, PCAs, and Compliance Audits, to include auditing hardware and software Configuration Items (CIs), disposition and tracking of action items and assist with preparation of the minutes
  • Assist with TIMs and the preparation of minutes from the meetings
  • Assist and execute transition to a digital technical order system
  • Monitor modification parts listings to identify items not loaded in the National Stock Number (NSN) system
  • Process non-stock listed items into the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) system.
  • Monitor and process parts lists utilized under contractor logistics support for provisioning and configuration management planning and documentation
  • Assist with the development of drawing packages, system-specific and standard, in support of CM

title: Sports Coach - Middle School Basketball
description:
SPORTS COACH - ATHLETIC PROGRAMS

Basketball - Middle School

Part-time, non-exempt, non-benefitted position

APPLICATION CLOSING DATE:

Open until filled. Application screening will begin immediately.

Anticipated start date is 11/2/26.

Girls basketball season will run 1/11/27 - 2/18/27

Boys basketball season will run 3/1/27 - 4/15/27

JOB DESCRIPTION:

General Statement of Duties: Provide instruction, leadership and supervision to participants in athletic programs. Lead skill workouts, practices and competitions in an organized structure; does related work as required.

Distinguishing Features of the Class: An employee in this classification is responsible for coaching and teaching youth and adults in athletic programs. Work is under the general supervision of the Recreation Supervisor, who reviews work primarily based on results attained and on the accomplishment of outlined objectives and goals. Supervision is not normally a responsibility of positions in this classification; however, incumbents are responsible for confirming participation paperwork is received and schedules are distributed.

Examples Of Essential Duties Performed: (Illustrative only. Any single position of a class will not necessarily involve all of the duties listed, and many positions will involve duties that are not listed.)

  • Assumes primary responsibilities for program-assigned tasks including, but not limited to, planning, organizing and scheduling of practice and games for participants.
  • Assumes primary responsibilities to secure practice areas are safe and absent of all hazards and non-approved individuals.
  • Report all participant injuries at practice and competition to the Recreation Supervisor.
  • Provides first aid care as necessary.
  • Carry necessary paperwork including emergency forms, medical and parent/guardian information to all practices and competitions.
  • Ensure locker rooms are checked and cleaned on a daily basis.
  • Oversee students leaving competition site with a parent or guardian and secure the students are signed out when applicable.
  • Attend all coaches meetings and trainings necessary to facilitate program.
  • Perform other job-related duties or tasks as required.



DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS:

Knowledge: Considerable knowledge of methods involved in coordinating, scheduling and implementing a program of recreational activities, coaching methods and techniques, skills and safety precaution involved in athletic programs, and record keeping; knowledge of computers and basic word processing.

Skills: First Aid and CPR


Abilities: Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing; work successfully with youth, parents, co-workers and supervisor; work independently; act calmly and effectively in emergency situations.


Physical Demands of Position: While performing the duties of this position, the employee is frequently required to sit, stand, bend, kneel, stoop, communicate, reach, and manipulate objects. The position requires mobility including the ability to move materials weighing up to 25 pounds on a regular basis such as sports equipment, uniforms, and written materials. Manual dexterity and coordination are required over 25% of the work period while working with youth in activities. Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this class with reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis and depends, in part, on the specific requirements for the job, the limitations related to the disability and the ability of the hiring department to accommodate the limitation.

Required Experience and Training: High school graduation or equivalency and four years of experience in community education, parks and recreation, or related area which included working closely with youth and the general public; or any satisfactory combination of experience and training which demonstrates the knowledge, skills and ability to perform above-described duties.

Preferred Experience and Training: Individuals bilingual in Spanish or ASL are encouraged to apply; a bilingual rate adjustment for Spanish or ASL is contingent upon passing a proficiency test.

Necessary Special Requirements: Concussion certification. Possession of current First Aid, AED and CPR certificates. Because this job is considered safety sensitive, a drug screen test will be required prior to employment. Must be at least 16 years of age.

Hours/Shifts

Monday-Thursday 3:15-5pm

Drug Free Workplace

This job is considered safety sensitive, a drug screen test and ability to pass a criminal background check will be required prior to employment.

description:
Overview

Job Title: Product Manager - PricingLocation: Atlanta, GA

Job Type: Independent Contract (Contractor / Non-Employee)Start Date: ASAP
