title: CRS Clinical Trials Specimen Processing Specialist I
description:
Overview

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington.

With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.

At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

The Clinical Research Support (CRS) - Clinical Trial Specimen Processing Specialist supports oncology clinical trials conducted within Fred Hutch Cancer Center and its research partners. This position is responsible for the collection, preparation, processing, documentation, storage, and shipment of clinical trial specimens in accordance with study protocols, laboratory manuals, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and regulatory requirements. The Clinical Trial Laboratory Technician supports protocol-required laboratory activities, specimen tracking, and research documentation to help ensure the accurate and timely handling of research specimens.

Reporting to the CRS Clinical Trials Specimen Processing Manager, the Clinical Trial Specimen Processing Specialist I works closely with laboratory staff, research coordinators, clinic personnel, investigators, sponsors, and other study team members to support clinical trial operations. This position is an integral part of the Clinical Trial Research Laboratory and contributes to the successful execution of oncology clinical trials through high-quality specimen processing, documentation, and laboratory support services.

This role may work with radiopharmaceutical specimens.

At Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, all employees are expected to demonstrate a commitment to our values of collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity, and respect.

This is an onsite role at our South Lake Union Campus supporting Tuesday-Friday,nine hour shift and Saturday, 4 hour shift.

Responsibilities

  • Process clinical trial specimens according to study protocols, laboratory manuals, and standard operating procedures (SOPs), including specimen preparation, centrifugation, aliquoting, labeling, storage, and shipment.
  • Perform routine laboratory techniques related to clinical trial specimen handling, including separation of serum, plasma, and peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) samples.
  • Prepare, package, and ship research specimens to central laboratories while ensuring all shipment requirements and timelines are met.
  • Complete laboratory requisition forms, specimen tracking records, shipping documentation, and other study-related records accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and contemporaneous records of specimen collection, processing, storage, and shipment activities in accordance with ALCOA+ principles, Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and applicable study, institutional, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with preparation and maintenance of research laboratory kits and supplies used for clinical trial specimen collection and processing.
  • Monitor laboratory inventories and notify laboratory leadership of supply, equipment, or specimen storage needs.
  • Collaborate with laboratory staff, research coordinators, clinic personnel, and other study team members to support protocol-required specimen collection and processing activities.
  • Follow all applicable laboratory safety, biosafety, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), regulatory, and institutional requirements while maintaining participant confidentiality.
  • Support daily laboratory operations and perform additional duties as assigned to ensure efficient and compliant clinical trial research laboratory activities.
  • Travel between Fred Hutch clinical and laboratory locations, including South Lake Union and Montlake campuses, to retrieve, transport, and process clinical trial specimens in accordance with protocol requirements, established timelines, and specimen handling procedures.
  • Provide support for protocol-required specimen collection and processing activities that occur outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, utilizing a flexible work schedule to ensure compliance with study-specific collection and processing windows.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Medical Laboratory Science, or a related scientific field; OR
  • Associate degree in a scientific field and one (1) years of laboratory experience; OR
  • High School Diploma/GED and three (3) years of laboratory experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Lab experience, working in a lab setting.
  • Working knowledge of QA (Quality Assurance).
  • Facilitate the timely delivery of requested documents supporting QA.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Experience with a wide range of computerized systems.
  • Good time management skills.
  • The ability to work well on a team as well as independently.

The hourly pay range for this position is from $29.77 to $42.39 and pay offered will be based on experience and qualifications.Although Fred Hutch is not sponsoring most H-1B visas at this time, candidates who already hold an H-1B sponsored by another organization and are currently in the U.S. may be eligible for this position.

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center offers employees a comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits include medical/vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, life, disability, retirement, family life support, employee assistance program, onsite health clinic, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation (12-22 days per year), paid sick leave (12-25 days per year), paid holidays (13 days per year), and paid parental leave (up to 4 weeks).

Additional Information

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability (physical or mental), marital or veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, political ideology, or membership in any other legally protected class. We desire priority referrals of protected veterans. If due to a disability you need assistance/and or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to Human Resources at hrops@fredhutch.org or by calling 206-667-4700.

title: Fresh Foods Clerk
description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Assist customers by providing over-the-counter service and customer service throughout the Fresh Foods department. Operates and maintains the fresh food production areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza), prepares the areas for sales, fries food, operates the rotisserie oven, prepares ready-to-bake/baked pizzas, etc. Receives inventory, verifies receipt of ordered product, and stocks in designated areas. Consistently provides friendly, courteous service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work. Generally works 6-8 hour shifts between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve, and thank customers. Maintains an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Takes orders, answers questions, and performs suggestive selling.
  • Prepares, stocks, displays, straightens, and rotates product in fresh food areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza).
  • Prepare production items according to recipes, food safety procedures, and/or specified cooking times
  • Handles frozen product.
  • Inspects all product for quality and freshness
  • Prepares case by putting the product in fresh pans, rotating product, putting product back, filling, etc.
  • Places proper signage on all products which includes pricing, description, code dating, and COOL information on all required products.
  • Cleans and maintains department equipment such as fryers, slicers, etc. by breaking down and reassembling equipment, operating dish washer and hand washing dishes, cleaning all appropriate parts with sanitizing solution.
  • Maintains clean and sanitary department by washing parts, tables and wrapping stations; taking trash and paper to the appropriate balers; cleans floors and coolers; cleaning and maintaining glass display counters on the inside and out; etc.
  • Receives inventory, stocks, verifies receipt of ordered product and orders.
  • Follows strict sanitary guidelines and completes associated records.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or needed.
  • Understands and follows all food safety procedures and requirements.

Requirements

Ability to:

  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Communicate (hearing & speech) effectively with customers to receive orders and perform customer relation skills.
  • Conduct visual inspections, read and follow production guides, recipes and product labels, log production quantities, temperature readings, etc. on proper forms.
  • Perform basic math (add, subtract, divide and multiply) and compute weights and measures.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, equipment (e.g., knives) and work aides.
  • Complete training course and meet minimum time standards of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear hair net, beard net and gloves and other personal protective equipment as required.
  • Use cleaning chemicals and handle related food products.
  • Stand, walk and move rapidly for extended periods of time.
  • Bend, stoop, twist, turn and reach over the counter and in tight areas frequently.
  • Lift up to 50 lbs. occasionally and reach, push and pull racks.
  • Handle refrigerated goods (-20°F to 28°F)
  • Work around machinery emitting heat (400°F rotisserie and 325°F hot shortening).
  • Must be 16 years of age or older.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

Additional Requirements:

  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

Machines and Equipment Operated:

  • Cash Register
  • Film over wrapper, digital scales, etc.
  • Knives and other kitchen utensils.
  • Electric Slicers
  • Deep fryers, ovens, etc.
  • Oil filtering machine
  • Dishwasher
  • Trash compactor
  • Cardboard bailer
  • Hand, pallet jack
  • Conveyor ovens

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job. All employees must comply with Company policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and qualifications required of personnel may vary.

EEO/Inclusivity

As the WinCo Foods community continues to grow, our variety of perspectives and wide range of experiences are essential to our strategy and success. We are committed cultivating and celebrating an inclusive environment in which all employees are valued and respected.

description:

title: Product Designer
description:
Product Designer


Turn Creativity Into Connection

Do you believe creativity has the power to bring people together? Are you the kind of person who learns a new craft simply because you're curious how it works? Do you love the challenge of turning creative ideas into achievable customer projects?


If so, we may have the perfect opportunity for you. At Stampin' Up!, we're passionate about connecting people through creative crafting experiences. We're looking for a talented Product Designer who thrives on creativity, collaboration, and hands-on experimentation. This role is ideal for someone who loves exploring new mediums, solving creative challenges, and creating approachable and inspiring crafting experiences that help people discover the joy of making.

About Stampin' Up!

For more than 35 years, Stampin' Up! has been helping people around the world create meaningful connections through creativity. We believe handcrafted experiences have the power to inspire, uplift, and bring people together.

Our culture is built on four core values:

  • We care about people first
  • We act with courage
  • We better our best
  • We own it

We're a company of creators, problem-solvers, learners, and collaborators who believe great ideas come from working together. We embrace curiosity, encourage innovation, and celebrate the joy that comes from creating something with your own hands.

The Opportunity

As a Product Designer, you'll help bring new crafting products and experiences to life, from concept to production. You'll work on a variety of products, including crafting kits, stamps, paper collections, tools, accessories, and other creative offerings that inspire customers to create with confidence.


This role combines creative design, product development, and hands-on experimentation. You’ll explore a variety of creative techniques, crafts, and materials while collaborating with others to transform ideas into products and projects customers can confidently create and enjoy.


Success requires curiosity, creative problem solving, and a willingness to learn. You'll regularly test concepts, refine ideas, and balance creative exploration with practical considerations such as customer experience, manufacturability, timelines, and instructional clarity. This role is perfect for a serial hobbyist and lifelong learner. You'll thrive if you're the type of designer who picks up a new craft just to understand how it works, then uses that knowledge to create inspiring products, projects, and instructions that help others discover the joy of making.


You'll also need to be comfortable navigating ambiguity. Product development is an evolving process, and priorities, requirements, and information can shift as projects progress. If you're energized by learning, adaptability, and change management, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

  • Exemplify Stampin' Up!'s core values: We Care About People First, We Act with Courage, We Better Our Best, and We Own It.
  • Design and illustrate new products, including crafting kits, stamps, paper collections, tools, accessories, and other creative products aligned with business strategy and customer needs.
  • Help transform innovative concepts into products that make crafting approachable, achievable, and inspiring.
  • Transform concepts into engaging products and projects that support connecting people through creative crafting experiences.
  • Complete product assignments with increasing independence while maintaining quality standards and meeting project timelines.
  • Use hands-on experimentation to explore new materials, techniques, and creative possibilities.
  • Participate in reviews, present progress updates, and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple teams.
  • Learn and apply product design standards, manufacturing requirements, brand guidelines, and best practices.
  • Verify engineered artwork and physical products for accuracy and production readiness.

Lead the Field. Own the Plan. Build Something You’re Proud Of.

At iiCON Construction, we believe great projects are built by strong field leaders who take ownership of the work, plan ahead, solve problems, and bring people together to get the job done.


We’re looking for an experienced Project Superintendent who wants more than simply managing the day-to-day activity on a jobsite. This position leads the construction effort in the field and plays a critical role in how our projects are planned, coordinated, and executed.


As a Project Superintendent, you will have responsibility for the project schedule, field operations, safety, quality, trade coordination, site logistics, and execution of the work. You’ll work alongside the Project Manager and project team from preconstruction through closeout to make sure the project stays ahead of problems instead of reacting to them.

What You’ll Do

You’ll lead the field construction effort and create an environment where everyone on the project understands the plan, their responsibilities, and what needs to happen next. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and actively manage the project schedule, including weekly updates, three-week look-aheads, trade commitments, and coordination of upcoming work.
  • Lead daily field operations and coordinate subcontractors, field personnel, materials, equipment, inspections, logistics, and site access.
  • Take ownership of jobsite safety and quality, setting expectations and holding the entire project team accountable.
  • Lead pull planning and weekly work planning using iiCON’s lean construction approach.
  • Work closely with the Project Manager to identify constraints, solve problems, and keep decisions from becoming schedule impacts.
  • Lead subcontractor coordination meetings and hold trade partners accountable for manpower, schedule commitments, quality, and safety.
  • Maintain accurate daily project documentation and ensure significant field conditions, delays, direction, and project events are properly recorded.
  • Plan field manpower and track production rates for iiCON’s self-performed work.
  • Participate in preconstruction, constructability reviews, schedule development, and project turnover
  • Drive punch-list completion and field closeout so projects finish as strongly as they start.


Who We’re Looking For

This role is a strong fit for someone who naturally takes ownership and moves things forward.


You’re comfortable making decisions in the field and don't need someone constantly telling you what to do next. You can look several weeks ahead, recognize problems before they affect the project, and get the right people involved to solve them.


You thrive in a construction environment where priorities can change quickly. You can juggle multiple issues without losing sight of the overall project objectives, and you have the confidence to hold yourself and others accountable.

At the same time, you understand that being a strong Superintendent isn't about simply pushing people. You establish expectations, communicate clearly, build relationships with trade partners, and create a jobsite where people understand the plan and work together toward it.


What You Bring

We’re looking for someone with 5+ years of commercial construction experience as a Superintendent or Quality Control Manager, with hands-on experience managing schedules, quality, safety, subcontractor coordination, and field execution. Experience on commercial projects ranging from approximately $1 million to $30 million is preferred.


You should be comfortable reading plans and specifications, developing and maintaining construction schedules, working with project management and scheduling software, and communicating with owners, design teams, subcontractors, and internal project teams.


The position requires OSHA 30, OSHA 10, CPR/First Aid, applicable Competent Person training, a valid driver's license, and proficiency with construction scheduling software. A Construction Management or Engineering degree is preferred but not required.

Why iiCON?

At iiCON, our Superintendents aren't simply there to watch the work happen. They lead it.


You'll have the opportunity to influence how the project is planned, how the work is sequenced, how trade partners perform, and ultimately how successful the project becomes.


Our projects are built around Creative Solutions, Customer Focus, Quality Results, Stewardship, Leadership, and Teamwork. We want people who take pride in their projects, take ownership of their decisions, and want to continue developing as construction leaders


If you're the kind of Superintendent who likes to know the plan, stay ahead of the work, solve problems, and lead a jobsite from start to finish, we'd like to talk with you.


Great Teams Build Great Projects®


Location

This position will be based in Colorado Springs and may include working on the Front Range from South Denver to Pueblo, Colorado.

iiCON Construction Colorado, LLC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Equal opportunity means every candidate will receive consideration based on his/her ability to do the job, and each employee will be treated in a nondiscriminatory manner on the job. We do not and will not discriminate in our business practices on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital or citizenship status, or any other protected class. We are firmly committed to achieving equal opportunity for all individuals. This applies to all personnel actions, including external and internal recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, and pay and benefits administration.

title: SAP Infrastructure Engineer (SAP Technical Engineering Expert)
description:
Salary: $125 – $150 per hour

SAP Infrastructure Engineer (SAP Technical Engineering Expert)

The location of work for this role is QLD, ACT, VIC, NSW, SA

Scrumtech Digital is looking for an experienced Senior SAP Infrastructure Engineer to join a major government program on a long-term contract. You'll work with SAP Basis administration, SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA platforms, and enterprise infrastructure environments to support secure and scalable systems. This is a great opportunity to work on meaningful projects in a stable, enterprise environment.

CANDIDATE MUST BE AN AUSTRALIAN CITIZEN AND HAVE A NEGATIVE VETTING LEVEL 1 SECURITY CLEARANCE.

Closing Date - 08 October 2026

Organisation - Federal Government Agency

Initial Contract Duration - 12 Months

Extension term - Up to a maximum of 24 months

Experience Level - Senior - EL1 equivalent

Location of work - QLD, ACT, VIC, NSW, SA

Working arrangements - Hybrid. Services required at the agency's premises in Canberra, Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, and Sydney. Working from home arrangements considered where the Labour Hire Worker's residing address is within reasonable travel time and distance of the RFQ location (Capital City) to present onsite in cases of emergency or to meet business requirements.

Job details

Infrastructure Engineers implement, manage and retire the infrastructure (including physical, virtual, networking and cloud infrastructure) that supports digital services.

The SAP Technical Engineering Expert will provide specialist technical expertise to support the operation, maintenance and modernisation of the agency's SAP platform landscape.

The SAP Technical Engineering Expert is responsible for the administration, configuration, optimisation and support of SAP environments, ensuring the ongoing stability, performance, security and availability of critical business systems.

The SAP Technical Engineering Expert will perform activities across the agency's SAP landscape, including system administration, monitoring, performance tuning, transport management, patching, upgrades, system refreshes, troubleshooting, disaster recovery planning and operational support.

The SAP Technical Engineering Expert will work closely with architects, platform engineers, project teams, security specialists and APS staff to ensure SAP services continue to meet operational and business requirements.

The SAP Technical Engineering Expert will support the agency's SAP S/4HANA transition program. This includes providing technical expertise for the migration of existing SAP workloads and databases to SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA platforms, assisting with technical assessments, landscape design, migration planning, system conversions, data migration activities, testing and operational readiness.

The SAP Technical Engineering Expert will contribute to the evaluation and implementation of future-state SAP architectures and support the consolidation and modernisation of existing SAP environments.

The SAP Technical Engineering Expert will provide technical leadership and advice on SAP Basis operations, SAP HANA administration, platform architecture, lifecycle management, integration requirements, system performance and migration approaches.

A key requirement of the role is the transfer of knowledge and skills to APS employees through mentoring, documentation, workshops and day-to-day collaboration, ensuring the agency develops and retains the capability required to support and sustain SAP platforms into the future.

Key duties and responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:​

Provide senior SAP Basis administration and engineering services across the agency's SAP landscape.

Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, patching, maintenance and lifecycle management activities.

Manage SAP transports, client administration, system refreshes and environment management activities.

Monitor, analyse and optimise SAP system performance, availability and reliability.

Provide technical support and troubleshooting for complex SAP platform issues.

Design and implement SAP high availability, backup, recovery and disaster recovery solutions.

Support SAP Security, infrastructure and application teams to ensure compliance with agency standards and policies.

Contribute to the planning, design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA solutions.

Support migration and transition activities from existing database platforms and SAP environments to SAP S/4HANA.

Conduct technical assessments, readiness reviews and proof-of-concept activities for SAP modernisation initiatives.

Develop technical documentation, operating procedures and support models.

Mentor APS staff and facilitate knowledge transfer activities to strengthen internal SAP capability.

The role may require the Contractor to participate in an on-call roster and perform scheduled release shift work.

Skills and Attributes:

Expert-level SAP Basis administration experience.

Strong SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA technical expertise.

Experience with SAP landscape architecture, administration and support.

Experience planning and executing SAP system upgrades, migrations and technical conversions.

Strong knowledge of SAP transport management, system monitoring, performance tuning and troubleshooting.

Experience supporting database migrations and transitions to SAP HANA.

Knowledge of SAP high availability, disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.

Experience working with Linux and enterprise infrastructure environments supporting SAP systems.

Knowledge of cloud-hosted and hybrid SAP architectures.

Experience within large and complex government or enterprise ICT environments.

SAP Certified Technology Associate — SAP System Administration (SAP Basis) or equivalent certification.

SAP Certified Technology Associate — SAP HANA or equivalent certification.

Experience working within Australian Government environments is desirable.

Requirements

Criteria

The buyer has specified that each candidate must provide a one page pitch to address all criteria specified. This is equal to 5000 characters.

Essential criteria

  1. SAP Basis Technical Expertise

    Demonstrated experience providing senior SAP Basis administration and engineering services, including SAP system installation, configuration, transport management, monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, upgrades, patching and operational support within large and complex SAP environments.

  2. SAP Qualifications and Certifications

    Current SAP certification(s) in SAP Basis Administration, SAP System Administration, SAP HANA, SAP S/4HANA or equivalent SAP Technology disciplines, demonstrating contemporary technical knowledge and expertise.

  3. SAP S/4HANA Experience

    Demonstrated experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments, including implementation, upgrade, migration, technical conversion and platform modernisation activities.

  4. Database Migration and SAP HANA Experience

    Proven experience supporting the migration of SAP workloads and database platforms to SAP HANA, including technical planning, system conversion, migration execution, testing, cut-over planning and operational readiness activities.

  5. Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement

    Demonstrated ability to provide expert technical advice and collaborate effectively with architects, engineers, project teams, vendors and business stakeholders to deliver complex SAP platform outcomes.

  6. Knowledge Transfer and Documentation

    Demonstrated experience developing technical documentation, operational procedures and delivering effective knowledge transfer, mentoring and capability uplift activities to internal support teams.

Desirable criteria

  1. Australian Government Experience

    Experience supporting SAP environments within Australian Government agencies or similarly regulated environments.

  2. High Availability and Disaster Recovery

    Experience designing, implementing and supporting SAP high availability, backup, recovery and disaster recovery solutions.

  3. Cloud and Hybrid SAP Platforms

    Experience supporting SAP workloads deployed in cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.

  4. Large-scale ERP Transformation Programs

    Experience contributing to complex enterprise ERP transformation, platform consolidation or modernisation programs.

title: Senior Product Manager, Analytics Features
description:

This is a senior product leadership opportunity focused on building analytics products that help app businesses make better monetization decisions.
You will own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for a suite of analytics capabilities, including dashboards, charts, benchmarking, and predictive LTV.
The role combines product strategy with deep analytical and technical problem-solving in a highly data-driven environment.
You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to turn complex data into actionable customer insights.
You will also investigate data issues, develop meaningful metrics and benchmarks, and identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
The position offers significant autonomy, with responsibility for making product decisions, experimenting rapidly, and delivering measurable business impact.
You will join a fully remote, international environment where ownership, customer focus, systems thinking, and a strong bias toward shipping are highly valued.

Accountabilities

  • Own the product strategy, vision, roadmap, and prioritization for the analytics product portfolio, ensuring initiatives are cohesive, scalable, and aligned with broader product objectives.
  • Lead the development and evolution of analytics capabilities, including charts, dashboards, benchmarking, metrics, and predictive lifetime value features.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their needs, investigate complex analytics and data problems, distinguish meaningful signals from noise, and translate insights into impactful product opportunities.
  • Develop, recommend, and maintain benchmarks and metrics that help app developers understand performance, identify opportunities, and improve monetization.
  • Act as a key point of expertise when data or metrics appear incorrect, investigating underlying causes and edge cases rather than relying solely on engineering teams.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to evaluate feasibility, define solutions, and bring robust analytics and experimentation capabilities to market.
  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, breaking complex initiatives into meaningful deliverables and realistic timelines.
  • Drive product discovery, experimentation, and delivery while balancing quality, customer value, technical complexity, and speed of execution.
  • Independently make product decisions within your area, contribute to broader product strategy, and identify new opportunities to create customer and business value.
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and help teams develop deeper customer empathy and understanding of industry trends.
  • Continuously evaluate product performance and be willing to discontinue or rethink initiatives when evidence shows they are not delivering the expected value.
  • During the first year, establish ownership of your product area, deliver meaningful customer impact, develop a longer-term product vision, and contribute to the evolution of the overall product strategy.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, with significant experience delivering complex products from concept through launch.
    • Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience working with data; proficiency in SQL or comparable data tools and the ability to independently investigate data and develop robust, scalable metrics.
    • Strong technical understanding, including the ability to work effectively with APIs, data models, system architecture, and complex technical constraints. Coding is not a core requirement, but the ability to prototype using code and modern AI-assisted tools is expected.
    • Experience working closely with highly technical engineering and data teams and the ability to understand and communicate complex technical trade-offs.
    • Strong understanding of analytics products, data visualization, metrics, experimentation, and how data can be translated into actionable insights.
    • A strong customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and turn feedback into scalable product solutions.
    • Understanding of the mobile app ecosystem, app-business economics, monetization, and the factors that define success for app developers.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly and concisely across different communication formats, teams, and time zones.
    • Strong ownership mentality, initiative, and willingness to investigate problems directly and take responsibility for outcomes.
    • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments where decisions often need to be made with incomplete information.
    • Systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to move beyond individual customer requests and design solutions that scale across products and users.
    • Strong attention to product and user experience details, including a passion for high-quality data visualization and the ability to connect visual presentation with meaningful insights.
    • Pragmatic approach to product development, balancing a high standard of quality with a strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and iteration.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, international environment and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple time zones.

      • Benefits:

      • $207,000 USD annual salary for the role.
      • Competitive equity package within a fast-growing Series C startup environment.
      • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options.
      • Fully remote work environment designed around autonomy and flexibility.
      • 4–5 weeks of flexible time off annually.
      • Paid coworking space/desk.
      • Dedicated workspace budget.
      • Continuous learning and professional development stipend.
      • Opportunity to work on analytics products operating at significant scale and influencing how app businesses understand and grow their revenue.
      • Collaborative environment with experienced professionals across product, engineering, data, design, and go-to-market functions.
      • Significant autonomy and ownership over product strategy, prioritization, and execution.
      • International, remote-first working culture spanning multiple countries and time zones.

title: Electrical Assembler I – Entry Level/Trainee - Day Shift
description:
The Electrical Assembler is an entry level position focused on developing foundational electrical assembly skills in a manufacturing environment. · Follow all safety procedures, quality standards, and work instructions during assembly and installation activities.

title: Profisee Technical Architect
description:
Hybrid. Not "hybrid" as in one day at home if you ask nicely, actually hybrid.
EL1-equivalent seniority, so you're setting the architecture, not waiting on sign-off for it.

A contract that runs through to 30 June next year, not just to Christmas.
And the kind of scale you only get inside a federal government agency: core data infrastructure used at a national level.

That's the shortlist. One condition sits in front of all of it: you need an active Baseline security clearance already, no exceptions.

I've just had a rare one land on my desk: Senior MDM Technical Architect for a federal government transformation program, rebuilding how a huge, high-stakes dataset is governed and managed end-to-end. The platform is Profisee, but that's the part you can pick up fast if you've genuinely done this before. What matters more is the depth of your MDM background.

This is hands-on: define the architecture, build it, configure Master Data and Reference Data domains, matching, survivorship, stewardship and security models, then work in Azure to make it all talk to everything else.

Based out of Canberra, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane or Hobart. ASAP start.

  • Active Baseline clearance required, no exceptions
  • Hands-on MDM architecture
  • Hybrid, EL1-equiv, contract to 30 June 2027

title: Senior Software Engineer - Reliability, Infrastructure, and Tooling
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Reliability, Infrastructure, and Tooling based in Switzerland.

This is a senior engineering role focused on building reliable, scalable infrastructure for demanding real-time and AI workloads.
You’ll work closely with product engineering teams to design systems that are secure, maintainable, observable, and resilient at global scale.
The role goes beyond traditional operations, combining infrastructure engineering, reliability, tooling, and hands-on product development.
You’ll tackle complex challenges involving distributed systems, Kubernetes, networking, real-time media, and secure execution environments.
Your work will help engineering teams self-serve infrastructure and reliability capabilities without creating unnecessary operational bottlenecks.
You’ll also contribute to incident management, on-call practices, architectural decisions, and long-term reliability improvements.
This is an opportunity to work remotely with experienced engineers while contributing to infrastructure supporting billions of real-time interactions.

Accountabilities

  • Ramp up on a complex global architecture involving distributed databases, messaging systems, networking infrastructure, Kubernetes, and other core platform technologies, identifying areas of reliability debt and improvement.

  • Design and ship reliability-focused engineering work directly within production codebases, including load balancing, load shedding, instrumentation, scalability, and efficiency improvements.

  • Build and evolve internal infrastructure and developer tooling that enables product engineering teams to independently operate reliable workloads.

  • Partner closely with product development teams to co-design systems and ensure reliability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness are considered throughout development.

  • Develop observability capabilities that make system behavior measurable, understandable, and actionable, using appropriate signals and visualization techniques.

  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation and contribute to effective incident response, investigation, remediation, and prevention of recurring reliability issues.

  • Investigate complex system-level problems across distributed infrastructure, networking, application behavior, and production environments.

  • Improve configuration management and infrastructure practices across diverse systems, reducing unnecessary complexity, errors, and technical debt.

  • Contribute technical perspectives to architectural discussions and help establish engineering practices that support both short-term delivery and long-term scalability.

  • Support systems with demanding workloads, including real-time media, secure customer code execution, advanced networking, and other highly concurrent services.

  • Collaborate with engineering partners on potentially contentious reliability and operational decisions with clarity, pragmatism, and strong technical judgment.

  • Automate repetitive operational processes wherever possible to improve engineering efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience building and operating non-trivial production applications, particularly systems involving high concurrency, distributed workloads, or complex control loops.

    • Significant experience with Kubernetes or an equivalent large-scale container orchestration platform.

    • Strong understanding of Linux internals and networking, with the ability to investigate issues across multiple layers of a production system.

    • Proven experience using observability, monitoring, logging, and related tooling to diagnose difficult production problems.

    • Experience operating large-scale, globally distributed systems, including the configuration management, reliability challenges, and technical debt that emerge as systems grow.

    • Experience responding to and managing complex production incidents, including identifying root causes and implementing durable corrective actions.

    • Experience operating open-source infrastructure technologies such as Kafka, ClickHouse, or comparable distributed systems.

    • Strong systems-thinking skills and an ability to reason about infrastructure in terms of signals, feedback, dependencies, and control mechanisms.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with partner engineering teams and navigating competing priorities.

    • A pragmatic approach to engineering that balances immediate delivery needs with long-term maintainability, reliability, and operational cost.

    • A strong interest in observability, reliability engineering, clean configuration, automation, and reducing operational complexity.

    • Nice to have: experience with data engineering and analytics.

    • Nice to have: experience with global Layer 3 networking.

    • Nice to have: experience operating systems with long-lived workloads such as real-time media.

    • Nice to have: experience in Google SRE or another high-scale reliability engineering environment.

    • Nice to have: experience working with compliance frameworks such as PCI.

      • Benefits

      • Equity participation as part of the overall compensation package.

      • Fully remote work with opportunities for collaboration across a globally distributed organization.

      • Health, dental, and vision benefits.

      • Opportunity to work on infrastructure supporting large-scale real-time and AI applications.

description:

  • Improve scan architecture, scan coverage, test models, execution methods, and overall product quality.
  • Perform ATPG pattern and gate-level netlist analysis to identify and resolve testability and coverage issues.
  • Collaborate with physical design engineers to support design closure through static timing, clock-domain crossing, netlist, and power analysis.

  • Understanding of IEEE 1149.1 boundary scan, IEEE 1500 embedded core test, and memory built-in self-test concepts.
  • Experience with multi-clock and multi-power-domain designs.
  • Familiarity with static timing analysis, clock-domain crossing analysis, static power analysis, and physical design closure.
  • Experience adapting standard DFT tools or methods to meet the performance requirements of complex, high-frequency designs.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating across design, physical design, product engineering, and geographically distributed teams.

title: Founding AI Product Engineer
description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

About the role

We’re looking for a strong full-stack engineer who can own the complete product development process: understand a business problem, define the solution, design the user experience, build the software, and improve it after launch.

You’ll work closely with leadership and business teams, combining hands-on engineering with product management and design responsibilities. You should be highly effective with AI coding tools and have the technical depth to independently review, debug, secure, and maintain everything you ship.

What you’ll own

  • Translate business needs and user feedback into product requirements, user flows, prototypes, and prioritized development plans.
  • Design and build polished applications across the front end, back end, database, and integrations.
  • Make architecture decisions and scope releases that balance speed, reliability, and future maintainability.
  • Use AI tools throughout development to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation.
  • Own deployment, production monitoring, incident resolution, and ongoing improvements.
  • Measure whether your work improves adoption, conversion, operational efficiency, or another relevant business outcome.

Required technical skills

  1. Front-end engineering
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Next.js, including component architecture, hooks, routing, and client/server rendering.
  • Strong HTML and CSS skills, with the ability to implement responsive layouts and consistent visual design.
  • Experience managing forms, validation, application state, asynchronous data, caching, and loading/error states.
  • Ability to diagnose rendering issues and improve page performance, bundle size, and unnecessary network requests.
  • Ability to build accessible interfaces with semantic markup, keyboard navigation, and appropriate focus management.
  1. Back-end development and API design
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, using a framework such as Express, NestJS, or an equivalent.
  • Experience designing and implementing REST APIs, including validation, pagination, consistent error handling, and API documentation.
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, role-based access, and third-party integrations.
  • Ability to build reliable background jobs and webhook processing, including retries, duplicate-event handling, and failure recovery.
  • Understanding of timeouts, rate limits, caching, and common application bottlenecks.
  1. Databases and data modeling
  • Strong practical knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL.
  • Ability to design relational schemas, relationships, constraints, and indexes.
  • Experience with database migrations, transactions, and investigating slow queries.
  • Familiarity with an ORM such as Prisma or Drizzle, along with the ability to inspect and optimize the underlying SQL.
  • Ability to handle data integrity, concurrent updates, and safe changes to production data.
  1. Deployment and production operations
  • Experience independently deploying and operating applications on a cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Vercel.
  • Working knowledge of Git, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, and secrets management.
  • Familiarity with Docker and reproducible development environments.
  • Ability to set up useful logs, error tracking, monitoring, and alerts.
  • Experience handling releases, database migrations, rollbacks, and production debugging.
  1. Testing, security, and code quality
  • Ability to write meaningful unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools such as Vitest/Jest and Playwright/Cypress.
  • Strong debugging skills across browser behavior, API requests, application logs, and database queries.
  • Practical understanding of secure sessions, server-side permission checks, input validation, SQL injection, XSS, and protection of sensitive data.
  • Ability to structure maintainable code, review changes critically, and refactor without breaking existing behavior.
  1. AI-assisted software development
  • Regular, hands-on use of tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex.
  • Ability to give AI tools useful repository context, break complex work into verifiable tasks, and guide implementation across multiple files.
  • Ability to evaluate generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and compatibility with the existing application.
  • Experience using tests, type checks, linting, and code review to validate AI-generated changes.
  • Ability to explain and debug the resulting code independently and recognize when an AI-generated approach should be revised or discarded.

Product and design skills

  • Product discovery: Speak with users, understand workflows, identify the underlying problem, and challenge assumptions constructively.
  • Prioritization: Define a focused first release, make scope trade-offs, and connect engineering effort to business value.
  • Interaction design: Create user flows and prototypes using Figma or code, including edge cases and failure states.
  • Visual execution: Apply sound judgment around typography, spacing, hierarchy, consistency, and responsive behavior.
  • Measurement: Instrument important user actions and combine analytics with feedback to guide improvements.
  • Communication: Explain decisions clearly and coordinate with nontechnical stakeholders.

Experience we’re looking for

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of substantial independent ownership.
  • A track record of shipping and maintaining full-stack production applications.
  • Examples of features or products where you personally influenced the requirements, design, and implementation.
  • Experience taking loosely defined problems through to a working release.

Nice to have

  • Python and FastAPI.
  • Experience building AI features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool calling, or retrieval, with attention to evaluation, latency, and cost.
  • Experience integrating CRMs, payment systems, analytics platforms, or business workflow tools.
  • Experience as an early startup engineer or independent product builder.

Why you'll love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

title: Live Production Director
description:
OKC Live Production Director

The OKC Live Production Director works under the LP Pastor to execute all OKC campus needs related to audio, video, and lighting, ensuring excellent, worship-ready delivery for every gathering, rehearsal, and event. This role coordinates, operates, and provides technical support for video, audio, lighting, and production equipment for weekly services, special events, and offsite events, and provides leadership and training to production, technical, and audio staff and volunteers across all Victory Church ministry areas at the OKC Campus, particularly on the tools and technology used by the Live Production and Worship teams.

  • Ensure weekly that venue platforms and LP areas are clean, gathering-ready, and in working order.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Work closely with the Live Production Team to assume primary responsibility for coordinating and operating AVL equipment across all OKC venues.
  • Build and maintain a strong, healthy Live Production team of volunteers.
  • Recruit, train, and empower volunteers to operate production equipment, with training that covers style, team building, spiritual development and technical levels for advancement.

    and database management.
  • Organize, schedule, and attend regular training sessions for potential Serve Team members.
  • Work with OKC LP Pastor to create a system of leadership development to cultivate and train potential production Serve Team leaders.

Technical Operations

  • Understand basic concepts including, but not limited to, electrical safety, rigging, video switchers, cabling, circuits, audio, lighting, and video equipment. Training is also provided by OKC LP Pastor.
  • Work with OKC LP Pastor in troubleshooting and management contact for audio, video, and lighting systems, including updating hardware, software, and equipment firmware.
  • Regularly clean and maintain projectors, lighting, equipment racks, and other production equipment.
  • Load and program content for gatherings and events.
  • Provide audio/visual/lighting technological guidance within the organization.

Budget & Vendor Management

  • Work with OKC LP Pastor to manage and maintain accounts within the annual Production budget.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong personal faith and active involvement in church life.
  • Experience in live production, broadcasting, or church media (3+ years preferred).
  • Proficiency in audio, video, and lighting systems, including rigging and signal flow.
  • Experience leading, training, and developing teams of staff and volunteers.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Experience with digital mixing consoles (e.g., Yamaha, WAVES).
  • Familiarity with ProPresenter and Planning Center.
  • Experience with lighting programming and stage/rigging design.
  • Understanding of worship ministry dynamics.
  • Experience negotiating vendor contracts and managing a departmental budget.

  • Special events, including occasional travel to other Victory campuses and offsite outreach events (Youth Camp, prison ministry, leadership retreats)
  • Flexible weekday hours for preparation, training, and maintenance.

REPORTING STRUCTURE

Reports to: Live Production Pastor

Supervises: All Volunteer Production teams, Technical, and Audio volunteers (OKC campus)


STAFF CORE VALUES/STAFF COMPETENCIES

To perform the job successfully, an individual should adhere to the Staff Core Values and demonstrate the related competencies:


Spirit-led.
We can only lead someone to a place that He has led us to first.

Visionary Leadership – Our staff displays passion and optimism, which inspires respect and trust. They provide vision and inspiration to their teammates, mobilizing others to fulfill the vision.

Leadership – A leader effectively influences the actions and opinions of others, motivating them to perform well. They give appropriate recognition and accept feedback from others.

We will intentionally grow personally and professionally.

title: Sprinkler Technician (Fire Suppression Systems Technician)
description:
Job Purpose

The Sprinkler Technician (Fire Suppression Systems Technician) is responsible for the inspection, testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of automatic fire sprinkler systems, standpipe systems, fire pumps, and special hazard suppression systems at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam (JBPHH) and designated outlying military installations throughout Hawaii.


Work will be performed in accordance with applicable requirements, including NFPA 13, NFPA 25, NFPA 14, NFPA 20, UFC 3-600-01, DoD/Navy installation directives, local Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements, and other applicable federal and installation standards. The position helps ensure fire suppression systems remain fully operational to protect government property and personnel.

The position reports to the Project Manager/Site Supervisor and works closely with the installation Fire Department, Facilities Engineering, and Government Quality Assurance Representative (QAR).

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Inspect, test, and maintain wet pipe, dry pipe, pre-action, deluge, and foam-water automatic sprinkler systems in accordance with NFPA 25 and applicable UFC standards.
  • Perform annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly inspections as required by NFPA 25 and the Performance Work Statement (PWS).
  • Inspect and test standpipe systems, including hose connections, pressure gauges, and flow tests, in accordance with NFPA 14.
  • Inspect, test, and maintain electric and diesel-driven fire pumps in accordance with NFPA 20, including weekly/monthly churn tests and annual flow tests.
  • Troubleshoot and repair system deficiencies, including leaking heads and fittings, corroded piping, valve failures, and waterflow alarm malfunctions.
  • Replace sprinkler heads, control valves, check valves, alarm valves, and associated trim as needed.
  • Perform hydrostatic testing and internal pipe inspections as required by NFPA 25 five-year cycles.
  • Inspect, test, and maintain applicable special hazard suppression systems, including clean agent, Halon alternative, FM-200, CO2, and dry chemical systems.
  • Maintain, service, and certify fire department connections (FDC) and backflow prevention assemblies
  • Coordinate planned impairments, system shutdowns, and fire watch procedures with the installation Fire Department and building occupants in accordance with NFPA 25 impairment requirements.
  • Ensure system tags, signage, valve labels, and as-built documentation are current and accurate.
  • Document inspections, test results, deficiencies, and corrective actions in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) and government-required reporting formats.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable codes and standards, including NFPA 13, NFPA 25, NFPA 14, NFPA 20, UFC 3-600-01, DoD/Navy directives, and local AHJ requirements.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors and specialty vendors for specialized repairs, pipe replacement, or system modifications.
  • Participate in quality control inspections, government QAR reviews, and safety inspections.
  • Maintain required certifications and attend continuing education and training as required.
  • Complete scheduled inspections within the timeframes established by the PWS and NFPA 25.
  • Complete and submit inspection reports within required contract timeframes.
  • Respond to emergency service calls within the response times established by the PWS.
  • Ensure fire pump tests are conducted on schedule and results are properly documented and submitted.
  • Prepare deficiency reports with appropriate corrective-action recommendations.
  • Properly coordinate system impairments and initiate required fire watch procedures.
  • Perform work in accordance with applicable NFPA, UFC, and AHJ standards and support satisfactory government QAR inspections


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associate's degree or technical/vocational training in fire protection, plumbing, or mechanical systems preferred.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience inspecting, testing, and maintaining automatic fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems in commercial, industrial, or government/military facilities.
  • NICET Inspection and Testing of Water-Based Systems Level II certification required; Level III preferred.
  • Journeyman Sprinkler Fitter or equivalent trade certification preferred.
  • Valid driver's license required, with the ability to operate government or company vehicles on the installation.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD/Navy Base Access credential, including required background screening.
  • U.S. Citizenship required for base access.
  • State of Hawaii Backflow Prevention Tester Certification preferred.
  • OSHA 10-Hour Construction Safety certification preferred.

Physical Requirements



  • Ability to lift and carry up to 75 pounds, including pipe, fittings, and equipment.
  • Ability to work at heights using ladders, scaffolding, and aerial lifts.
  • Ability to work in confined spaces, mechanical rooms, crawl spaces, and underground vaults.
  • Ability to work outdoors in Hawaii's tropical climate conditions.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding tasks, including pipe fitting, threading, cutting, and system flushing.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and crouch for extended periods

Work Schedule and Location

The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM, or as otherwise directed by the contract. On-call or emergency-response availability may be required, including participation in a rotating on-call schedule.

Work locations include Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam and designated outlying areas, including Ford Island, Lualualei, West Loch, Barbers Point, Kunia, and other designated sites.

title: Automation Software Engineer
description:
Skilled with automation engineering and ready to dive a bit deeper with the topic as professional? How about moving on to the modernizations side and global scale? We are looking for an Automation Software Engineer to strengthen our competence in the field of automation engineering and to help us with crane modernization projects. By joining our team, you would be working with the group of skilled electrical, mechanical and automation engineers in our Global Modernizations organization. Working in this team means supporting Konecranes frontline units in engineered modernizations for bridge (EOT) cranes. These modernizations are based on Konecranes solutions and technology.

Location: hybrid work model with possibility to work 2 days per week at Hyvinkää office and other days remotely.

Your key responsibilities:

· Automation engineering of crane modernization projects using Siemens Step 7, Tia Portal and some legacy tools.

· Giving engineering support for our project team’s electrical and mechanical engineers as well as some frontline specialists all over the world.

· Automation site commissioning work in our modernization projects.

· Documenting the work into the Konecranes PLM systems.

· Fluency in English and Finnish is important

Why join us?

What our team has, is interesting and challenging engineering tasks related to world-class crane modernization projects. With us, you will develop your skills with interesting projects and relevant training.

We believe in curiosity and passion for learning, which means you will have continuous training and development opportunities.

We offer flexible work arrangements to support balancing your work and private life.

In addition to the base salary, we have a great benefits package which includes an annual bonus system, the opportunity to participate in our Employee Share Savings Plan, and Epassi, among others.

Interested?

If this role sparked your interest, please apply with your CV as soon as possible.

Curious to learn more about the role before applying? Feel free to contact Daria Zhuravleva, Global TA specialist (daria.zhuravleva (at) konecranes.com)

title: Senior Material Planner
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a Material Planner to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planning team is responsible for planning and sourcing of materials to support rapidly iterating and building of cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, mobile ground equipment, and flight vehicles. The Material Planner will have material flow responsibility spanning the entire value chain from raw materials through finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate supply, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop and manage the production plan including working with Purchasing to ensure component availability and scheduling production in line with availability.
  • Provide visibility on part shortages to purchasing and production teams (in clear-to-build).
  • Provide forecasts to the Supply Chain team for components required for production.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to prioritize supply allocations.
  • Work cross-functionally with the Engineering team to provide visibility into material coverage on component changes.
  • Manage Consumables Inventory and ensure stocked to support Production.
  • Develop and maintain processes for working within MRP and the associated master data.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years experience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment in either a supply chain or production-type role where complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies were built.
  • Prior knowledge of Netsuite or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.
  • Ability to travel up to 15-20%.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in any technical field including mechanical/aerospace/manufacturing, electrical, or computer engineering, supply chain, or business with a technical minor or concentration.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing and/or Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma principles in action.
  • Demonstrated ability to completely own a value chain from start to finish, coordinating among multiple different internal and external parties to achieve on-time deliveries under stringent quality standards.
  • Ability to demonstrate a willingness to take on substantial responsibility across supply chain, logistics, engineering, and material planning functions with a bias towards speed and accuracy.
US Salary Range
$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Senior Technical Animator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Animator based in Ireland.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in developing advanced animation technology for ambitious AAA/AA+ game projects.
You will help shape character pipelines and runtime animation systems in Unreal Engine, with a strong focus on Animation Blueprints and Control Rig.
The role combines hands-on technical animation, character rigging, scripting, optimization, and creative problem-solving.
You will collaborate closely with animators, artists, engineers, and technical leadership to translate creative requirements into robust technical solutions.
You will also research new techniques, improve workflows, and help establish best practices across the animation pipeline.
As a senior contributor, you will provide guidance and mentorship to other technical animators while contributing to project planning and delivery.
The position is fully remote and offers the flexibility to work with an international game development team from anywhere in Europe.

Accountabilities

  • Contribute to the technical vision for character animation pipelines and runtime animation systems within Unreal Engine.
  • Design, implement, and maintain complex animation systems, with particular emphasis on Animation Blueprints, State Machines, and Control Rig.
  • Integrate new characters by creating and implementing Physics and Cloth assets and optimizing Level of Detail (LOD) settings.
  • Research, prototype, and introduce new technical animation techniques that improve animation quality, production workflows, and team efficiency.
  • Create and maintain high-quality character and weapon rigs in Maya using internal rigging tools and established technical standards.
  • Skin high-density characters while ensuring high-quality and efficient deformation.
  • Modify and adapt Python-based rig definitions to accommodate unique character requirements while maintaining consistency across the codebase.
  • Work closely with engineers and other technical specialists to resolve complex technical challenges and ensure animation systems remain performant and stable.
  • Partner with the Technical Animation Lead and Director to translate artistic and gameplay requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance, feedback, coaching, and mentorship to junior and mid-level technical animators.
  • Document technical animation workflows, standards, and best practices to promote consistency and quality across projects.
  • Track progress, contribute to task evaluation and scheduling, and communicate upcoming priorities effectively.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in technical animation within the games industry, including experience operating at a senior level.
    • Proven experience shipping at least one AA+ game title in a technical animation role.
    • Expert-level knowledge of Unreal Engine, particularly Animation Blueprints, State Machines, and Control Rig.
    • Strong understanding of dynamic asset systems, especially Physics and Cloth assets.
    • Demonstrated expertise in Maya character rigging and skinning, particularly for realistic characters and high-density assets.
    • Strong proficiency in Python tools programming and the ability to modify and maintain Python-based rigging systems.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with artists, animators, engineers, and technical leadership.
    • Strong problem-solving abilities and an interest in researching new technical approaches and improving animation workflows.
    • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a distributed, multidisciplinary team.
    • C++ proficiency is desirable.
    • Experience with procedural animation techniques is an advantage.
    • Passion for and knowledge of the Action-RPG or Soulslike genre is desirable.
    • A gameplay portfolio demonstrating relevant technical animation and rigging work is expected; creature-related work is particularly welcome.
    • Applicants must have the right to work in the country where they reside.

      • Benefits:

      • 5-month freelance contract with an immediate start.
      • Fully remote work arrangement.
      • Flexible working schedule with core collaboration hours from 10 AM to 4 PM CET.
      • Opportunity to work on ambitious, high-profile game projects with cutting-edge animation technology.
      • Collaboration with talented international artists, animators, engineers, and game development professionals.
      • Opportunity to contribute to advanced Unreal Engine animation systems and modern technical animation workflows.
      • International and diverse remote working environment.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to welcoming people regardless of background, identity, age, disability, or social status.
      • Opportunity to work from the Netherlands while collaborating with a distributed European team.
