title: Head of Product Development
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Product Development based in United Kingdom.

This is a newly created department-head role with direct exposure to the CEO and end-to-end ownership of physical consumer product development.
You will turn customer insights into products that are specified, manufactured, priced, launched, and continuously improved.
The role combines customer research, product design, overseas manufacturing, commercial decision-making, and post-launch performance management.
You will use evidence from reviews, search behavior, social content, surveys, interviews, and testing to determine what products should be built and how they should be positioned.
You will also establish a disciplined feedback loop between launch predictions and actual commercial results.
Alongside individual product ownership, you will lead a small team and shape the research, analysis, and scoring systems that support product decisions.
The position is fully remote, with flexibility around a required daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

Accountabilities

  • Own the complete product development lifecycle, from identifying customer needs and opportunities through product specification, manufacturing, launch, pricing, and post-launch performance.
  • Build and maintain a detailed understanding of target customers, including purchase motivations, customer segments, purchase occasions, price and quality perceptions, trust signals, complaints, and return drivers.
  • Use customer reviews, search behavior, social media, surveys, interviews, concept testing, and pricing research to generate actionable product insights and continuously validate assumptions.
  • Define and prioritize the new product pipeline, determining which opportunities should move forward, wait, or be discontinued based on customer and commercial evidence.
  • Own product and offer design decisions, including materials, construction, specifications, packaging, sizing, color assortment, and market positioning.
  • Manage product development with overseas factories and manufacturing partners, including specifications, samples, quality standards, and production requirements.
  • Monitor live products and lead continuous improvement initiatives, investigating negative feedback to identify root causes and determining when products should be redesigned, relaunched, expanded, or discontinued.
  • Establish a results-oriented feedback loop comparing launch forecasts and assumptions with actual product performance and using those learnings to improve future decisions.
  • Balance pricing, product costs, and expected margins when evaluating product and offer opportunities.
  • Lead and develop the product analysts and sourcing/production coordinator, set priorities, review their work, and raise the overall quality and effectiveness of the team.
  • Guide the development and use of research and scoring tools, including AI-supported workflows, while maintaining appropriate human oversight and validation.

    • Requirements:

    • Demonstrated experience developing and launching at least three physical consumer products sold to US consumers, with ownership of customer insights, product and offer decisions, and commercial results.
    • Experience launching at least one product primarily through an online channel, such as direct-to-consumer, Amazon, or another marketplace.
    • At least five years of experience within a consumer products company, brand, or retailer serving US consumers.
    • Evidence of making difficult product decisions based on customer insights, including having stopped, redesigned, or challenged a product or concept because of research or customer feedback.
    • Strong understanding of customer research methodologies, including interviews, surveys, concept testing, pricing tests, review analysis, and social listening, as well as the strengths and limitations of each approach.
    • Strong understanding of how US consumers evaluate products online, including imagery, reviews, ratings, pricing and price anchors, comparisons, and social proof.
    • Hands-on product development expertise covering specifications, materials, samples, quality standards, and manufacturing relationships, including overseas production.
    • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to evaluate price, cost, margin, customer value, and product quality together.
    • Experience leading at least three people, with a demonstrated ability to improve the quality and effectiveness of their work.
    • Practical experience using AI tools in research or product development, combined with appropriate human review and validation.
    • Excellent written English and the ability to communicate product insights, decisions, specifications, and recommendations clearly and precisely.
    • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment with required overlap from 9 AM to 1 PM US Eastern Time, while maintaining flexibility outside those hours.
    • This role is specifically focused on physical consumer products; backgrounds centered exclusively on software or digital product management, marketing or brand management without product ownership, sourcing or merchandising without customer and offer ownership, or product development exclusively for non-US markets are not aligned with the role.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position.
      • Flexible working schedule outside the required 9 AM–1 PM Eastern Time overlap.
      • Direct reporting relationship with the CEO and significant visibility within the organization.
      • End-to-end ownership of product development and commercial outcomes.
      • Opportunity to shape a newly created product development function and establish its processes, tools, and standards.
      • Leadership responsibility for a dedicated product and sourcing/production team.
      • Opportunity to work across customer research, product development, manufacturing, pricing, and commercial strategy.
      • Ability to use and shape AI-supported research and product development workflows.
      • International exposure through collaboration with overseas manufacturing partners.
      • Compensation and additional benefits to be determined according to the local employment package.

title: BIM Technician II
description:
Exante360, Inc., is looking for a BIM Technician II that wants to join us on our bold initiative of “improving lives through relationships, by connecting people to solutions.”

Role

In this role, you will use your expertise with Revit to provide support to project teams and Exante360’s Center of Excellence (ECOE), with a consistent focus on our values of superior customer service, responsibility, versatility, and excellence. You’ll collaborate internally with senior consultants, designers, BIM Staff, and others to assist our clients with decision making related to a variety of low voltage systems design projects. Your role will require the ability to transfer design concepts and sketches into accurate Revit models.

Exante360 is building an AI-forward organization. We are looking for professionals who embrace artificial intelligence, automation, and digital transformation as part of how they work. Ideal candidates are proactive in learning and applying new technologies, comfortable integrating AI tools into their workflow where appropriate, and capable of combining technology with sound business judgment to deliver exceptional results.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with the project team to establish drawings and documents from concept to completion; review and interpret 2D drawings and 3D models for changes; revise necessary components using Exante360 documented procedures, BIM standards, and applications.
  • Facilitate the completion of construction drawings which may include multiple views, detail drawings and line drawings indicating components of equipment, facilities, or systems.
  • Organize BIM project setup, data sets, and workflow.
  • Adhere to architectural BIM execution plans as well as any client or project standards.
  • Weekly/daily Revit model management administration and maintenance.
  • Assist in clash detection of 3D models as it relates to our devices and pathways.
  • Assist with maintaining Revit libraries as well as expanding the current family library.
  • Maintain an understanding of QA / QC protocol for all assigned tasks.
  • Provide support on various tasks required for the successful completion of the project such as project scheduling, coordination, and administrative tasks.
  • Work in conjunction with technology designers and project managers to meet scheduled deliverables deadlines and milestones.
  • Assist new designers and BIM technicians with necessary training.
  • Continually research new methods to improve existing workflows.
  • Effective communication and project documentation.
  • Work closely with the project team in a high performance and dynamic environment.
  • Participate in a minimum of 4 hours per month of continuing professional development/education - products, technology, codes, and skills development. See Training and Development Pathway.

Key Skills and Abilities Necessary

  • Sense of responsibility, customer service, excellence, and versatility.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment.
  • Must be able to handle multiple concurrent assignments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Education/Experience Requirements

  • 4-7 years Revit experience
  • Proficiency in at least two low voltage disciplines as well as three low voltage systems for each discipline.
  • Experience generating Revit families and project standards.
  • Experience setting up and maintaining complex Revit models.
  • Familiarity of Navisworks 3D coordination software.
  • Working knowledge of MS Office and Bluebeam.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of the architectural process and ability to produce construction documents.
  • AA/BS degree in architecture, engineering, IT or related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, data analytics, or other emerging technologies to improve efficiency, decision-making, collaboration, or business outcomes.

What We Offer

We believe that the culture of the company, work environment, and job responsibilities present a unique working atmosphere in which you will thrive. We trust people to own their work, make smart decisions, and use the freedom they’re given to deliver exceptional results. We uphold superior customer service, strive for excellence, embrace versatility, and take responsibility in everything we do. Join a growing team that’s shaping an exciting, fast-evolving industry and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible!

We’re proud to offer an experience that not only makes work more enjoyable, but also empowers you to grow, stay energized, and feel supported every step of the way.

  • Remote work environment built on intentional connection
  • Professional growth through prioritizing your continued education goals
  • Robust benefit package to support wellness and work life balance

Who We Are

Exante360, Inc. is an industry-leading technology design and consulting company that specializes in Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and Security systems. Guided by our Core Values, our certified professionals consult, design, and manage a variety of specialized low-voltage systems including telecommunications and data network cabling infrastructure, wireless (Wi-Fi, DAS, ERCES), electronic security systems (access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, security communications), audiovisual, fire alarm, nurse call, clinical communications, and other technology systems. Since our founding in 2013, our company has successfully completed thousands of technology design projects in various market sectors, including healthcare, education, data centers, critical infrastructure, corporate, government, biotech, and transportation. Our services include project management and construction administration to ensure that our projects effectively produce Intended Results.

title: AI Orchestrator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a AI Orchestrator based in Brazil.

Orchestrate the end-to-end delivery flow across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), connecting upstream demand with technical execution and final delivery.
This role sits across the entire value stream rather than within a single delivery stage, coordinating people, AI agents, workflows, and dependencies.
You will govern how work is delivered, ensuring the right balance of time, cost, quality, compliance, and business value.
The position combines delivery governance, process evolution, AI fluency, workflow optimization, and financial and technical feasibility assessment.
You will work closely with AI Engineers, AI Deployment Engineers, and multidisciplinary teams to translate demand into executable solutions.
Success will depend on your ability to define meaningful metrics, manage exceptions and approval boundaries, and continuously improve the operating model.
You will also help teams adopt a new way of working centered on effectively orchestrating AI agents rather than relying solely on traditional specialization.

Accountabilities:

  • Define, review, and continuously evolve delivery processes, standards, governance practices, and team rituals.
  • Monitor and maintain workflow health, identifying bottlenecks, dependencies, exceptions, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Define and monitor success metrics such as ROI, accuracy rates, delivery performance, and other relevant value indicators.
  • Prioritize initiatives and delivery activities based on the value they generate for the organization and end users.
  • Govern AI-enabled workflows by managing dependencies, exception paths, levels of agent autonomy, and appropriate boundaries for human approval.
  • Promote consistency across the delivery model while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability.
  • Develop AI fluency across the team through continuous learning, enablement, and practical adoption of AI-driven ways of working.
  • Support the squad in transitioning toward a model where teams effectively orchestrate AI agents and workflows rather than relying primarily on accumulating specialized capabilities.
  • Facilitate continuous improvement of the overall delivery operating model and encourage experimentation with new AI-enabled practices.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong experience in end-to-end delivery orchestration, program/project management, product delivery, operations, transformation, or a comparable cross-functional discipline.

    • Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand complex workflows, dependencies, bottlenecks, exceptions, and interactions across multiple teams and technologies.
    • Experience establishing or improving processes, standards, governance models, and delivery rituals.
    • Strong analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance cost, time, quality, technical feasibility, compliance, and business value.
    • Experience defining and tracking delivery or business success metrics, including ROI, quality/accuracy indicators, efficiency, or comparable performance measures.
    • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams without relying exclusively on formal authority.
    • Demonstrated AI fluency and an understanding of how AI agents can participate in workflows and software delivery processes.
    • Ability to govern AI-enabled workflows, including dependencies, exceptions, autonomy levels, escalation paths, and human approval boundaries.
    • Strong adaptability and continuous-improvement mindset, with an interest in evolving traditional ways of working through AI-enabled approaches.
    • Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into clear workflows, priorities, and execution plans.
    • Strong facilitation, coordination, and organizational skills to maintain alignment across people, agents, and delivery stages.
    • Willingness and ability to continuously develop AI capabilities and help teams adopt new AI-driven operating models.

      • Benefits:

title: Nuclear Medicine Technologist
description:
Overview

The images you provide will help our medical staff determine patient situations and provide appropriate care. Your work as a nuclear medicine technologist will involve your expert knowledge and judgment in regard to radionuclide administration, imaging technique and patient treatment. Together with the entire imaging services department, you will strive to make life better for others.

Legacy Good Samaritan Medical Center in Northwest Portland is known for its specialty programs and clinical excellence. Legacy Good Samaritan features nationally renowned doctors in cancer care, kidney transplantations, neurology, ophthalmology, weight-loss surgery, robotic surgery, rehabilitation and more, plus Oregon’s only 24-hour urgent care that’s located alongside an emergency room, with access to emergency care if needed.

Responsibilities

IMAGING: Provides quality images with accuracy and efficiency, using optimal

skills and knowledge of all equipment.

Administers radionuclides according to department policies and training.

Positions patient for diagnostic imaging according to department procedures, training, and machine requirements.

Operates imaging equipment, determines and sets exposure factors, sets technique utilizing all relevant factors to ensure accurate and quality images with minimal and acceptable repeat rates.

Uses computer image processing to select and optimize images.

Develops and presents films and related patient information to the nuclear medicine / ultrasound physician for diagnosis.

Assists with patient transport by moving patients using standard procedures.

DOCUMENTATION: Gathers complete documentation of all pertinent information to provide accurate and timely service to customers.

Identifies patient by checking patient's I.D., full name and medical record number according to department procedure.

Reviews patient chart and orders to insure correct examination.

Labels images completely with demographic, position and other needed documentation.

Logs activities, gathers charging information and charges exams as required.

Follows department and hospital procedures and policies.

Performs quality control and quality assurance, records results and reports variance from normal equipment function.

PERSONAL & PATIENT CARE AND SAFETY: Quality patient care appropriate to age of neonate, pediatric, adolescent, adult and geriatric patients is provided using professional judgment in accordance with written standards so there is no injury to self or others.

Protects patients and others in the area by using proper machine settings and radiation safety standards.

Practices universal and blood and body fluid precautions and sterile practices according to procedures.

Communicates and uses knowledge of related anatomy and physiology to insure appropriate and effective care to neonate, pediatric, adolescent, adult and geriatric patients.

Maintains awareness of patient status and takes appropriate actions to meet their needs.

Starts IV’s using proper technique and administers medications under the direction of the LIP.

PROFESSIONAL BEHAVIOR: Practices professional communications, appearance, conduct, punctuality, attendance and attitude that leads to physician, patient and co-worker respect and confidence.

Informs patient and/or family of all needed information concerning the exam performed.

Uses professional judgment and presents a professional image of competency to customer and staff.

Maintains professional appearance, punctuality, flexibility, confidentiality and guest relations.

Handles stressful situations in ways that promote positive outcomes.

Takes personal initiative to maintain current in education (journals, books, in-services, seminars, etc.) and certification.

Participates in presenting professional information to colleagues.

Qualifications

Education:

Graduate of approved Nuclear Medicine Technology program or Radiologic Technology

program with Nuclear Medicine Specialty is required.

Experience:

One-year experience in Nuclear Medicine preferred.

Skills:

Keyboard skills and ability to navigate electronic systems applicable to job functions.

Licensure

Licensure/Certification:

Certified Nuclear Medicine Technologist (CNMT) or registration in Nuclear Medicine (ARRT-N) required. Current state license in Nuclear Medicine required for all employees who perform this job in the state of Oregon. Current Radiologic Technologist Certification required for all employees who perform this job in the state of Washington. AHA BLS for Healthcare Providers.

Pay Range

USD $51.13 - USD $73.12 /Hr.

Our Commitment to Health and Equal Opportunity

Our Legacy is good for health for Our People, Our Patients, Our Communities, Our World. Above all, we will do the right thing.

If you are passionate about our mission and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can grow and succeed.

description:
Rocky Mountain Care’s Hunter Hollow skilled nursing community in West Valley City provides unparalleled rehabilitation therapy and nursing services and is consistently recognized as a leader in nursing care. We composed our integrated team of nursing specialists with the most highly trained and most experienced personnel to meet the individual needs of each of our guests in a personal and professional manner. Coupled with our incredible staff and unbeatable service, guests of Hunter Hollow enjoy breath taking surroundings that provide a wide range of opportunities for their wellness experience. Hunter Hollow in West Valley is Medicare and Medicaid certified, and is available for short and long-term care.

RESTORATIVE Therapy Aide - SNF

Job Description

Department

Nursing

Reports to

Director of Nursing, Unit Manager or MDS Coordinator

Reporting to this position

None

Job Classification

Department Staff

Position Purpose

Provides restorative nursing services to assigned residents in accordance with care plans and facility policies & procedures.

Required Qualifications

Minimum requirements include the following:

  1. Certified Nursing Assistant in good standing with the state.
  2. High school diploma or equivalent.
  3. Current CPR/BLS Certification
  4. Current Food Handler Permit (Where Applicable)

Must have no disciplinary action in effect against certification.

At least one year of experience as a certified nursing assistant in long-term care.

Completed training in restorative nursing services, or complete the training within 90 days of hire or promotion to the position.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Receives specific restorative nursing assignments from Restorative Nurse, or designee, or a discharging therapist. Performs duties as assigned.

Performs restorative nursing services in accordance with care plans and facility policies and procedures. These services may include activities related to range of motion, splint/brace assistance, bed mobility, transfers/walking, dressing/grooming, eating/swallowing, amputation/ prosthesis care, and communication.

Performs tasks to individual residents or as part of small group classes.

Coordinates dining room services at assigned mealtimes, including set-up and clean-up, meal tray delivery, feeding assistance, and documentation of meal intake.

Delivers nutritional supplements to residents at assigned times and provides assistance as necessary to ensure intake. Documents intake accordingly.

Assists with weighing residents according to facility policy, and records weight in designated locations. Reports weight changes to nurse and supervisor.

Assists with tracking the condition of splints/braces of residents who require them. Reports lost or broken splints/braces to nurse and supervisor.

Assists nursing staff in carrying out toileting program activities.

Completes flow sheets daily to indicate that the specified restorative nursing task was done. Documents the progress of each resident as directed by supervisor.

Keeps nurse and supervisor informed of factors that interfere with being able to perform the work as assigned (i.e. resident refusal, reassigned to nursing unit).

Reports changes in a resident’s condition to the resident’s nurse and supervisor.

Other Assigned Tasks

  1. Attends care-plan meetings of assigned residents as able.
  2. Participates in QAPI or facility assessment activities as needed, such as carrying out duties assigned as part of a performance improvement committee.
  3. Accepts certified nursing assistant assignments as staffing needs require. Performs certified nursing assistant duties as assigned, in accordance with facility policies and procedures.
  4. Uses proper lifting and body mechanics while delivering care to residents.

Additional Tasks

  1. Treats all residents with dignity and respect. Promotes and protects all residents’ rights.
  2. Establishes a culture of compliance by adhering to all facility policies and procedures. Complies with standards of business conduct, and state/federal regulations and guidelines.
  3. Follows appropriate safety and hygiene measures at all times to protect residents and themselves.
  4. Maintains confidentiality of protected health information, including verbal, written, and electronic communications.
  5. Reports noncompliance with policies, procedures, regulations, or breaches in confidentiality to appropriate personnel. Reports any retaliation or discrimination to HR or compliance officer.
  6. Reports any allegations of abuse, neglect, misappropriation of property, exploitation, or mistreatment of residents to supervisor and/or administrator. Protects residents from abuse, and cooperates with all investigations.
  7. Reports any occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and/or hazardous chemicals in accordance with facility policy.
  8. Participates in all life safety and emergency drills and trainings. Fulfills responsibilities as assigned during implementation or activation of the facility’s emergency plan.
  9. Reports work-related injuries and illnesses immediately to supervisor.
  10. Follows established infection control policies and procedures.
  11. As a condition of employment, completes all assigned training and skills competency.

Personal Skills and Traits Desired/Physical Requirements

  1. Ability to read, write, speak and understand the English language.
  2. Must be a supportive team member, contribute to and be an example of team work.
  3. Ability to make independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action.
  4. Ability to deal tactfully with personnel, residents, family members, visitors, government agencies/personnel and the general public.
  5. Must have patience, tact, and willingness to deal with difficult residents, family and staff.
  6. Must be able to relay information concerning a resident’s condition.
  7. Must not pose a threat to the health and safety of other individuals in the workplace.
  8. Must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday.
  9. Meets general health requirements according to facility policy, including medical and physical exams and checking immunity status to various infectious diseases.
  10. Ability to work beyond normal working hours and on weekends and holidays when necessary.
  11. Ability to assist in evacuation of residents during emergency situations.
  12. Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, perform overhead lifting and perform other common physical movements as needed for the position.
  13. May be subject to falls, burns from equipment, and/or odors throughout the day; encounter reactions from dust, tobacco smoke, disinfectants, and other air contaminants.
  14. Subject to exposure to infectious waste, diseases and/or conditions which include AIDS, Coronavirus, Hepatitis B, and Tuberculosis.
  15. May be subject to hostile or emotional residents, family members, visitors or personnel.
  16. Ability to work independently, and to organize, plan, and manage time effectively to complete assignments.
  17. Knowledgeable of restorative nursing practices, and ability to demonstrate knowledge and skills necessary to provide appropriate care to meet resident needs.
  18. Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  19. Strong listening skills and ability to deal with conflict with professionalism and courtesy.
  20. Basic computer skills, including ability to navigate electronic medical record systems.
  21. Positive interpersonal relationship skills, including with persons of all ages and cultures.
  22. Dexterity of hands and fingers to perform resident care.

Compliance as a Condition of Employment and Performance Appraisal

Agreement to abide by all standards, policies, and procedures of the facility, including the facility’s compliance and ethics program, is a condition of employment. Compliance will be a factor in evaluating job performance. Violations, including failure to report violations, will result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

Other tasks not listed here may be assigned if the tasks are similar or related to the essential duties of the position.   4. Exceeds Standards: Achieves results that usually exceed the standards identified for the performance factors rated.

title: CRM Platform Engineer (Customer.io)
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
About Uphold

Uphold is a financial technology company that believes on-chain services are the future of finance. We provide modern infrastructure for on-chain payments, banking and investments. Offering Consumer Services, Business Services and Institutional Trading, Uphold makes pioneering financial services easy and trusted for millions of customers in more than 140 countries.

Uphold integrates with over 30 trading venues, including centralized and decentralized exchanges, to deliver superior liquidity and optimal execution. Uphold never loans out customer assets and is always 100% reserved. The company pioneered radical transparency and uniquely publishes its assets and liabilities every 30 seconds on a public website (Transparency Page).

Uphold strips away the complexity to open up Web3 finance for everyone.

To learn more about Uphold, please visit .


Job Summary

Uphold is looking for a CRM Platform Engineer (Customer.io)/CRM MarTech Manager to take full ownership of Customer.io, the platform we use to communicate with millions of customers across email, push, in-app and SMS.

This is a technical role, not a campaign execution role. You will own the data model, the integrations, the workflow architecture and the operating standards that make customer communication possible at scale. You will sit between Engineering, Data, Marketing and Commercial, and you will be the person who decides how the platform is built and how it is used.

The scope is wide. Uphold runs multiple products and regions on shared infrastructure, in a highly regulated industry, with a large volume of personal data. Getting this right means designing for reuse, for auditability and for safety, not just for the next campaign.



What you’ll be doing primarily

Own the CRM data foundation

  • Own the data layer inside Customer.io: Define and maintain the objects, attributes, events and identifiers that power the platform. Segmentation quality is a direct function of data quality, so this is the core of the role.
  • Work hand in hand with Engineering and Data: Design and maintain the pipelines that feed Customer.io. Agree on schemas, event contracts and data freshness requirements, and hold the line when they drift.
  • Guarantee freshness and correctness: Put monitoring and alerting in place so that stale, missing or malformed data is caught before it reaches a customer, not after.

Architect workflows that last

  • Apply systems thinking to campaign design: Build journeys, triggers and segments that are modular, reusable and understandable by someone who did not build them.
  • Prevent workflow sprawl: Establish naming conventions, versioning, documentation and deprecation routines. Retire what is no longer used. Treat the CRM workspace as a codebase, not a folder of one off campaigns.
  • Design for scale: Anticipate volume, message throughput, rate limits and platform constraints before they become production issues.

Operate with a multi product and multi brand mindset

  • Serve several products and brands from one platform: Design workspace structure, data models and templates so that Wallet, Topper, Enterprise and future brands share what should be shared and separate what must be separated.
  • Balance consistency with autonomy: Give each product team room to move without letting the overall architecture fragment.
  • Manage cross brand message pressure: Own global frequency capping, priority rules and suppression logic so customers receive a coherent experience across products.

Translate business objectives into CRM capability

  • Partner with Marketing and Commercial: Understand what the business is trying to achieve, then decide what the platform needs to look like to support it. Push back when a request is better solved a different way.
  • Turn requirements into architecture: Convert commercial goals into concrete data, segmentation and workflow design, with clear trade offs and sequencing.
  • Own the roadmap for the platform: Maintain a prioritised view of platform work and communicate it to stakeholders.

Enable marketing autonomy

  • Build for self sufficiency: Create templates, reusable components, documented segments and clear guardrails so marketing teams can launch routine work without engineering support.
  • Train and document: Run enablement sessions and maintain practical documentation. Success is measured by how much the teams can do without you, not by how much depends on you.
  • Set the guardrails: Define what marketers can change freely, what needs review, and what is locked. Make the safe path the easy path.

Drive automation and AI adoption

  • Identify automation opportunities: Look for manual, repetitive or error prone steps across the CRM operation and remove them.
  • Apply AI where it earns its place: Evaluate and implement AI for content generation, send time and channel optimisation, segmentation, anomaly detection and QA. Be pragmatic about where it adds value and where it does not.
  • Keep improving the operation: Measure the cycle time from business request to live campaign, and work it down.

Security and data protection first

  • Treat personal data with care: This is a PII heavy environment. Apply data minimisation, least privilege access, retention rules and clear handling standards by default.
  • Own consent and preferences: Maintain the consent, opt out and preference model, and make sure it is respected consistently across every channel and every brand.
  • Support compliance and audit: Work with Security, Privacy, Compliance and Legal on GDPR, access reviews, vendor risk and audit evidence. Be able to explain who received what, when, and on what basis.
  • Respect jurisdictional rules: Uphold operates under multiple regulatory regimes. Build the targeting and suppression logic that keeps communications compliant by market, including mandatory risk warnings and geographic restrictions on financial promotions.

Protect quality at the customer touchpoint

  • Be detail and quality obsessed: Every message is a direct customer touchpoint and a reflection of the brand. Own the QA process, including test sends, seed lists, rendering checks, link validation and pre send review.
  • Own deliverability: Manage domain and IP reputation, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warm up, list hygiene, bounce and complaint rates. Deliverability is an engineering problem, and it belongs to this role.
  • Run change management: Define approval gates, no send windows, rollback procedures and incident response for communication failures.
  • Measure and improve: Own experimentation design, holdout groups and performance reporting, in partnership with the Data team.


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • BS or advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in the field, with meaningful time spent owning a marketing automation, CRM or customer engagement platform in a technical capacity.
  • Hands-on experience with Customer.io, or a comparable platform such as Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, at an architecture and administration level rather than campaign execution only.
  • Strong SQL and comfort working with data warehouses and modern data pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, event driven data models and identity resolution.
  • Working knowledge of templating languages such as Liquid, plus HTML, CSS and JavaScript for email and in-app content.
  • Demonstrated systems thinking: the ability to design maintainable, scalable structures rather than solve each request in isolation.
  • Experience working with personal data under a security and privacy first approach, including consent management and GDPR.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working across functions with Marketing, Commercial, Product, Data and Engineering.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.
  • Fluent written and oral English.


Salary: $150K + Bonus, Benefits

Bonus if you have

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrencies or other digital assets, as they are core to our business.
  • Experience running CRM across multiple products or brands from a single platform.
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms and reverse ETL tooling.
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt or similar modern data stack tooling.
  • Practical experience applying AI tooling to marketing or CRM operations.
  • Deep email deliverability experience, including reputation management and remediation.
  • Experience integrating mobile SDKs for push and in-app messaging.
  • Community talks, certifications, and/or blog posts on your interests and research.
  • Open source project contributions of any kind.

Importantly, if you are looking for a senior role with us, you will have achieved many of the things above while also providing mentorship to others, and have engaged in public speaking opportunities.


What We Offer

  • Innovation and Impact: Contribute to pioneering projects in a dynamic and challenging environment.
  • Competitive Compensation: Performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits on top of a competitive salary.
  • Strong Company Culture: Thrive in a supportive, collegiate environment with values of integrity, teamwork, accountability, and excellence.
  • Global Collaboration: Participate in regular updates, strategy sessions, and networking opportunities across the group.
  • Development Opportunities: Access training and mentorship programs.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy options to work from home, other locations, or adjust your hours.
  • Inclusive Environment: Value and respect diverse perspectives.



Our Benefits

  • Generous PTO, healthcare, and employee assistance programs.
  • Engaging events and celebrations.
  • Well-stocked office kitchen with a foodie culture.


Join us to grow, innovate, and contribute meaningfully. Be part of our talented team!

Visit our careers page for more exciting opportunities, if this role isn’t the perfect fit.

title: Clinical Research Regulatory Specialist B
description:
**University Overview**

The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

**Posted Job Title**

Clinical Research Regulatory Specialist B

**Job Profile Title**

Clinical Research Regulatory Specialist B

**Job Description Summary**

The Penn Neurogenetics Therapy Center (PNTC) supports a diverse group of neurogenetics investigators and clinical research professionals conducting investigator-initiated clinical research and complex, industry-sponsored, first-in-human trials of gene therapies for neurological diseases. The PNTC is seeking a Clinical Research Regulatory Specialist B (CRRS B) to support clinical trial startup and ongoing regulatory activities across the Center’s portfolio of clinical trials while following applicable institutional and federal regulations as well as ICH-GCP guidelines. The CRRS B will function as part of a multidisciplinary team and will report to the PNTC Director of Operations.

**Job Description**

The CRRS B will play a key role in coordinating trial start-up activities from feasibility assessment through site activation, working closely with PNTC Project and Business Managers, investigators, study teams, institutional offices, sponsors, and contract research organizations (CROs). Responsibilities will include coordinating and tracking regulatory and ancillary submissions, essential study documentation, and other startup requirements to support efficient and timely study activation. Following activation, the CRRS B will collaborate with study teams to provide ongoing regulatory support, including protocol amendments, continuing reviews, reportable events, regulatory documentation, maintenance of complete and inspection-ready study files, and coordination of monitoring visits and audits.

The ideal candidate will be highly motivated, organized, and detail-oriented, with a proactive and collaborative approach and the ability to plan and manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced clinical research environment. Prior experience with regulatory/ethics boards/ancillary submissions and reviews, industry-sponsored early-phase clinical trials, and/or gene therapy research is strongly preferred.

- Coordinate clinical trial startup from feasibility assessment through site activation, working collaboratively with PNTC Project and Business Managers and other stakeholders to track regulatory and ancillary submissions, essential study documentation, timelines, dependencies, outstanding items, and activation requirements across regulatory, operational, budget, and contract workflows.
- Prepare, coordinate, and process regulatory submissions to the IRB and required ancillary review committees, and prepare, collect, and submit essential regulatory documentation required by sponsors, CROs, and other applicable entities.
- Provide ongoing regulatory support for active clinical trials, including protocol amendments, continuing reviews, reportable events, personnel and study document updates, and other required regulatory submissions and documentation.
- Maintain complete, accurate, current, and inspection-ready regulatory documentation and investigator site files (ISFs) throughout the study lifecycle in accordance with institutional, sponsor, and applicable regulatory requirements.
- Resolve regulatory queries and support study oversight activities, including site initiation, monitoring, audit, inspection, and close-out activities, in collaboration with investigators and study teams.
- Participate in study team meetings, protocol and regulatory training, and compliance activities, and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of regulatory and clinical trial startup processes, guidance documents, templates, trackers, and other work tools.
- Perform additional duties as assigned.

The position is hybrid eligible and contingent on continued funding.

The job pay range encompasses the full range of employees from new hires to the salaries of Penn employees with many years of experience and seniority. It is not a precise indicator of the new salaries of new hires when working at the top end.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree and 3-5 years of research experience or equivalent combination of education and experience is required . At least 1 year of regulatory experience preferred. Associated research credentialing (RAC, CCRP, CIP, etc.) preferred.

- Preferred: Must be organized and able to prioritize; effective communication and writing skills; strong time management skills; flexible and able to multi-task; demonstrated ability to work as part of a team, as well as independently. At least 1 year of regulatory experience preferred. Associated research credentialing (RAC, CCRP, CIP, etc.) preferred.


**Job Location - City, State**

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

**Department / School**

Perelman School of Medicine

**Pay Range**

$63,085.00 - $70,119.00 Annual Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. Internal organization and peer data at Penn are also considered.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

The University of Pennsylvania is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, creed, national origin(including shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics), citizenship status, age, disability, veteran status or any class protectedunder applicable federal, state or local law.

**Special Requirements**

Background checks may be required after a conditional job offer is made. Consideration of the background check will be tailored to the requirements of the job.

**University Benefits**

- **Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts**: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.

- **Tuition**: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions.

- **Retirement:** Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard.

- **Time Away from Work:** Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be.

- **Long-Term Care Insurance:** In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.

- **Wellness and Work-life Resources**: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.

- **Professional and Personal Development:** Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.

- **University Resources:** As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.

- **Penn Home Ownership Services:** Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.

title: Engineering Director
description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

We’re looking for an exceptional Engineering Director to help lead and scale our engineering organization as we build the next generation of financial technology that empowers and increases the competitiveness of Latin American organizations.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong technical judgment, people leadership, platform and systems-scale thinking, and business acumen. You will lead multiple engineering teams, develop engineering leaders and IC builders, shape our technical strategy, and ensure we continue to increase our execution velocity while maintaining the reliability, security, and quality expected from a regulated fintech platform.

You will also play an important role in how we leverage AI across our products and engineering organization, helping us identify opportunities to improve customer experiences, automate complex workflows, and increase engineering productivity.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a high-growth, fast-moving environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and can move naturally between strategy, technology, people, and direct execution.

What you'll do

  • Recruit, lead and scale engineering teams. Lead multiple teams building a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, speed, and technical excellence.
  • Develop exceptional builders. Coach and grow senior engineers while strengthening our leadership pipeline and raising the talent bar across the organization.
  • Shape our engineering strategy. Partner with Product and business leaders to translate company priorities into a clear technical strategy and engineering roadmap.
  • Drive execution at scale. Ensure teams consistently deliver high-impact products while balancing speed, quality, reliability, and long-term technical investments.
  • Raise the technical bar. Provide leadership across architecture, scalability, reliability, security, observability, and engineering practices. You won't need to be the primary individual contributor, but you should be technically deep enough to challenge assumptions and earn the trust of senior engineers.
  • Build for fintech-grade reliability. Ensure our systems meet the security, availability, data integrity, and auditability expectations of a financial technology platform.
  • Be at the cutting edge of AI-native. Identify and drive opportunities to leverage AI across our products and engineering workflows. Help establish strong practices around AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, reliability, and responsible deployment.
  • Partner across the business. Work closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to make thoughtful decisions and translate technical trade-offs into clear business implications.
  • Build for the next stage of growth. Anticipate technical and organizational bottlenecks and evolve our architecture, processes, and team structure before they become constraints.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience and systems thinking, with significant experience building and operating complex production systems.
  • 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, ideally recruiting and leading multiple teams in parallel.
  • Proven experience building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations in fast-growing technology companies.
  • Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, cloud architectures, APIs, microservices, data systems, and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience designing and operating high-scale, highly available systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and engineering best practices translated to an AI-first approach.
  • Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to attract, coach, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, make thoughtful trade-offs, and adapt quickly as priorities evolve.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Our current technology ecosystem includes Java/Spring Boot, React, relational and NoSQL databases, Kafka, REST APIs, AWS, Git/GitHub, and modern CI/CD tooling. You don't need to be an expert in every technology—we care more about your ability to lead teams building complex systems and make excellent technical decisions.

AI experience

You don't need to be an ML researcher, but you should understand how modern AI can be translated into reliable products and meaningful engineering leverage.

Experience with LLMs, AI-powered products, agentic systems, AI evaluation, guardrails, or AI-assisted engineering workflows is highly valuable.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, cards, expense management, or financial infrastructure.
  • Experience building technology in regulated environments.
  • Experience scaling engineering organizations through periods of rapid growth.
  • Experience building or operating AI/ML-enabled products or platforms.
  • Experience with fraud, risk, credit, decisioning, or automation systems.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese proficiency.

Why this role matters

Engineering is at the core of how we build and scale our business.

As Engineering Director, you will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology, but also how our engineering organization operates, how we develop our people, and how we use AI to build better products and move faster.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of our growth and help build the technology and engineering organization that will take us there.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

  • Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.

  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one

  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara’s Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

title: Full Time Floor Leader - West Edmonton Mall
description:
Position: Full Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 30-39 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!
  • Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.
  • Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

  • Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

  • Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.
  • Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.
  • Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.
  • Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.
  • Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in:
    • customer service and sales
    • cash handling and opening/closing procedures
    • supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training
    • problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations
    • a fast-paced team environment
  • Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

  • Experience with consultation-based customer service models
  • Experience analyzing sales metrics
  • Experience working in skincare or cosmetics
  • Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training
  • Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

title: Associate, Corporate Development and Private Equity
description:
Forum Asset Management – Associate, Corporate Development and Private Equity


Location: In-Office, 181 Bay Street, Toronto


Work Schedule: Full-time, in-office (5 days/week)


About Forum:

Delivering Extraordinary Outcomes™ through Investment.

Forum Asset Management is a North American investor, developer, and asset manager with a 30+ year track record of delivering long-term value through real estate, private equity, and infrastructure investments. We are a purpose-driven firm committed to sustainability, responsible investing, and making a positive impact in the communities where we invest.

With over $4 billion in AUM, Forum is one of Canada's most dynamic investment platforms. In 2024, we completed the country’s largest real estate transaction through our acquisition of Alignvest Student Housing, making us the largest owner and developer of Purpose-Built Student Accommodations (PBSA) in Canada. Our open-ended Real Estate Income and Impact Fund (REIIF) is now over $2.9 billion, backed by a $4.0 billion+ development pipeline that spans coast to coast.

Forum is also building one of the fastest-growing self-storage platforms in Canada, focused on acquiring, developing, and operating institutional-grade storage facilities in undersupplied urban markets.


Forum’s private equity strategy invests in middle market businesses providing essential services in the built environment. We partner with entrepreneurs and owner-operators looking to accelerate growth and value creation. Our current portfolio includes six investments generating over $250 million of revenue. Our operating businesses today cover HVAC and plumbing services, out of home media, geothermal exchange heating and cooling, retail energy and residential solar.


Forum is a values-led, high-performance organization. We embrace agility and innovation, and we strive to foster a team culture grounded in integrity, collaboration, humility, and results. Our growth is fueled by our ability to identify structural real estate themes and deliver strategies that balance income, impact, and long-term value creation.


Position Overview:

Forum Asset Management is seeking an Associate, Corporate Development and Private Equity to originate, execute and manage investments alongside senior members of the team, reporting to the Managing Partner, Corporate Development and Private Equity. Based in our Toronto office, this role will be a key member of the Corporate Development and Private Equity team and will contribute to driving investment performance across Forum’s corporate development and private equity strategies.

This is a high-impact role within a growing corporate development and private equity group, working directly alongside senior deal team members to originate, structure, execute and manage investments. The Associate will build and maintain complex financial models, lead diligence workstreams and help shape recommendations that go directly to Forum's Investment Committee. This is an excellent opportunity for a high-performing, AI-native individual to gain hands-on experience with a top-tier investment platform that is scaling fast and building the infrastructure to match. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Forum.


Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Play an active role in growing Forum's corporate development and private equity platforms, including emerging verticals such as self-storage
  • Support deal teams in generating, evaluating, structuring and executing investments
  • Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to support investment evaluation, structuring, financing and performance measurement
  • Conduct comparable company, precedent transaction, discounted cash flow and other valuation analyses

title: Senior Product Manager, Analytics Features
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Analytics Features based in Netherlands.

This is a senior product leadership opportunity focused on building analytics products that help app businesses make better monetization decisions.
You will own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for a suite of analytics capabilities, including dashboards, charts, benchmarking, and predictive LTV.
The role combines product strategy with deep analytical and technical problem-solving in a highly data-driven environment.
You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to turn complex data into actionable customer insights.
You will also investigate data issues, develop meaningful metrics and benchmarks, and identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
The position offers significant autonomy, with responsibility for making product decisions, experimenting rapidly, and delivering measurable business impact.
You will join a fully remote, international environment where ownership, customer focus, systems thinking, and a strong bias toward shipping are highly valued.

Accountabilities

  • Own the product strategy, vision, roadmap, and prioritization for the analytics product portfolio, ensuring initiatives are cohesive, scalable, and aligned with broader product objectives.
  • Lead the development and evolution of analytics capabilities, including charts, dashboards, benchmarking, metrics, and predictive lifetime value features.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their needs, investigate complex analytics and data problems, distinguish meaningful signals from noise, and translate insights into impactful product opportunities.
  • Develop, recommend, and maintain benchmarks and metrics that help app developers understand performance, identify opportunities, and improve monetization.
  • Act as a key point of expertise when data or metrics appear incorrect, investigating underlying causes and edge cases rather than relying solely on engineering teams.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to evaluate feasibility, define solutions, and bring robust analytics and experimentation capabilities to market.
  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, breaking complex initiatives into meaningful deliverables and realistic timelines.
  • Drive product discovery, experimentation, and delivery while balancing quality, customer value, technical complexity, and speed of execution.
  • Independently make product decisions within your area, contribute to broader product strategy, and identify new opportunities to create customer and business value.
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and help teams develop deeper customer empathy and understanding of industry trends.
  • Continuously evaluate product performance and be willing to discontinue or rethink initiatives when evidence shows they are not delivering the expected value.
  • During the first year, establish ownership of your product area, deliver meaningful customer impact, develop a longer-term product vision, and contribute to the evolution of the overall product strategy.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, with significant experience delivering complex products from concept through launch.
    • Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience working with data; proficiency in SQL or comparable data tools and the ability to independently investigate data and develop robust, scalable metrics.
    • Strong technical understanding, including the ability to work effectively with APIs, data models, system architecture, and complex technical constraints. Coding is not a core requirement, but the ability to prototype using code and modern AI-assisted tools is expected.
    • Experience working closely with highly technical engineering and data teams and the ability to understand and communicate complex technical trade-offs.
    • Strong understanding of analytics products, data visualization, metrics, experimentation, and how data can be translated into actionable insights.
    • A strong customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and turn feedback into scalable product solutions.
    • Understanding of the mobile app ecosystem, app-business economics, monetization, and the factors that define success for app developers.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly and concisely across different communication formats, teams, and time zones.
    • Strong ownership mentality, initiative, and willingness to investigate problems directly and take responsibility for outcomes.
    • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments where decisions often need to be made with incomplete information.
    • Systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to move beyond individual customer requests and design solutions that scale across products and users.
    • Strong attention to product and user experience details, including a passion for high-quality data visualization and the ability to connect visual presentation with meaningful insights.
    • Pragmatic approach to product development, balancing a high standard of quality with a strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and iteration.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, international environment and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple time zones.

      • Benefits:

      • $207,000 USD annual salary for the role.
      • Competitive equity package within a fast-growing Series C startup environment.
      • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options.
      • Fully remote work environment designed around autonomy and flexibility.
      • 4–5 weeks of flexible time off annually.
      • Paid coworking space/desk.
      • Dedicated workspace budget.
      • Continuous learning and professional development stipend.
      • Opportunity to work on analytics products operating at significant scale and influencing how app businesses understand and grow their revenue.

At Morin Supply, we aim to be the easiest building supply company to deal with.

  • Unload incoming merchandise and ensures that merchandise receives matches orders and put in the designated area.

  • High School diploma or general education degree (GED)

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to reach overhead to grasp and handle materials.

Working Conditions

  • Work outside in temperatures ranging from extreme heat to extreme cold.

title: HubSpot CRM Champion (Clark On-site, Dayshift)
description:
About Shore360:

﻿Shore360 is a 100% Australian-owned BP firm based in the Philippines, providing customized staffing and administrative support for international companies, handling recruitment, HR, IT, and office facilities so clients can focus on core business, offering transparent pricing, dedicated teams, and flexible setups.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic CRM Champion to lead the implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of our CRM platform across multiple businesses.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the CRM is effectively structured, adopted, and utilized across the organization. The successful candidate will work closely with leadership and a team of approximately 20 users across three businesses to establish efficient CRM processes, improve data quality, drive user adoption, and ensure the platform supports business and operational objectives.

HubSpot experience is highly preferred, although candidates with strong experience implementing and managing other leading CRM platforms will also be considered.

The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on — someone who can build and configure a CRM environment, develop practical processes and workflows, and confidently guide and manage users to ensure the system is being used correctly and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:

CRM Implementation & Configuration

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and optimization of the CRM platform.
  • Assess existing processes and translate business requirements into effective CRM workflows.
  • Design CRM structures, pipelines, properties, automations, dashboards, and reporting.
  • Ensure the CRM is scalable and aligned with the needs of multiple businesses.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes through CRM automation and integration.

CRM Management & Optimization

  • Act as the primary CRM subject matter expert and internal champion.
  • Monitor CRM usage, data quality, processes, and overall system performance.
  • Establish and maintain CRM standards, processes, and governance.
  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements to maximize CRM functionality.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues and coordinate with relevant technical support when required.
  • Maintain accurate and consistent CRM data across the organization.

User Management & Training

  • Manage and support approximately 20 CRM users across three businesses.
  • Train users on CRM functionality, processes, workflows, and best practices.
  • Develop practical guidelines and documentation to support consistent CRM usage.
  • Monitor user adoption and address gaps in compliance or system utilization.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support to ensure users are confident and effective in using the CRM.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop dashboards and reports to provide visibility into business and CRM performance.
  • Analyze CRM data and usage trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work with leadership to establish CRM KPIs and reporting requirements.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve CRM processes, workflows, and user experience.

Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in CRM implementation, administration, optimization, or consulting.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully implementing and managing a CRM platform.
