title: Admissions Coordinator - SNF (55334)
location: Operations and Resource Center - Woods Cross, UT 84010
description:
Admissions Coordinator

Job Description

Department

Administration

Reports to

Administrator

Reporting to this position

N/A

Job Classification

Administrative

Position Purpose

Completes day to day tasks regarding admission, discharge, and/or transfer of residents in accordance with local, state and federal standards and regulations, as well as established facility policies and procedures.

Required Qualifications

  1. Demonstrates an understanding of arithmetic.
  2. Must have, as a minimum, one (1) year of experience with demonstrated success in a position in the facility or in another related health care facility.
  3. Knowledgeable of insurance coverage and authorization process pertaining to long-term care is helpful.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Participates in an open and collaborative relationship between the business office and the admissions office, both working toward shared facility goals for occupancy and collections.

Performs duties daily in the admissions office as assigned by the Admissions Director to facilitate the conversion of referrals to admission status.

Knows at all times, the status of each referral.

Communicates with external team members regarding referral status and any additional information needed to assist with the admission decision.

Communicates daily with the Business Office to complete financial evaluations for potential residents and payment options including but not limited to printing of the Common Working File, printing Medicaid Eligibility, and identifying the pay status with the resident/representative prior to admitting the resident.

Knows, at all times, which payment entities require prior authorization for payment and secures prior authorization when required.

Maintains working knowledge of facility’s practices related to all pay status types such as other insurances, Medicare A, Medicaid, Private, Veteran’s Administration contracts, and hospital contracts, etc.

May at times be required to complete mental health screenings as required by federal and state regulations prior to admission.

Assists with processing referrals timely on a daily basis as assigned by the Admissions Director.

Ensures residents are admitted, transferred and discharged from the facility software accurately on a daily basis.

Records resident pay status changes on the facility’s internal daily census communication tool.

Records resident pay status accurately in the resident’s record at time of admission.

Behaves in a manner aligned with facility goals for occupancy and customer service.

Meets with potential residents/representatives daily and provides information about the facility.

Provides tours of the facility daily, and as requested by potential residents/representatives.

Works in a helpful and pleasant manner, daily using the telephone to communicate with families, residents, hospitals, insurance companies, etc. related to processing referrals.

Works numerous times a day using a computer, electronic medical record, spreadsheets, and other tools related to processing referrals.

Completes admission paperwork and files according to facility policy.

Informs the Admissions Director of obstacles or barriers to admitting residents.

Maintains daily referral tracking information as assigned by the Admissions Director.

Communicates with interdisciplinary team members timely regarding room assignments for pending admissions.

Demonstrates interpersonal relationship skills by developing and maintaining trust with coworkers.

Completes the daily census.

Participates in facility assessment activities as needed, such as carrying out duties assigned as part of a performance improvement committee.

Collaborates with members of the interdisciplinary team, family members, hospitals and community, etc. in a manner that resolves issues and improves the admissions process.

Promotes teamwork, mutual respect, and effective communication.

Participates in the facility’s plan of correction response to an inspection survey and implements any follow-up as designated by the Admissions Director.

Promotes safe work practices, safety rules, and accident prevention procedures to prevent employee injury and illness.

Additional Tasks

  1. Treats all residents with dignity and respect. Promotes and protects all residents’ rights.
  2. Establishes a culture of compliance by adhering to all facility policies and procedures. Complies with standards of business conduct, and state/federal regulations and guidelines.
  3. Follows appropriate safety and hygiene measures at all times to protect residents and themselves.
  4. Maintains confidentiality of protected health information, including verbal, written, and electronic communications.
  5. Reports noncompliance with policies, procedures, regulations, or breaches in confidentiality to appropriate personnel. Reports any retaliation or discrimination to HR or compliance officer.
  6. Reports any allegations of abuse, neglect, misappropriation of property, exploitation, or mistreatment of residents to supervisor and/or administrator. Protects residents from abuse, and cooperates with all investigations.
  7. Reports any occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and/or hazardous chemicals in accordance with facility policy.
  8. Participates in all life safety and emergency drills and trainings. Fulfills responsibilities as assigned during implementation or activation of the facility’s emergency plan.
  9. Reports work-related injuries and illnesses immediately to supervisor.
  10. As a condition of employment, completes all assigned training and skills competency.
  11. Follows established infection control policies and procedures.

Personal Skills and Traits Desired/ Physical Requirements/Working Conditions

  1. Ability to read, write, speak and understand the English language.
  2. Must be a supportive team member, contribute to and be an example of team work.
  3. Ability to make independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action.
  4. Ability to deal tactfully with personnel, residents, family members, visitors, government agencies/personnel and the general public.
  5. Must have patience, tact, and willingness to deal with difficult residents, family and staff.
  6. Must be able to relay information concerning a resident’s condition.
  7. Must not pose a threat to the health and safety of other individuals in the workplace.
  8. Must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday.
  9. Meets general health requirements according to facility policy, including medical and physical exams and checking immunity status to various infectious diseases.
  10. Ability to work beyond normal working hours and on weekends and holidays when necessary.
  11. Ability to assist in evacuation of residents during emergency situations.
  12. Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, perform overhead lifting and perform other common physical movements as needed for the position.
  13. May be subject to falls, burns from equipment, and/or odors throughout the day; encounter reactions from dust, tobacco smoke, disinfectants, and other air contaminants.
  14. Subject to exposure to infectious waste, diseases and/or conditions which include AIDS, Coronavirus, Hepatitis B, and Tuberculosis.
  15. May be subject to hostile or emotional residents, family members, visitors or personnel.
  16. Works in office and throughout the facility.
  17. Willing to work to task completion in spite of frequent interruptions.
  18. Subject to hostile and emotionally upset residents, family member, personnel and visitors.
  19. Works beyond normal working hours and on weekends, holidays when necessary. On call 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

Compliance as a Condition of Employment and Performance Appraisal

Agreement to abide by all standards, policies, and procedures of the facility, including the facility’s compliance and ethics program, is a condition of employment. Compliance will be a factor in evaluating job performance. Violations, including failure to report violations, will result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

This job description is intended to convey the general scope of the major duties and responsibilities inherent in this position. Other tasks not listed here may be assigned by the Administrator. Periodic revision may be necessary to reflect changes in expectations placed on long term care by various governmental agencies. This job description will be reviewed and/or revised annually and as needed.

Individual performance will be evaluated using the following scale:

title: Study Grant Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Study Grant Analyst II based in India.

As a Study Grant Analyst II, you will play a key role in developing accurate, competitive clinical study grants across Phases I–IV and a broad range of therapeutic areas. You will collaborate closely with proposal teams, site contracts leaders, study leaders, project directors, and clients to build effective budget strategies. The role combines financial analysis, clinical research knowledge, compliance, stakeholder management, and client advisory skills. You will contribute to both pre-award proposals and post-award budget activities while ensuring adherence to fair market value principles. You will also help identify process improvements, support training initiatives, and share expertise across the team. This is an opportunity to work in a collaborative, virtual environment where your analysis directly supports the successful delivery of clinical research programs.

Accountabilities:

  • Prepare accurate and competitive clinical study grant estimates for Phases I–IV using appropriate clinical study pricing tools, including GrantPlan or similar platforms.
  • Collaborate with proposal teams to develop competitive budget concepts while ensuring alignment with RFP requirements and internal policies.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for the creation, revision, escalation, and approval of clinical study grants for awarded projects.
  • Partner with site contracts leaders, study project leaders, project directors, and other stakeholders on grant development and post-award analyses.
  • Participate in strategy sessions and budget reviews to identify client needs, assess market and competitor benchmarks, and support proposal strategies.
  • Ensure grant information and analyses comply with Fair Market Value principles and applicable healthcare compliance requirements, including the Physician Payments Sunshine Act, HIPAA, FCPA, and Safe Harbor guidance.
  • Maintain client-focused grant analyses, monitor performance, proactively identify issues, and support resolution activities.
  • Share knowledge, lessons learned, and new scenarios with colleagues while contributing to departmental training plans, content, and delivery.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable ICH Guidelines, Good Clinical Practices, regulatory requirements, and relevant internal procedures.
  • Participate in system improvements, standards initiatives, committees, task forces, and change management activities.
  • Maintain agreed productivity and billability levels while completing administrative responsibilities such as timesheets, training, expenses, and travel requirements.
  • Promote a collaborative, results-oriented environment and contribute to continuous improvement based on client, team, and quality-audit feedback.

    • Requirements

    • 3–5 years of professional experience in clinical site budget development or a similar role within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, managed care, or clinical research industry.
    • Hands-on experience with GrantPlan, Grant Manager, or comparable clinical study budgeting tools.
    • Experience using industry benchmarking databases and tools to support fair market value assessments and investigator grant development.
    • Degree-level education in biological sciences, pharmacy, another health-related discipline, or an equivalent nursing or relevant clinical qualification.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, strategic thinking, and decision-making abilities, particularly when working through complex situations.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, influencing, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Strong client focus, with the ability to establish trust, provide informed guidance, and contribute to client decision-making.
    • Ability to work independently, assess organizational implications, resolve issues, and appropriately escalate matters when senior management involvement is required.
    • Familiarity with standard business and eClinical systems used within clinical research.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to learn and become proficient in additional systems.
    • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, attention to detail, and enthusiasm.
    • Comfortable working effectively within a virtual, cross-functional, and geographically distributed team.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time opportunity based in India with a remote work setup.
      • Opportunity to contribute to clinical research programs that support the development of new healthcare therapies.
      • Exposure to global clients, cross-functional teams, and diverse clinical research projects.
      • Opportunities to develop expertise in clinical study budgeting, fair market value, compliance, and commercial strategy.
      • Collaborative environment with opportunities for knowledge sharing, training, and professional development.
      • Involvement in process improvement, innovation, and cross-functional initiatives.
      • Potential travel opportunities based on business and project needs.

This is a hands-on, technically deep position suited to someone who enjoys designing robust systems, strengthening security and ensuring technology enables great frontline and guest experiences.

Operating within a 7-day, revenue-critical attraction environment, this role goes beyond day-to-day systems administration. You will be accountable for how our systems are designed, integrated, secured and improved over time, ensuring our technology environment remains resilient, scalable and practical for our operations.

Looking for a tree change? This role is based full-time onsite at Scenic World in Katoomba, in the heart of the Blue Mountains. Please note, this is not a hybrid role.


Reporting to the Head of IT, the Systems Administrator is responsible for engineering & continuously improving Scenic World’s core platforms, infrastructure, identity services & security controls. You will work closely with stakeholders across the business & IT teams within the broader group to ensure systems support operational uptime, security & future growth.

Key focus areas include Microsoft 365, identity & access management, endpoint security, networking, backup & disaster recovery & security framework alignment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Engineer, manage, and continuously improve core technology platforms including:
    • Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams)
    • Endpoint management, patching, and device security
    • Backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions
  • Design systems that are secure by default, resilient, and aligned to operational realities.
  • Engineer and maintain identity and access controls, including:
    • User lifecycle automation
    • Privileged access models
    • Guest and cross‑tenant access (where applicable)
  • Design and implement security controls aligned to recognised frameworks (e.g. Essential 8, ISO 27001).
  • Analyse vulnerabilities and engineer remediation strategies.
  • Act as a key contributor during security incidents, investigations, and post‑incident improvements.
  • Engineer and support network environments for:
    • Corporate users
    • Operational systems (POS, CCTV, access control)
    • Guest and event connectivity
  • Develop and maintain technical standards, system documentation, and runbooks.
  • Support audits through strong system design, documentation, and evidence.
  • Assist the Head of IT with software and hardware roadmaps aligned to business needs and asset renewal.
  • Collaborate with IT teams across group businesses and support group‑level IT initiatives as required.
  • Actively contribute to a positive, collaborative work culture.
  • Participate in ongoing technical, cultural, and business development.

About You

You are a confident Systems Administrator who enjoys designing, improving and evolving platforms, rather than simply maintaining them. You bring a security-first mindset, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across complex and evolving environments.

Essential experience & skills:

  • Demonstrated experience in a Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer or similar role.
  • Strong hands-on experience engineering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments.
  • Proven ability to design, secure and continually improve identity and endpoint platforms.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and security controls.
  • Experience working in environments where uptime and security have a direct business impact.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable:

  • Experience in hospitality, attractions, retail or other operationally intensive environments.
  • Exposure to security frameworks such as Essential 8 or ISO 27001.
  • Experience in hybrid AD environments.
  • Experience with backup, disaster recovery and incident response engineering.
  • Project management experience.
  • Relevant Microsoft, security or infrastructure certifications.
Life at Scenic World

Ready for a tree change? Where in the world? Scenic World!

At Scenic World, our values sit at the core of everything we do. We value team members who are self-motivated, collaborative and committed to continuous improvement.

You will join a passionate team working in a truly unique environment in the heart of the Blue Mountains, where technology plays a critical role in both operational success and the experience we deliver to our guests.

For someone looking to swap the daily city commute for a tree change, this is an opportunity to build your career while working onsite in one of Australia’s most spectacular locations. Your work will have a real impact, ensuring our systems remain reliable, secure and fit for purpose across a busy, 7-day tourism operation.

Please note, this position is based full-time onsite at Scenic World in Katoomba and is not a hybrid role.

We will not be engaging with external recruiters for this role.

title: Head Energy Regulatory Compliance
location: George Town, Cayman Islands, Cayman Islands
description:
ABOUT US

The Utility Regulation and Competition Office (“URCO” or “Office”) is an independent, multi-sector regulatory body responsible for regulating information and communications technology, energy and electricity, water, and fuels in the Cayman Islands.

Our mandate is to protect consumers, ensure fair competition, and promote innovation, investment, and development in all regulated sectors.

The sectors are regulated by the Utility Regulation and Competition Act (URCA) and the sector-specific acts and regulations.

Overview:

The Cayman Islands Utility Regulatory and Competition Office (the Office) is committed to regulating and overseeing the energy sector to ensure its sustainable, efficient, and equitable operation. The Head of Regulatory Compliance plays a central role in driving compliance with statutory requirements, safeguarding industry standards, and promoting a competitive energy landscape.

Job Purpose:

The Head of Regulatory Compliance (Energy) position leads the regulatory compliance function for the energy sector, ensuring licensee adherence to statutory requirements and regulatory frameworks in the Cayman Islands. Working closely with the Executive Director, Energy (EDE), the Head of Regulatory Compliance will ensure licensed entities operate within the regulatory boundaries while fostering innovation and growth in the energy market.

Scope of Role:

Accountable for the oversight and enforcement of compliance for regulatory compliance matters, liaising with licensed entities, government agencies, and the public.

Responsible for regulatory compliance outcomes for energy sector entities.

Collaborates with the Executive Director, Energy (EDE) and other stakeholders to inform policies and practices that align with national goals.

Supervises two Energy Analysts, ensuring their professional growth and operational effectiveness.

Principal Accountabilities

Assignment And Planning of Work

The post holder plans and schedules work in accordance with Office procedures, established protocols, activity timetables, and deadlines set with the EDE. They develop and maintain the team’s work plan, assigning tasks to Regulatory Analysts based on expertise, workload, and operational priorities to ensure efficient use of resources.

Work planning may require coordination with other agencies and must adapt to shifting priorities, urgent matters, and emergencies. The role requires sound judgement to ensure tasks are planned and executed efficiently.

Working Conditions

Primarily office-based with standard hours (8:30 AM – 5:00 PM). Occasional flexibility required. Ergonomic workstation provided; hybrid work options may be considered.

The post holder may be required to make occasional site visits to importer terminals and retail facilities.

The post holder may be required to travel on behalf of and to represent the Office internationally.

Supervisory Responsibilities & Key Working Relationships

The post holder is responsible for managing three (3) staff. The post-holder will maintain daily working relationships with Senior Managers and all employees, interns, and consultants of the Office. Additionally, they will be directly responsible for fostering positive business relations with all licensees, as well as with the Central Government, other authorities and government companies.

Decision-Making Authority and Controls

The post-holder works in an environment where rules and regulations are well-documented and clearly understood. If any issues arise due to discrepancies or situations that fall outside of the established policies or procedures, the post-holder will refer these matters to the EDE.

Person Specification

Education

A bachelor's degree in law, Business Administration, Energy Management, or a related field is required.

A master’s degree in one of the areas is strongly preferred and considered an asset.

Professional Experience:

Minimum 7 years of experience in regulatory compliance, energy sector management, or a related field.

Demonstrated leadership experience, particularly in supervising and mentoring teams.

Proven track record in regulatory audits, licensing processes, and enforcement actions.

Knowledge

Comprehensive knowledge of the Cayman Islands Utility Regulation and Competition Act (URC Act) and associated energy sector legislation.

Strong understanding of the regulatory and compliance standards governing the energy industry.

Familiarity with international energy market trends, best practices, and emerging technologies.

Expertise in risk management and mitigation strategies within regulatory environments.

Knowledge of compliance management software and tools.

Knowledge of the supply and distribution of energy, employed through the three Islands.

Skills and Competencies

Exceptional analytical skills with keen attention to detail.

Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.

Proficient in compliance-related systems and software.

Ability to lead, collaborate, and work effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.

How to apply


All applications must include the following: (1) a cover letter, (2) curriculum vitae, (3) application form, (4) two professional character references. Incomplete applications, including those missing required supporting documents, will not be considered.

A detailed job description, application form and application notes are available online at: www.ofreg.ky/job-opportunities

A resume, application form and cover letter should be sent to: https://ofreg.bamboohr.com/jobs

Please submit application form together with your resume as one (1) PDF.

Preference will be given to suitably qualified and experienced Caymanians or legal residents.

title: Director, Sports Medicine
description:
The Role

The Director of Sports Medicine leads league-wide sports medicine administration, medical operations, and the implementation of policies and programs that support player health and safety across the League and its member clubs. This role helps ensure consistent implementation of league operating manuals including the Medical Manual, league policies, workers compensation and insurance processes, and the NWSL Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA).

As an integral member of the Sporting team, the Director will work with League Medical consultants including the Chief Medical Officer (CMO), club medical staff, the NWSL Players Association (NWSLPA), U.S. Soccer, relevant competition organizers, and medical and professional organizations. The Director serves as a key operational leader between the league office and the delivery of medical care at the Club level. The role emphasizes strong leadership, subject matter expertise, and sound judgement and communication skills across a varied and broad ecosystem.



What You Will Own, Drive, & Contribute To

League Medical Manual, CBA Compliance and Related Medical Policies

  • Lead the development, annual review, implementation and administration of the NWSL Medical Manual and related medical policies and protocols.
  • Oversee the implementation of and compliance with the NWSL/NWSLPA CBA medical provisions, including requirements related to healthcare delivery, player medical rights including second-opinion, and mental health support.
  • Oversee administration and management of the NWSL Concussion Protocol and Medical Spotter Review (MSR) system, including case review, documentation, follow-up and identification of opportunities for education and quality improvement.
  • Support league-wide efforts as they relate to the inclusion of policies and practice regarding performance and female-specific health needs including reproductive and menstrual health, pregnancy, lactation, and postpartum return-to-participation.

League-Wide Injury and Illness Reporting and Surveillance

  • Contribute to League-wide injury and illness reporting and surveillance operations, including mandatory documentation requirements and data-quality standards for the Club electronic medical record (EMR) system.
  • Work with Club medical staffs and relevant League partners to improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency and timeliness of medical and injury- surveillance data.

Workers Compensation and Insurance

  • Manage the operational aspects of the League’s workers compensation and medical insurance programs as they relate to Player injuries and medical care.
  • Develop and maintain clear processes, protocols, and workflows to facilitate timely and consistent case management.
  • Collaborate and communicate with claims administrators, insurers, League officials, Clubs, medical providers, and other stakeholders to identify and resolve operational issues and improve efficiency and consistency across the League.

NWSL Club Medical Oversight, Readiness and Support

  • Serve as the primary League office resource for Club sports medicine staff, promoting consistency in League medical standards while supporting effective local implementation.
  • Facilitate communication, education, and sharing of best practices among Club team physicians, athletic trainers, physical therapists, licensed mental health professionals, and other members of the multidisciplinary medical team, including monthly Executive Medical Advisory Team (EMAT) meetings.
  • Support quality-assurance and continuous-improvement initiatives related to League and Club medical operations.
  • Lead the development, revision, review and oversight of the Pre Competition Medical Assessment (PCMA) and related Club medical-readiness.
  • Conduct end-of-season medical and operational reviews with Clubs including oversight of exit physicals, and identify opportunities for system-wide improvement.
  • Establish and maintain League medical standards for Match Venue and Practice Facility Emergency Action Plans (EAPs) and support Clubs in implementation, review and readiness.

NWSL League Medical Operations Support

  • Lead and coordinate medical planning, logistics, programming, and venue medical standards for the NWSL Championship, Combine, Annual Medical Meeting & Symposium, and other relevant league-owned competitions and events.
  • Support medical planning and response for emerging and/or emergent player-health and competition-related issues as needed.


What You Will Bring

Core Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in elite sports medicine administration, including administrative and operational responsibility within professional sports and/or NCAA Division I athletics.
  • Significant experience with sideline and competition management and medical operations.
  • Strong working knowledge of FIFA and US Soccer medical protocols and standards relevant to professional soccer.
  • Experience working within a unionized professional sports environment.
  • Working knowledge of workers’ compensation practice and protocol.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with EMR systems, injury and illness classification, surveillance platforms, and other medical data-quality processes.
  • Experience developing, implementing and evaluating medical policies, protocols, and operational standards.
  • Strong organizational, communication and project-management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage complex and sensitive medical and operational matters.
  • Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality, medical ethics, and appropriate protection of health information.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional qualification/s and current certification/licensure in Athletic Training (LAT/ATC) and/or Physical Therapy (DPT/PT) .
  • Experience in women’s soccer, at the collegiate, professional, or national/ international level.
  • Experience with sports medicine research particularly in athlete health and performance.




Our Investment in You

In addition to working in an incredible, inclusive, and committed-to-diversity culture, we offer:

  • Competitive Compensation: $125,000 - $155,000 (Salary is contingent upon candidate qualifications and functional business needs).
  • Time & Flexibility: Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), sick days, and an end-of-year office closure.
  • Hybrid Work Model: Three days in-office and two remote days per week.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning (Consumer Revenue)
location: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (U.S.)
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking to hire a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on our Consumer Revenue ML team. This team applies Machine Learning across Discord's core revenue surfaces — Shop, Nitro, Server Subscriptions, and Gifting — building the ranking, targeting, and recommendation systems that connect users to the right products, subscriptions, and content. If this excites you and you’ve led org-wide initiatives in the past, keep reading!

What You'll Be Doing

  • 8+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning, inclusive Ph.D. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Strong expertise in applied deep learning and mainstream RecSys model architecture (e.g. two-tower, transformer-based models, multi-task learning).
  • Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
  • A track record of building ML systems from 0→1 in ambiguous, early-stage environments, and taking them to production at scale.
  • Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to translate experiment results into roadmap decisions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills — able to lead cross-functional technical initiatives across multiple verticals and keep stakeholders educated and aligned.
  • The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, energized by open-ended, technically challenging problems.

What you should have

  • Built internal ML platform/tooling (shared data standards, targeting endpoints, recommender libraries) adopted by multiple product teams.
  • Familiarity with personalized marketing systems — lifecycle targeting, audience segmentation and lookalikes, campaign optimization.
  • Deep expertise in distributed training (e.g. PyTorch on GPU, Ray, Anyscale) and large-scale data processing pipelines (e.g. Chronon, Spark, Flink).

This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you're welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

title: Head of Technology and Projects
description:
H2R Technology is partnering with Cancer Society Wellington to appoint its first dedicated Head of Technology and Projects.

This is an opportunity to shape how technology supports an organisation with a clear purpose. From helping people access cancer support to improving fundraising systems and giving staff better information, your work will have a direct connection to the services the Cancer Society delivers.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive, you’ll bring together technology leadership, business systems ownership and project delivery. You’ll have the opportunity to establish a clear direction and personally lead the improvements that turn it into reality.

The opportunity

As a member of the Wellington Leadership Team, you’ll work closely with colleagues across cancer services, fundraising and corporate functions to understand their needs and prioritise investment.

With one direct report focused on data administration and reporting, alongside external technology partners, this is a broad role suited to someone who enjoys working closely with people and getting things done.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Developing a practical technology roadmap that connects organisational priorities with achievable improvements.
  • Leading technology and business improvement projects from planning and business cases through to implementation and staff adoption.
  • Improving fundraising and client management systems, data quality and reporting capability.
  • Guiding responsible AI adoption and strengthening information management practices.
  • Managing technology suppliers, budgets and service performance, with oversight of cybersecurity, resilience and technology risk.
  • Working with other Cancer Society divisions and National Office on shared systems and initiatives.
Early priorities include further development of the Connect with Ease programme, which aims to improve access to support through 0800 CANCER, alongside improvements to donor information, SharePoint and the organisation’s approach to AI.

About you

You’re a pragmatic technology leader who can set direction, explain decisions clearly and take ownership of delivery. You’re comfortable working in a small organisation where leadership involves both influencing others and personally moving projects forward.

Your experience will include:
  • Leading technology, information systems or technology-enabled business change.
  • Personally delivering projects through implementation and adoption.
  • Developing technology roadmaps and making sound investment decisions.
  • Managing outsourced technology services and supplier relationships.
  • Overseeing business applications, data and reporting, with a sound understanding of cybersecurity, privacy and information management.
You’ll build trust with colleagues who have different levels of technical confidence and collaborate effectively across a federated organisation. You’ll also bring a commitment to equity, Te Tiriti o Waitangi and inclusive leadership.

A tertiary qualification in Information Systems or a related discipline is required. Experience in the health or not-for-profit sector would be helpful.

Why join?

You’ll have direct access to the CEO, a voice in organisational decisions and the opportunity to establish technology priorities that improve how the Cancer Society supports its communities.

Based primarily in Newtown, Wellington, this is a permanent opportunity with a preference for 0.8 FTE. Full-time hours may be considered.

To apply, submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and interest in the role. For a confidential conversation, contact Alex Allan at H2R Technology on +64 (0)4 499 9471 or alex.allan@h2r.co.nz

title: Companion Animal Team Lead
description:
Ready to take the next step in your veterinary career?

Vet Services is looking for an experienced Companion Animal Veterinarian to join our expanding Hastings team in a full-time senior clinical and Team Lead role.

This is an opportunity to continue doing the clinical work you enjoy while taking on greater responsibility for clinical leadership, mentoring and developing others, and helping shape the future of our Companion Animal service.

Whether you’re an experienced Team Lead or a senior veterinarian ready for your first leadership role, we’re looking for someone with strong clinical capability, sound judgement and a genuine interest in supporting and developing others.

The opportunity

You’ll join an experienced and supportive team of veterinarians, nurses and support staff, with a varied caseload across consultations, internal medicine and surgery, including opportunities for soft-tissue and orthopaedic procedures.

As Team Lead, you’ll provide senior clinical guidance, mentor colleagues, support clinical decision-making and help build a positive, collaborative and high-performing team culture.

You’ll work alongside the Production and Equine Team Leads in Hastings and the wider Companion Animal leadership team across Vet Services, giving you the opportunity to bring your ideas, collaborate and help shape the future of our services.

We support our vets to develop their areas of interest, which currently include small mammals, birds and exotics, soft-tissue and orthopaedic surgery, acupuncture and rehabilitation, and ultrasonography.

About you

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has strong Companion Animal clinical and surgical skills
  • Enjoys mentoring, coaching and developing others
  • Communicates clearly, respectfully and confidently
  • Leads by example and contributes positively to team culture
  • Is confident making clinical decisions and supporting others with theirs
  • Values collaboration, professionalism and high standards of patient and client care
  • Is motivated to contribute to the ongoing development of our clinic and services

What we offer

We believe our people do their best work when they feel valued, supported and trusted. We’re a family-friendly clinic committed to genuine work-life balance and wellbeing.

You’ll enjoy:

  • Generous remuneration and a strong professional development package
  • Health insurance, birthday leave and long-service leave
  • Support to develop your areas of special interest
  • Collaboration and professional development opportunities across our wider veterinary group
  • A fantastic, loyal client base and strong community connections
  • Modern facilities and equipment, with our Hastings clinic currently undergoing a major renovation scheduled for completion in 2027
  • In-house blood and cytology analysers, DR digital technology, dental radiology, ultrasonography and endoscopy
  • Digital tools including AI-assisted clinical note taking and digital rostering

Our culture

At Vet Services Hawkes Bay, we believe a great workplace is about more than just the work we do. We value work-life balance, wellbeing, trust and a supportive team environment.

Our Wellness Committee provides regular wellness initiatives, social activities and team events, helping our people connect, celebrate and enjoy being part of the team.

About Vet Services

Vet Services is a locally owned veterinary business with four mixed-practice clinics across Hawke’s Bay and Dannevirke and more than 50 years of connection to our local communities.

We’re proud of our people, our clients and the relationships we’ve built within our communities.

title: Senior Substation Engineer
description:
About the Organization

E2 Consulting Engineers, LP (E2) is a professional services firm established in 1988 specializing in a full spectrum of engineering services including, project engineering and design, federal base operations and infrastructure support services, gas pipeline construction and inspection services, environmental consulting and remediation, and information technology services. At E2, we value safety, innovation and collaboration, and we are dedicated to excellence.

Overview

The selected candidate will be responsible for the design of deliverables associated with substation projects supporting one of our largest electric utility clients in Southern California. The substation Protection & Control design deliverables include one-line & three-line diagrams, AC & DC elementary & logic diagrams, front & rear panel elevations and wiring, supervisory & control drawings, electrical vendor equipment wiring diagrams, complete cable schedule and bill of materials. The substation physical design deliverables include general arrangement drawings, electrical equipment plan & elevation drawings, above & below grade conduit & grounding drawings, relay house layout and complete bill of materials. The successful candidate will report directly to the Substation Design Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Leads substation P&C and/or physical design, including the preparation of field notes, drawings, specifications, and estimates.
  • Performs careful QA/QC review activities submitted by junior engineers to ensure a quality product.
  • Prepares computer assisted design and construction drawings of a complex nature with neatness and a minimum of errors.
  • Perform engineering calculations such AC and DC load calculations required to properly size auxiliary systems.
  • Perform engineering calculations such as conduit and bus sizing, lighting & lightning analysis, and grounding grid analysis.
  • Ensure all designs conform to client and industry standards. • Communicate and coordinate project activities with project manager, client, and others as needed.
  • Utilize client and/or company information system to track and update design activities. • Attend job site meetings to gather scope of work.
  • May provide field support during construction.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

(Required)

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from an ABET approved college or university.
  • 10+ years of experience working in substation design or similar with utility or consulting engineering firm.
  • Proficient using Microsoft Office suite (e.g., Excel, Word, and Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Experience with AutoCAD and/or MicroStation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

(Preferred)

  • Professional Engineer’s License in Electrical Engineering preferred but not required.
  • Experience with substation design and construction standards for electric utilities in California is highly desirable.

E2 Consulting Engineers, LP offers an excellent benefits package including health, dental, vision, and life insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off.

Work Environment

  • Ability to sit/ stand for up to 8 hours per day.
  • Ability to move freely for up to 8 hours per day.

Local Candidates only

No

After accepting an offer of employment, applicants may be required to undergo background checks, drug testing, and/or fit-for-duty physical examination. title: MOPS Automation SW Dev Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a MOPS Automation SW Dev Engineer to develop, automate, and maintain the mission operations processes, tools, and procedures required for successful operation of the AST SpaceMobile satellite constellation. This role blends mission operations engineering with software-driven automation, with a strong emphasis on scripting satellite procedures, developing operational tooling, and enabling scalable, reliable constellation operations. This position plays a critical role in shaping how the Satellite Operations Center (SOC) functions day-to-day and evolves over the lifetime of the constellation, providing operational insight into system design while actively building the automation and procedures used on orbit.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and evolve mission operations processes and concepts of operations (ConOps) across all mission phases (LEOP, commissioning, routine operations).
  • Perform trade studies on Satellite Operations Center (SOC) software tools and operational architectures.
  • Support SOC system design, integration, and evolution with a focus on automation and scalability.
  • Configure, operate, and troubleshoot SOC operations tools and environments.
  • Develop, test, and validate satellite operations procedures, sequences of events, and command scripts used for on-orbit operations.
  • Script and automate satellite command and control procedures using languages such as Python (and similar scripting languages).
  • Develop telemetry validation logic and expected response checks to support both automated and manual operations.
  • Modify and improve procedures based on on-orbit performance and lessons learned.
  • Design, develop, and maintain custom mission operations tools and automation scripts.
  • Develop tooling and lightweight applications to support on-orbit operations, monitoring, and analysis.
  • Build or extend user interfaces, dashboards, or visualization tools that improve operator situational awareness.
  • Interface with internal and external APIs to integrate mission operations workflows.
  • Support system-level integration tests and end-to-end testing between the SOC and factory satellite.
  • Participate in mission readiness activities including operations tests, simulations, rehearsals, and dry runs.
  • Support mission operations during LEOP and other critical on-orbit activities, including possible periodic rotating shifts.
  • Work closely with systems engineers, flight software, ground software, and external vendors to develop operational products.
  • Support requirements development, architecture reviews, design reviews, readiness reviews, and program milestones.
  • Provide mentoring and technical guidance to mission operations team members.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Technology, or Math (STEM) field.

Experience:

  • 2-5+ years of relevant experience in mission operations, software development, or automation roles.
  • Experience scripting operational procedures or automation workflows using Python or similar languages.
  • Familiarity with satellite command and control operations and mission operations workflows.
  • Comfortable working in a Windows development and operations environment.
  • Experience working with applications deployed in AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Familiarity with the Atlassian tool suite (Jira, Confluence).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with multi-satellite LEO constellations.
  • Experience developing or operating automated mission operations systems.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, networking protocols, and API-based integrations.
  • Experience creating telemetry displays, monitoring dashboards, or operator UIs.
  • Basic experience with databases or data persistence for operational tooling.
  • Systems engineering experience or coursework (requirements, architecture, integration & test).
  • Experience supporting mission rehearsals, simulations, or critical on-orbit operations.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with evolving system requirements.
  • Self-starter who takes ownership and initiative.
  • Comfortable working to tight deadlines in high-stress operational environments.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with a remote, distributed, and cross-disciplinary team.
  • Strong operational mindset with a bias toward automation and reliability.

Technology Stack:

  • Python and similar scripting languages for satellite command and control automation.
  • Windows-based development and operations environments.
  • AWS or other cloud environments for deployed applications.
  • Git or other version control systems.
  • Atlassian tool suite (Jira, Confluence).
  • Telemetry validation, dashboard, and visualization tooling for operator situational awareness.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Ability to use a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to work in a standard office environment.
  • Ability to support periodic rotating shifts during LEOP and other critical on-orbit operations.

title: Foreman Comm Tech
description:
Overview

Function as a Foreman Comm Tech for Bergelectric Corp.; monitoring installations and ensuring work is performed according to Bergelectric Corp. standards and project specifications. Work cooperatively with the general contractor and/or customer in managing the project, project schedule and employees. Responsible for maintaining productivity, safety, quality control, labor cost, scheduling, movement of manpower, procurement of materials and any other activities impacting the successful completion of the project. This is considered to be a safety sensitive position.

Responsibilities

  • Achieve Bergelectric Corp. productivity objectives by effectively managing and assigning tasks to crew members, while maintaining an accurate labor tracking log.
  • Establish project goals and monitor success in reaching those objectives on an ongoing basis.
  • Manage purchase orders and ensure ordered materials are received while adhering to bulk buy material procedures.
  • Adhere to project contract document changes and Bergelectric Corp. change order notice-to-proceed policies.
  • Fully utilize a prefabrication facility and company-wide installation methods and policies.
  • Ensure the proper safety equipment, materials and tools are onsite to perform the required work.
  • Provident Superintendent(s) with sufficient notice of any crew changes.
  • Utilize a proactive approach to anticipate and resolve potential issues.
  • Ensure crew members start and finish work shift on time; Maintain proper meal/break times as per Employee Handbook and as legally required per local labor laws and regulations.
  • Conduct effective performance evaluations of crew members.
  • Maintain complete and accurate “as-builts” as per Bergelectric Corp. procedures and project requirements.
  • Communicate effectively with a wide range of individuals including project owners, architects, general contractors, management, crew members, etc.
  • Ensure all work performed meets with NEC, federal, state, county, local codes and contract documents.
  • Adhere to all Bergelectric Corp., state and federal safety policies and procedures.
  • Provide leadership in fostering a teamwork environment in all aspects of job responsibilities.
  • Monitor and focus on employee / crew morale to ensure positive outcomes of all situations.
  • Ensure compliance with all policies and procedures included in the Bergelectric Corp. Employee Handbook.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of two to four years of field experience working as a Journeyman Low Voltage Technician.
  • Must hold a current Voice, Data, Video Low Voltage Journeyman license (if required by the applicable state, city or county).
  • Strong knowledge in fiber, copper and various low voltage cabling, including terminations, splicing, testing and troubleshooting in telecommunications and tele data settings.
  • Fully knowledgeable in federal, state and local codes for OSP and ISP cabling installations.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively order and track materials, perform cost projections and develop “as builts”.
  • Strong, first-hand knowledge and experience related to scheduling, material lead times, product knowledge and installation durations.
  • Solid understanding of the electrical codes and installation methods.
  • Well-versed in the installation of power systems: lighting, fire protection, security and data networks.
  • Knowledgeable regarding the build, installation and maintenance of control panels.
  • Comfortable utilizing Electrical Single Line blueprints.
  • Experience in verifying the compliance and functionality of installations.
  • Knowledgeable in the identification and repair of faults in electrical apparatus and circuits.

Physical Demands

  • Lift 50 lbs. from the ground and pull 50 lbs. of force.
  • Perform ladder climbing, wire pulling and conduit pulling.
  • Fully squat, stoop or kneel while wearing a 25 lbs. tool belt.
  • Maintain a standing position for long periods of time while performing repetitive actions such as grasping or manipulating wires.

title: HR Systems Help Desk Team Lead
description:
We are seeking a Human Resources (HR) Systems Help Desk Team Lead to support the Laboratory’s multiyear transition from PeopleSoft to Oracle HCM Cloud. Reporting to HR Product Management Group, this role leads two help desk specialists and partners with HR, Payroll, IT, process owners, and change and training teams. The Team Lead will oversee support for Oracle HCM Cloud, PeopleSoft, SmartRecruiters, ServiceNow, and related applications; identify opportunities for system and process improvements; and help develop knowledge management, self-service, and responsible AI-enabled support. This role combines operational leadership with the opportunity to shape the future of HR technology service delivery.

You will

  • Lead, develop, and mentor Applications Help Desk Specialists by setting clear expectations and goals, providing ongoing coaching and feedback, and fostering an accountable, collaborative, customer-focused, and continuous-learning environment.
  • Oversee daily service operations, including workload, case routing, escalations, staffing coverage, and service-level performance, ensuring timely, consistency, and effective support in accordance with established service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-impact issues requiring advanced troubleshooting, cross-functional coordination, or in-depth knowledge of HR systems and processes.
  • Anticipate service needs, operational risks, and capacity challenges; advance service-management practices and ServiceNow capabilities that improve efficiency, consistency, support quality, develop practical response strategies with help desk stakeholders.
  • Establish and mature service-management practices within ServiceNow to improve efficiency, quality, consistency, user satisfaction, and operational supportability.
  • Partner with senior Laboratory managers, IT developers, business systems analysts, and system end users to resolve support issues spanning business functions and ensure application changes are operationally supportable.
  • Collaborate with HR BSAs, IT, and technology transformation teams to assess service trends, identify enhancements, support technology upgrades, address adoption barriers, and deliver targeted support for new tools and processes.
  • Ensure processes, procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles are accurate, current, accessible, and designed to support team effectiveness and intuitive employee and manager self-service.
  • Prepare and present regular performance reports and actionable insights to the Group Leader and stakeholders, communicating service outcomes, risks, improvement opportunities, and progress against action plans.
  • Explore, lead, or support pilots and evaluations of AI-enabled capabilities for case intake, triage, agent assistance, knowledge discovery, content maintenance, and user self-service.
  • Perform other duties as assigned
  • Bachelor’s Degree in related business field, or equivalent combination of technical training and education, or professional certification in business/computer relevant
  • Demonstrated success leading or coordinating HR technology support, HR service delivery, shared services, or a comparable customer-support function in a complex organization.
  • Outstanding customer-service and consultative skills, including active listening, thoughtful inquiry, sound judgment, and the ability to uncover underlying needs and recommend effective solutions beyond the initial request.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify patterns and root causes, develop meaningful performance measures, and translate findings into system, process, or user-experience improvements.
  • Experience establishing and maturing knowledge-management practices, including content development, governance, and digital self-service capabilities.
  • Ability to build and maintain productive cross functional partnerships to accomplish shared goals.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly, present insights, advise stakeholders, and influence decisions.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities in an environment of changing deadlines, priorities, and frequent interruptions.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve problems, exercise independent judgment, make sound decisions, and remain calm while using conflict-resolution techniques to de-escalate difficult situations.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity and change, balancing reliable day-to-day service delivery with longer-term transformation and capability building.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Experience leading and developing professionals while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team environment.
  • Experience supporting HR technology products, including Oracle HCM Cloud, Service Now, Smart Recruiters or comparable HCM cloud platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of service-management practices, including case management, SLAs, escalations, knowledge management, digital self-service, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience supporting HCM implementation, migration, major release, or stabilization effort, including change management, user adoption, training readiness, or release management.
  • Experience developing dashboards and using service data and analytics to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Experience with AI-enabled service delivery, including automation, virtual agents, or agent-assist tools.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Position Information

This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

  • Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
  • Flexible Benefits Package
  • 401(k)
  • Relocation Assistance
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
  • Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

This position requires either no security clearance, or a Department of Energy (DOE) L-level or Q-level clearance depending on the particular assignment.

If you are selected and a security clearance is required, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. L and Q-level clearances require U.S. citizenship.

If no security clearance is required, but your assignment is longer than 179 days cumulatively within a calendar year, you must go through the Personal Identity Verification process. This process includes completing an online background investigation form and receiving approval of the background check.

National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The 2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Section 3112, generally prohibits citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea without dual US citizenship or legal permanent residence from accessing specific non-public areas of national security or nuclear weapons facilities. The restrictions of NDAA Section 3112 apply to this position. To be qualified for this position, Candidates must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

title: Senior Product Manager, Analytics Features
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Analytics Features based in Germany.

This is a senior product leadership opportunity focused on building analytics products that help app businesses make better monetization decisions.
You will own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for a suite of analytics capabilities, including dashboards, charts, benchmarking, and predictive LTV.
The role combines product strategy with deep analytical and technical problem-solving in a highly data-driven environment.
You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to turn complex data into actionable customer insights.
You will also investigate data issues, develop meaningful metrics and benchmarks, and identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
The position offers significant autonomy, with responsibility for making product decisions, experimenting rapidly, and delivering measurable business impact.
You will join a fully remote, international environment where ownership, customer focus, systems thinking, and a strong bias toward shipping are highly valued.

Accountabilities

  • Own the product strategy, vision, roadmap, and prioritization for the analytics product portfolio, ensuring initiatives are cohesive, scalable, and aligned with broader product objectives.
  • Lead the development and evolution of analytics capabilities, including charts, dashboards, benchmarking, metrics, and predictive lifetime value features.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their needs, investigate complex analytics and data problems, distinguish meaningful signals from noise, and translate insights into impactful product opportunities.
  • Develop, recommend, and maintain benchmarks and metrics that help app developers understand performance, identify opportunities, and improve monetization.
  • Act as a key point of expertise when data or metrics appear incorrect, investigating underlying causes and edge cases rather than relying solely on engineering teams.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to evaluate feasibility, define solutions, and bring robust analytics and experimentation capabilities to market.
  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, breaking complex initiatives into meaningful deliverables and realistic timelines.
  • Drive product discovery, experimentation, and delivery while balancing quality, customer value, technical complexity, and speed of execution.
  • Independently make product decisions within your area, contribute to broader product strategy, and identify new opportunities to create customer and business value.
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and help teams develop deeper customer empathy and understanding of industry trends.
  • Continuously evaluate product performance and be willing to discontinue or rethink initiatives when evidence shows they are not delivering the expected value.
  • During the first year, establish ownership of your product area, deliver meaningful customer impact, develop a longer-term product vision, and contribute to the evolution of the overall product strategy.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, with significant experience delivering complex products from concept through launch.
    • Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience working with data; proficiency in SQL or comparable data tools and the ability to independently investigate data and develop robust, scalable metrics.
    • Strong technical understanding, including the ability to work effectively with APIs, data models, system architecture, and complex technical constraints. Coding is not a core requirement, but the ability to prototype using code and modern AI-assisted tools is expected.
    • Experience working closely with highly technical engineering and data teams and the ability to understand and communicate complex technical trade-offs.
    • Strong understanding of analytics products, data visualization, metrics, experimentation, and how data can be translated into actionable insights.
    • A strong customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and turn feedback into scalable product solutions.
    • Understanding of the mobile app ecosystem, app-business economics, monetization, and the factors that define success for app developers.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly and concisely across different communication formats, teams, and time zones.
    • Strong ownership mentality, initiative, and willingness to investigate problems directly and take responsibility for outcomes.
    • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments where decisions often need to be made with incomplete information.
    • Systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to move beyond individual customer requests and design solutions that scale across products and users.
    • Strong attention to product and user experience details, including a passion for high-quality data visualization and the ability to connect visual presentation with meaningful insights.
    • Pragmatic approach to product development, balancing a high standard of quality with a strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and iteration.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, international environment and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple time zones.

      • Benefits:

      • $207,000 USD annual salary for the role.
      • Competitive equity package within a fast-growing Series C startup environment.
      • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options.
      • Fully remote work environment designed around autonomy and flexibility.

title: Med Tech - Wildwood, MO
description:
Position Summary

Medication Technicians are an essential part of our wellness team by administering medications to residents in a safe, accurate, and timely manner under the supervision of a licensed nurse and general direction of the Wellness Director.

Hiring for day shift and night shift.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and administer medications as allowed by state regulation to residents following established policies and procedures.
  • Accurately complete required documentation of medication administration at time-of-service delivery. Verifies identity of resident receiving medication and records name of drug, dosage, route, and time of administration on specified forms or records.
  • Review MARs immediately after administration of a medication and prior to end of shift to ensure documentation is complete and accurate.
  • Notify supervisor when making the decision not to administer a medication as ordered.
  • Communicate effectively at the end of shift relaying relevant and pertinent information regarding resident care, concerns, changes, and the like to oncoming/outgoing personnel.
  • Maintain security of medication cart and narcotic keys during entire shift. Conduct narcotic count at the beginning and end of every shift in accordance with company policy and procedure.
  • Observe residents and reports changes in resident’s psychosocial and physical condition as well as any concerns, e.g., skin breakdown, rash, behavioral changes, speech change, change in appearance, etc., to Wellness Director.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and orderly environment for residents. Ensure resident rooms are clean and tidy throughout each day and follows scheduled housekeeping tasks such as laundry as assigned.
  • Assist residents with activities of daily living, to include ambulation, transferring, showering, personal hygiene, incontinence care, feeding, reminders, and supervision according to the individual plan of care.
  • Gathering, engaging, and assisting residents in activities, conducting activities in groups or one-on-one with residents as requested. Encouraging residents to socialize and participate in planned activities and develop friendships with other residents.
  • Communicates professionally with physicians and third-party specialists, such as homecare providers, lab providers and hospice professionals.
  • Maintain the resident record daily following company policy and procedure.
  • Follow established safety protocols, including fire protection, infection control, blood borne pathogens, hazardous waste, and quality assurance procedures. Respond to all requests for assistance promptly and with a positive demeanor including emergency pull cords, telephone calls, and requests from family members or friends.
  • Report all complaints, grievances, suspicion of abuse and instances of abuse to the Wellness Director and/or the Executive Director.
  • Participate and attend Wellness meetings and required trainings to ensure compliance with all regulations and policies
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with both residents and staff. Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence.
  • Able to make standard and routine decisions as allowed by state regulation based on training, knowledge gained through job required certification, detailed guidelines, and judgement. Problems are generally solved with clear, detailed guidelines or by reporting them to a supervisor.
  • Successful completion of a state approved medication administration course and other state required certifications to perform job duties as allowed by state regulations.

Preferred Skill/Abilities:

  • Previous experience as a Certified Med Aide or Medication Technician
  • Experience working with older adults
  • Previous experience in Assisted Living or Memory Care
  • Knowledge of dementia and related diseases

  • Minimum 18 years of age
  • Must pass a pre-employment background check, drug screen, TB test and physical

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
We are seeking a business-minded

Analytics Engineer

with deep expertise in the Non-Life and Health Insurance domains who will act as the vital bridge between our core business operations and our data infrastructure. Managing insurance data lifecycles will be your primary focus, ranging from policy underwriting, claims reserve changes, and earned vs. unearned premiums.

Functions (Duties and Responsibilities): • Insurance Data Modeling - Design and optimize robust, business-centric data models (Star and Snowflake schemas) within SSMS that accurately map the complex data lifecycles of insurance policies and claims. • ETL Development & Optimization - Build, scale, and maintain stable ETL pipelines using SSIS and complex T-SQL stored procedures, ensuring clean and optimized structures for business analytics. • Business Logic Implementation - Translate nuanced insurance metrics directly into the data layer, including Gross Written Premium (GWP), Net Earned Premium, Loss Ratios, Claims Reserves etc. • Historical Reporting & Truth - Solve complex insurance data problems, such as retroactively adjusted claims, policy endorsements, and historical point-in-time ('as-of') financial reporting using advanced T-SQL. • Stakeholder Collaboration - Partner closely with Actuaries, Underwriters, Claims Managers, and Finance teams to turn messy production source data into reliable, intuitive analytical data products.

Job Skills And Qualifications: · Education:

Strong understanding of core insurance financials, policy lifecycles, and claims states. · Technical Expertise:
