title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software
location: Broomfield, Colorado, United States; Fort Collins, Colorado, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines. This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring.
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About SERHANT.

SERHANT. is the most followed real estate brand in the world, calibrated for the marketplace of tomorrow, delivering proven results for buyers, sellers, and developers. SERHANT. revolutionizes the traditional brokerage model by innovating through media and content creation and is powered by a full-service in-house film studio as well as an amplification platform that puts our properties in front of more people than anyone else.

SERHANT. ID Lab is the in-house creative agency behind all marketing at SERHANT., supporting agents, listings, new developments, and brand campaigns. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team of designers, marketers, and brand strategists that delivers standout marketing for the most followed real estate brand in the world.

About the Role

SERHANT. ID Lab is looking for a designer who can build the identity of a building from the ground up and then stand in front of a developer and sell it. New development branding is where design meets real money: a building’s identity has to carry a price point, hold up across a two- to three-year sales cycle, and convince a buyer before a single unit is finished. The ideal candidate has a refined luxury sensibility, tells a story through design rather than decorating around one, presents with confidence in front of clients, and has the technical range to take a brand from concept through print, environmental, and digital.

This is not an agency role. ID Lab runs on a systemized production model - templated asset frameworks, brand kits, a structured intake and review pipeline in ClickUp, AI tooling woven into the process, and in-house film, floor plan, and web resources - built so designers spend their time on thinking and craft rather than rebuilding the same deliverable from scratch. You will carry several buildings at different stages at once and move at a pace an outside agency cannot. If you would rather ship excellent work in weeks than perfect work in quarters, you will do well here.

Responsibilities

  • Developing full brand identities for new development projects - naming support, logo systems, typography, color, and the brand guidelines that keep an identity intact across a multi-year sell-out
  • Translating a developer’s vision, the architecture, and the neighborhood into a story a buyer can feel, and carrying that story consistently from pitch deck to brochure to construction barricade to sales gallery to website
  • Presenting concepts directly to developers, sponsors, and internal stakeholders - framing the rationale, defending the creative, absorbing feedback, and returning with the next round quickly
  • Designing the full new development collateral suite (materials include but are not limited to: pitch and RFP materials, brochures, floor plan books, e-blasts, social graphics, signage and construction barricades, print advertising, and presentation decks)
  • Designing floor plan presentations for print and web - floor plan production itself is handled by a dedicated contractor
  • Designing new development websites in Figma and handing off developer-ready files to internal and external web partners, then reviewing builds for brand and design fidelity
  • Using AI tools to accelerate concepting, iteration, and production
  • Working within and improving ID Lab’s templates, brand kits, and asset libraries so every project starts further along than the last one
  • Ensuring brand consistency across concurrent projects without letting any two buildings look alike
  • Coordinating with the New Development project management team, agents, and third-party vendors including printers, fabricators, photographers, and web developers
  • Contributing to team efforts by accomplishing tasks as needed and ensuring deadlines are met
  • Keeping up to date with luxury, hospitality, fashion, and architectural design - the reference set for this work sits largely outside real estate
  • *The company reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, communication design, or a related field
  • 4–6 years of experience as a designer in brand identity and marketing, with substantive work in a luxury category - real estate, hospitality, fashion, spirits, automotive, or comparable
  • Real estate marketing experience - new development, luxury residential, or comparable - clearly demonstrated in your portfolio
  • A portfolio link included in your resume, showing complete identity systems rather than individual assets, with editorial-quality print work
  • Direct client-facing experience presenting your own work to the people paying for it
  • Print production fluency: prepress, stock, finishes, binding, large-format and environmental specifications
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools within the creative process - be prepared to walk us through how and where you use them
  • Availability for occasional travel to new development sites within New York City
  • Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat
  • Figma, including website design and developer-ready handoff
  • Website builders (i.e. Squarespace, Webflow or similar)
  • Project management software (i.e. ClickUp or similar)
  • Email marketing platforms (i.e. Mailchimp or similar)
  • Preferred, but not required:
    • Ground-up new development or sales gallery experience specifically
    • Canva brand kits and templated design systems operating at scale
    • Working knowledge of construction and development timelines and how creative deliverables sequence against them

Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and the composure to present work in front of a client
  • A keen eye for design, visual composition, and luxury detail
  • The ability to explain why a mark, a typeface, or a paper stock is right for a building in a way that makes the work more persuasive
  • Effective time management and the ability to work at speed across concurrent projects without sacrificing craft
  • Meticulous attention to detail on anything that prints, gets fabricated, or goes on a wall
  • Discipline around process, file management, and handoff
  • Comfort in an entrepreneurial environment that is building while it runs
  • Ability to give and receive constructive criticism

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location.

The national base pay range for this position within the United States is $80,000.00 - $85,000.00 USD.

Benefits

Eligible employees may receive medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off and paid holidays; retirement benefits; and other company-sponsored benefits, subject to applicable eligibility requirements and plan terms.

Your Location

This position is hybrid eligible for candidates based in the New York City, NY area. The role may include occasional work at additional SERHANT. offices or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Candidates must live within the United States.

Hiring Statement

SERHANT. is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination or harassment. We expect every member of the SERHANT. community to do their part to cultivate and maintain an environment where everyone has the opportunity to feel included and is afforded the respect and dignity they deserve.

Decisions related to hiring, compensating, training, evaluating performance, or terminating are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and staff. SERHANT. does not charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruiting or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted here on on our Careers page or Linkedin, and all communications from the SERHANT. recruiting team and/or hiring managers will be from an @serhant.com email address.

To be considered for any of our open roles, candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

title: On-Site Automation Technician
description:
Concentric, LLC is the nation’s largest independent industrial power provider, delivering forklift power, critical infrastructure, mechanical/HVAC, and dedicated material handling and automation maintenance solutions. Through a nationwide network of technicians, engineers, and support teams, Concentric understands and prioritizes the unique needs of each customer to maximize uptime, improve operational efficiency, and maintain infrastructure. We provide reliable, scalable solutions that support data centers, telecommunications providers, utilities, manufacturing, distribution, commercial facilities, and other mission-critical environments across America.


Job Summary


The Automation Technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and optimizing automated systems and industrial equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. This role supports facility productivity by performing preventive and corrective maintenance on a variety of material handling, automation, and building support equipment, including electric forklifts, conveyors, robotic systems, case sealers and erectors, dock equipment, scissor lifts, tuggers, floor scrubbers, and racking systems. The Automation Technician works closely with operations and engineering teams to minimize downtime, improve equipment performance, and support continuous improvement initiatives while adhering to all safety, quality, and maintenance standards. This position reports to a Service Manager or designee and does not have any direct reports.


Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Timely and accurate completion of all work orders and service records per the company time standard.
  • Responsible for being the point of contact for customers.
  • Perform and complete preventive maintenance (PM) and repairs.
  • Facilitate work and repair requests.
  • Provide shift coverage.
  • Coordinate and facilitate warranty requests.
  • Facilitate outside vendor work and all outside of scope work (PO process and billing).
  • Order parts and manage inventory (5S Inventory Skills).
  • Attend and complete monthly safety training requirements.
  • Adhere to safety requirements by customer and company and complete all daily work orders in a safe manner.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and hazard-free work areas daily to support a safe and efficient work environment.
  • Troubleshoot equipment failures including root cause analysis, and research of potential warranty coverage.
  • Complete all repairs of equipment in a timely manner and follow the manufacturer’s repair guidelines.
  • Conduct equipment audits in accordance with the preventive maintenance (PM) schedule established within the service platform.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor.


Key Performance Measurements:

  • A score card that reflects performance in areas such as, PM completion, technician efficiency, customer satisfaction, inventory variance, Work in Progress (WIP), safety, shop cleanliness, and 5S.
  • Management observation regarding attitude, diligence, team contributions, and willingness and ability to learn new skills and information.
  • Other key performance indicators as assigned

title: Systems Project Controls Office & Reporting Lead
description:
About the Project:


Trillium Rail Partners (TRP) is a consortium of Amico Major Projects, Alberici Constructors, and Acciona Infrastructure Canada, working closely with Metrolinx to deliver the Stations, Rail, and Systems (SRS) package for the Eglinton Crosstown West Extension (ECWE), a transformative 9.2 km expansion of Toronto’s light rail network.


The ECWE will bring the Eglinton Crosstown LRT another 9.2 kilometres farther west, creating a continuous rapid transit line from the east end of Toronto into Mississauga. The Stations, Rail, and Systems (SRS) package encompasses the design, construction, integration, and commissioning of key project components.


Position Overview:


TRP has a current vacancy for a Systems Project Controls Office & Reporting Lead that will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and managing project controls, performance monitoring, data management, reporting, governance, and reporting activities for the Systems organization. The role provides oversight of systems-wide schedule performance, cost tracking, risk management, action tracking, KPI reporting, and executive reporting processes to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery.

The Systems Project Controls Office & Reporting Lead works closely with Systems Leads, Work Package Managers, Project Controls, Commercial, Design, Construction, Testing & Commissioning, and Operations Readiness teams to ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely reporting of project information. The position plays a key role in identifying project risks and trends, tracking performance metrics, and providing leadership with actionable insights to support delivery objectives.


Key Responsibilities:


Project Controls & Performance Management

  • Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of project control processes across the Systems organization.
  • Monitor schedule, progress, performance, and delivery metrics across all systems disciplines and work packages.
  • Support systems leadership in tracking project milestones, deliverables, commitments, and performance objectives.
  • Coordinate with Project Controls teams to ensure alignment of systems activities with overall project reporting requirements.
  • Identify performance trends, schedule risks, and recovery opportunities.


Reporting & Governance

  • Develop, manage, and continuously improve systems reporting processes and reporting tools.
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, and executive-level reports for Systems leadership and project stakeholders.
  • Coordinate collection, validation, and consolidation of information from systems disciplines and work package teams.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality of project reporting documentation.
  • Support governance reviews, executive presentations, and management reporting activities.


Risk, Action & Change Management

  • Maintain systems-level action registers, decision logs, risk registers, and issue trackers.
  • Coordinate follow-up activities to ensure actions and commitments are completed within required timelines.
  • Support identification, assessment, and escalation of project risks and issues.
  • Track systems-related change impacts and support reporting of key project impacts.


Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate reporting inputs from Design, Construction, Testing & Commissioning, Operations Readiness, and Systems Integration teams.
  • Lead cross-functional review meetings to confirm project status, risks, actions, and performance metrics.
  • Provide reporting support to Systems Leads and Work Package Managers.
  • Facilitate communication between project teams and senior leadership.


Data Management & Analytics

  • Develop dashboards, KPI tracking tools, and performance measurement processes.
  • Analyze project performance data and prepare recommendations to support management decisions.
  • Maintain reporting databases and project information repositories.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to reporting, controls, and governance processes.

title: [쿠팡] 로켓직구 CS 프로그램 기획 및 운영 (경력 7년 이상)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Jikgu CS Program Management 팀은 고객 관점에서 고객 서비스 품질 향상과 고객 만족도 제고를 목표로 운영됩니다. 고객 응대 및 VOC 분석을 기반으로 고객 경험 개선 기회를 발굴하고, 새로운 고객 서비스 프로세스와 운영 방안을 제안합니다. 또한 사업부, 운영 조직 및 글로벌 파트너와 긴밀히 협업하여 고객 접점에서 발생하는 이슈를 선제적으로 해결하고 안정적인 서비스를 제공합니다. 신사업의 성공적인 안착을 지원하기 위해 고객 접점 채널을 관리하고, 확장되는 비즈니스에 맞는 CS 정책 및 운영 체계를 구축하는 역할을 수행합니다.

업무 내용

  • Customer Issue Management
    • Rocket Jikgu FEM 티켓을 통해 고객 이슈를 신속하게 확인하고 해결
    • 고객 불만 및 운영 이슈에 대한 원인 분석(Root Cause Analysis) 수행
  • VOC Analysis & Customer Experience Improvement
    • 고객 VOC 및 운영 데이터를 분석하여 고객 경험 개선 과제 도출
    • Product, Operations, Logistics 등 Business Partner와 협업하여 고객 만족도 향상 추진
  • CS Knowledge Management
    • 상담사가 신속하고 정확하게 고객 응대를 할 수 있도록 지식 체계 구축
    • CS 정책, FAQ, 가이드라인 및 SOP 관리
  • Program & Process Management
    • 신규 비즈니스 및 서비스 확대에 따른 CS 영향도 검토
    • 관련 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 개발 및 운영 안정화 지원
    • 프로젝트 및 프로그램 단위의 개선 과제 리딩 및 관리

자격 요건

  • 학사 학위 이상을 보유하신 분
  • Customer Service, Program Management, Operations 또는 유관 분야에서 7년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 대규모 기업 또는 복잡한 조직 환경에서 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 운영 개선 및 프로젝트를 주도한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 분석 및 문제 해결 능력을 보유하신 분 (SQL 가능자)
  • 신규 프로세스 구축, SOP 수립 또는 운영 개선 프로젝트를 리드한 경험이 있는 분

우대 사항

  • AI 기반 분석 및 업무 자동화 활용 경험이 있으신 분
  • E-commerce, Marketplace 또는 Tech 산업 근무 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Electrical Site Safety Representative
description:
MISSION:

Achieving excellence through the dedication, innovation, and growth of our employee-owners, creating lasting value with our business partners.


OUR CORE VALUES:

Ownership: As employee-owners, we lead with discipline, act with conviction, and deliver more than is expected.

Transparency: We cultivate an environment of collaboration, accountability, and trust.

Safety: The principle that shapes our culture, values, and resolve.


JOB SUMMARY:

The Site Safety Representative will assist the Safety Director and Safety Managers in implementing safety protocols, conducting inspections, and promoting a culture of safety within the company. This position will serve as a resource for safety and field personnel alike.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Ensures that all policies, programs, and daily operations comply with local, state, and federal laws and procedures regarding safety.
  • Implement and enforce the Tri-City Safety Policy.
  • Assist with the management and inventory of job site safety equipment.
  • Qualify and help deliver safety and job skill training.
  • Assist with identifying job site field training needs.
  • Effectively communicate to enhance and encourage overall employee safety awareness and job knowledge.
  • Maintain a safety presence in the field and build rapport with the field team, other trades, controlling contractors, and owners.
  • Conduct periodic safety inspections and hazard assessments.
  • Assign responsibility and deadlines to correct safety issues identified to maintain OSHA compliance.
  • Assist with the maintenance of job site OSHA documentation, including SDS chemical lists.
  • Identify and evaluate hazardous conditions, practices, and programs on the job site.
  • Interact with other contractors to ensure employees are not exposed to various hazards.
  • Investigate accidents, near misses, and or/safety violations on the job site to determine trends and assist with the development of procedures to avoid recurrence.
  • Document accidents of all trades.
  • Respond immediately to any/all OSHA inspections and remain on-site for the duration of the inspectors' visit.
  • Serve as a representative of Tri-City to organizations, companies, trades, etc., outside of Tri-City.
  • Attend job site safety meetings.
  • Keep other personnel up to date regarding conditions, observations, upcoming training, etc.
  • Assist Human Resources in gathering on-site OSHA, safety, and workers' compensation investigations and information as required.


OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED:

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but does serve as a coach and mentor for other positions in the department.


REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Knowledge of basic mathematical operations and calculations (e.g., addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, order of operations) to calculate labor, materials, and/or cost estimates for projects and work orders, etc.
  • Working knowledge of National Electrical Codes
  • OSHA 30 (Construction or General Industry)
  • 1-3 years of direct job site safety experience
  • 3-5 years of electrical construction experience
  • Must have the ability to effectively read, write, and communicate in the English language at a 12th-grade level


PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bilingual
  • Ability to successfully obtain JLA badging for school job sites
  • Journeyman Electrical License
  • Prior experience as an instructor in either safety or technical topics
  • Safety Trained Supervisor in Construction (STSC) or equivalent

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES | SKILLS:

  • Supports our Mission Statement and Core Values.
  • Is honest and has the highest integrity.
  • Sets the example for others and is above reproach.
  • Ability to cope with job pressures in a constantly changing environment.
  • Interpersonal and intrapersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated.
  • Detail-oriented.
  • Positive and professional demeanor.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Able to handle and manage confidential information.


WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • General Office Environment: This position operates in a professional office environment, using standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.
  • Environmental Conditions:
    The work is performed indoors in a climate-controlled setting with minimal exposure to loud noise, temperature variations, or other environmental factors.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA, FMLA, and other federal, state, and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards.
  • Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ADA, FMLA, and other federal, state, and local standards.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, crawling, and climbing throughout the day.
  • Must be able to move objects and use abdominal and lower back muscles to provide support over time without fatigue. Constant movement and use of limbs; this position requires good manual dexterity, coordination, and stamina.
  • Ability to wear company-approved Personal Protective Equipment per local, state, federal, or OSHA regulations.
  • The employee must frequently lift and move items over 50 pounds.
  • Requires the ability to perform physical duties listed above for extended periods.
  • Sitting/Standing: Requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, though there may be opportunities for standing and moving around the office as needed.
  • Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands to operate computer keyboards, mouse, and other office tools, as well as to handle paperwork.
  • Visual Requirements: The ability to read and interpret data on computer screens and printed documents is essential.
  • Mobility: Occasional lifting of objects weighing up to 25 pounds, such as files, documents, or office supplies, may be requested. Must be able to access all areas of the facility and projects to determine purchasing needs.
  • Communication: Regular communication with colleagues, vendors, and other stakeholders requires the ability to exchange information effectively in both verbal and written form.

SCHEDULE AND REQUIRED TRAVEL:

  • Requires the ability to report to job sites or offices throughout Florida.
  • May be requested to work overtime, nights, and weekends.


EOE/APP/Drug-Free Workplace

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Tri-City provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Solutions Architect to design practical, technically sound solutions that address customer needs and make effective use of the Evidation Platform. This external and internal customer-facing role will serve as a bridge across Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Delivery—translating business and program requirements into scalable solutions that can be successfully sold, configured, and delivered.

The Solutions Architect will develop deep expertise in Evidation’s platforms, tools, and capabilities; guide customers and internal teams toward solutions that are feasible and supportable; and help Evidation adopt more automated, AI-enabled approaches to solution configuration and implementation.



Responsibilities

Solution Design & Pre-Sales

  • Lead technical and solution discovery with prospective and existing external customers.
  • Translate customer objectives, program requirements, and business needs into clear solution designs.
  • Guide customers and internal teams toward solutions that make effective use of existing platform capabilities while identifying where new functionality may be required.
  • Partner with Business Development and other commercial stakeholders on technical presentations, platform discussions, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and feasibility assessments.
  • Provide technical input during proposal development, scoping, and contracting. Identify technical risks, gaps, and dependencies early in the solution-design process.
  • Review solution designs and technical sections of statements of work and contracts to confirm feasibility, dependencies, assumptions, and delivery implications.

Technical Architecture & Feasibility

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor by developing deep expertise in Evidation’s platforms, tools, integrations, and configuration options; evaluating proposed solutions for feasibility, scalability, security, and operational impact; and translating customer and business needs into clear technical specifications for Product and Engineering.

Implementation Enablement and Team Leadership

  • Carry solution context from design and contracting into implementation to support a smooth transition and reduce gaps between what is sold and what can be delivered.
  • Configure or support the configuration of platform solutions, integrations, APIs, webhooks, data transfers, and identity and authentication tools such as SSO and OIDC.
  • Partner with Delivery, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical issues and ensure solutions are implemented as designed.
  • Provide technical guidance on implementation plans, configuration decisions, change requests, QA, UAT, and release readiness.
  • Build internal knowledge of platform configuration and implementation processes to reduce operational risk and reliance on individual subject-matter experts.
  • Balance the ongoing delivery of existing and legacy solutions with the adoption of improved tools and implementation approaches.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying recurring customer and implementation needs, partnering with Product and Engineering to develop and adopt AI-enabled automation, and creating reusable solution patterns, standards, playbooks, and configuration guidance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a proactive connector across customers, Business Development, Product, Engineering, Implementation, and Delivery—building alignment, translating feedback into product priorities, and independently navigating complex cross-functional initiatives.

Requirements

  • 5–7 years of experience in solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical consulting, implementation, or a similar customer-facing role supporting SaaS or platform products.
  • Demonstrated experience designing technical solutions based on complex customer and business requirements.
  • Strong understanding of integrations, APIs, webhooks, data flows, and identity and authentication technologies such as SSO and OIDC.
  • Ability to translate effectively between business, customer, product, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Experience evaluating technical feasibility, defining solution requirements, and identifying risks and dependencies.
  • Ability to understand complex platform capabilities and guide stakeholders toward scalable, supportable solutions.
  • Experience supporting solutions through both pre-sales design and post-sales implementation.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools and identifying opportunities to automate technical or operational workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present effectively to technical and executive audiences.
  • Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills and the ability to operate independently in an evolving environment.
  • Experience working in regulated contexts, such as ISO 27001 or 21 CFR Part 11, or the ability to develop that knowledge quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, digital health, or clinical research.
  • Experience designing solutions for pharmaceutical or clinical research customers.
  • Hands-on experience configuring SaaS platforms and third-party software.
  • Experience formalizing reusable solution architectures, implementation playbooks, or configuration standards.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to improve platform capabilities based on customer and implementation needs.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled or agentic approaches to solution configuration, implementation, or workflow automation.

title: Compliance Management System Analyst-Specialist
description:
Summary

Responsible for operating and administering Sunward’s Compliance Management System (CMS) day to day — regulatory change management, the risk-based compliance monitoring and testing schedule, policy and procedure upkeep, and complaint management — under the direction of the Manager, Compliance and BSA Officer. This role keeps the CMS current, well-documented, and running on cadence, and provides the dedicated operational capacity the compliance program needs as regulatory complexity grows.

The role coordinates with business units, the enterprise risk team, and control partners to track regulatory changes, execute monitoring and testing, maintain the compliance documentation set, and support complaint intake and reporting. It guides stakeholders on compliance requirements, ensures adherence to established procedures, tracks issues and corrective actions, and escalates concerns appropriately.

Operating with limited-to-moderate autonomy within established policy, the CMS Analyst / Specialist executes program activities, prepares compliance reporting for review, applies practical judgment in day-to-day work, and refers novel, high-impact, or cross-departmental matters to the Manager, Compliance.

Essential Functions:

CMS Operation & Regulatory Change Management

• Operates the regulatory change-management process — monitors rule changes and regulatory guidance, assesses applicability to Sunward, and coordinates implementation with affected business units.

• Maintains the CMS framework documentation, ensuring policies, procedures, and program records are current, version-controlled, and readily retrievable.

• Maintains the compliance calendar and program cadence, ensuring recurring obligations and filings are tracked and met.

• Administers compliance program systems and tools, supporting data accuracy and consistent use across the compliance function.

Monitoring, Testing & Issue Management

• Executes the risk-based compliance monitoring and testing schedule, documenting scope, methodology, results, and findings.

• Tracks compliance issues and corrective actions to closure, escalating aging or high-severity items to the Manager, Compliance.

• Conducts or supports compliance risk assessments, helping identify and prioritize areas of regulatory exposure.

• Supports consumer compliance activities (e.g., UDAAP, fair lending, and regulation-specific requirements) as directed.

Complaint Management, Reporting & Examinations

• Administers complaint management — intake, categorization, root-cause review, tracking, and reporting — including consumer-complaint trend analysis.

• Prepares compliance reporting for the Manager, Compliance and, as needed, for the Risk Oversight Committee and Board Governance & Risk Committee.

• Supports regulatory examinations (e.g., NCUA), internal and external audits, and management responses by coordinating documentation, preparing narratives, and tracking corrective actions.

• Delivers or supports compliance training and stakeholder guidance to reinforce consistent compliance practices across the organization.

• Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned in support of departmental and organizational objectives.

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.

팀 소개

Health&Wellbeing(H&W)팀은 임직원의 신체적(Physical), 정신적(Mental), 사회적(Social) Wellbeing을 통합적으로 지원하여, 임직원이 건강하고 안전하게 일할 수 있는 환경을 만들어갑니다.
임직원들에게 필요한 다양한 건강지원 서비스를 제공하며, 예방적 건강관리와 Wellbeing 활동을 통해 임직원 건강문화를 조성하는 것을 목표로 합니다.

업무 내용

  • 임직원 건강상담 및 맞춤형 건강관리 지원
  • 응급상황 대응 및 응급처치, 사후 건강관리 수행
  • 예방 중심의 건강관리 및 건강증진 활동 운영
  • 건강 데이터 관리, 통계 분석 및 리포팅
  • 건강위험요인 평가 및 건강한 근무환경 조성 지원

자격 요건

  • 간호사 면허를 보유하신 분
  • 임상현장에서의 건강상담 및 환자 상태평가 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 응급상황 발생 시 초기 평가 및 응급처치가 가능하신 분

우대 사항

  • BLS, KALS, ACLS 등 응급처치 관련 자격 또는 교육을 이수하신 분
  • 건강검진 사후관리 및 건강상담 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 운전면허증을 소지하신 분
  • 외국어(영어) 능력을 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangfs.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

반드시 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 지원해 주시기 바랍니다.

Please make sure to apply with your Coupang e-mail address.

title: In-Home Care + Weekly Pay
description:
Overview

Location: Molalla, West Linn, Lake O and surrounding communities

We are especially seeking caregivers who are open to ongoing weekend shifts and daytime shifts

Become a Caregiver with TheKey while building a meaningful career in a growing industry!

  • TOP PAY RATES - $22-25 per hour
  • Currently hiring for all shifts (consistent daytime and weekend availability strongly preferred)
  • Full-time and part-time available

TheKey is the largest provider of private pay in-home care for aging seniors in North America. As an Employer of Choice, our dedicated local teams provide exceptional support to our caregivers while they transform the lives of aging adults.

JOIN TODAY AND HELP US CHANGE THE WAY THE WORLD AGES!

Why join TheKey?

  • $250 Sign on Bonus - after 30 hours worked
  • Flexible Schedules
  • Highly Competitive Pay Rates - starting at $22-25 per hour
  • Weekly Pay with optional Daily Pay through PayActiv
  • Mileage Reimbursement
  • Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision and 401(k) Plan with Employer Match
  • Paid Training - Virtual/Online/Hands-On classes
  • Referral Bonuses - Bonus will be paid via Caribou
  • 24/7 Caregiver Support & local management

Responsibilities

As a Caregiver for TheKey, you’ll assist your clients 1:1 with the following activities inside their homes:

  • Personal care: dressing, bathing, grooming and assisting with meals
  • Light housekeeping: basic cleaning, laundry, and organizing
  • Transportation: Driving clients to appointments, running errands, and grocery shopping
  • Companionship: games, puzzles or other activities that provide social and emotional support

Qualifications

At TheKey, we pride ourselves on hiring compassionate caregivers who meet the following eligibility requirements:

  • At least 6 months of professional caregiving experience required
  • Alzheimer's or Dementia experience
  • Empathy, compassion and kindness a MUST
  • Ability to use sound judgement and remain calm in a variety of situations
  • Must be reliable, dependable and on time

  • Basic computer skills

At TheKey, we are committed to treating every employee with dignity and respect while providing a white glove experience for our clients to promote a healthy mind, body and spirit. Our caregivers are compassionate, innovative and dedicated to providing the quality of life our seniors deserve. Join us today and make a difference for seniors in your community!

Caregivers must comply with state background screening requirements and must be eligible to work in the US. Certain additional eligibility requirements, compensation, benefits and bonuses vary by state and location, so please ask for complete details at your interview.

title: Construction Engineer (Temporary Works Design)
description:
Overview

Are you a self-motivated Engineer looking to make a significant impact on our projects? As a Construction Engineer, you will draft and analyze temporary works designs to ensure constructability with contract documents, specifications and regulatory requirements.

The Construction Engineering Group focuses on the “how” when it comes to constructing the work. This team of specialized engineers has extensive experience in designing and constructing various temporary works.

Click here to find out what drew Isabel to the Construction Engineering group.

Apply now and transform your career with us.

What you will be doing

  • Provides constructability and technical design input on temporary works construction designs to ensure compliance with contract specifications and regulatory requirements.
  • Designs and drafts construction methods for temporary works (falsework, shoring, temporary bridges, formwork, slopes, etc.), ensuring completeness and accuracy with regulatory standards and within the contract specifications.
  • Reviews personal and peer design elements to optimize project constructability, cost effectiveness and material quantities.
  • Conducts forensic analysis for post-construction items to support claims mitigation and dispute resolutions.
  • Submits design for peer review or approval review in an accurate and timely manner to avoid construction delays on the project site. Seals personal and team designs following approval review.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil, Structural or related Engineering field required.
  • Professional Engineering License (PE/PENG) required.
  • 10+ years of experience with temporary works construction practices and constructability innovation techniques.
  • Proven knowledge of AutoCAD, RISA suite, LARSA and MathCAD required.
  • Proven knowledge of temporary works construction practices and constructability innovation techniques.
  • Proven success with creative, innovative and optimization strategies for construction challenges.
  • Strong verbal, written and presentation skills. Proven interpersonal skills used to defend, clarify and explain construction strategies and designs
  • Clear, concise and efficient technical writing skills used in calculation packages.
  • Able to self-prioritize and track individual work with limited oversight.
  • Able and driven to mentor developing engineering team. Able to set clear expectations and support team to reach Company and departmental goals.

Why work for us

Some of the benefits you may be eligible for as an employee are:

  • Comprehensive compensation package and paid time off program
  • Industry leading 401(k)/RRSP
  • Medical/Extended Health Care, Dental, Vision and/or Provincial Medical
  • Wellness benefits & Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

We are an EEO/ADA/Veterans employer.

Salary Min

USD $130,000.00/Yr.

Salary Max

USD $145,000.00/Yr.

title: Pet Care Attendant - Durham, NH
description:
Who we are

Great Bay Kennel is Hiring a Doggie Daycare Attendant!

Position Details

Role: Doggie Daycare AttendantStatus: Full-timeSalary: Competitive and based on experienceSchedule: Weekdays only; flexible schedulingRequirements: Previous experience in a doggy daycare and/or equine and barn setting is required

Benefits Highlights

Financial Rewards that Grow with You: Competitive pay, 401(k) matching, tuition support, and referral bonuses.

Wellness & Peace of Mind: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with supplemental options; up to three weeks of paid parental leave; generous PTO; and employee pet discounts.

Professional Growth & Recognition: Quarterly team bonuses, professional development opportunities, continuing education allowance, and uniform allowance.

Lifestyle Perks You’ll Appreciate: Six paid holidays, an Employee Assistance Program, and an employee discount program.

Love Dogs? Make Them Your Coworkers.

At Great Bay Doggie Daycare (GBDD) in picturesque Durham, NH, we believe dogs deserve more than a place to spend the day. Our goal is to provide the exercise, socialization, and mental stimulation that come from spending time with other dogs in a safe, controlled environment.

Our outdoor campus is designed with both dogs and their humans in mind. With sun and shade, pools, chairs, playground equipment, decks, and awnings for extra shade and rain protection, we’ve created an environment where dogs can play and our team can stay active alongside them.

We’re looking for a self-motivated, friendly, and experienced Dog Daycare Attendant to join us in a full-time, year-round position.

Why Our Doggie Daycare Attendants Love Working Here

  • Weekdays only—keep your weekends for yourself
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Spend your workday interacting with dogs in an active environment
  • Work on a campus designed for exercise, enrichment, and outdoor play
  • Join a supportive, team-oriented workplace
  • Work somewhere questions are encouraged and your efforts are appreciated
  • Make a direct impact on the safety, comfort, and happiness of the dogs in our care

What Our Doggie Daycare Attendants Do

  • Supervise dogs during group play and daycare activities
  • Help provide appropriate exercise, socialization, and mental stimulation
  • Monitor dog interactions and body language to maintain a safe environment
  • Recognize changes in behavior and respond appropriately
  • Think quickly and calmly when stressful situations arise
  • Help maintain clean, comfortable, and organized play and care areas
  • Support safe use of pools, playground equipment, decks, and other campus areas
  • Remain attentive and engaged while supervising dogs for extended periods
  • Communicate effectively with teammates and help create a positive environment
  • Provide friendly customer service when interacting with pet owners

What You’ll Bring

  • Previous experience in a doggy daycare and/or equine and barn setting is required
  • Knowledge and understanding of dog body language
  • Ability to think quickly and make sound decisions in stressful situations
  • Ability to remain on your feet for extended periods
  • Ability to perform the lifting and physical activity required in an active animal-care environment
  • Self-motivation and a strong work ethic
  • Friendly, dependable, team-oriented attitude
  • Comfort working outdoors and in an active environment
  • Commitment to maintaining a safe and positive experience for every dog
  • Customer service skills are a plus

The Extras You’ll Actually Feel

This isn’t a job where you’ll spend your day behind a desk. You’ll be moving, observing, interacting, and helping dogs get the physical activity and social enrichment they need.

You’ll also be part of a workplace where questions are encouraged and your efforts are appreciated. Add in flexible scheduling and weekdays-only hours, and you have an opportunity to build a career around animals while still making room for life outside of work.

And yes, pools, playground equipment, outdoor time, and four-legged coworkers are all part of the package.

Benefits You Can’t Beat

Benefit eligibility may vary based on full-time or part-time status. Benefits designated as full-time only are subject to eligibility requirements.

Financial Benefits

  • A flexible approach to compensation that reflects your skill set and future performance
  • 401(k) matching & Roth Retirement Savings Plan
  • Flexible Spending Account (full-time only)
  • 529 Savings Plan
  • Tuition Support Program (full-time only)
  • Referral bonus program

Wellness Benefits

  • Health insurance, including medical, dental, and vision (full-time only)
  • Supplemental insurance, including accident, critical illness, hospital, short- and long-term disability, legal plan, and employee, spouse, and child-dependent life insurance (full-time only)
  • Up to three weeks of full pay for the birth or adoption of a child (full-time employees only; available after one year of service). In states with paid family leave programs, this benefit does not apply.
  • Sick Time / Paid Time Off
  • Free or discounted lab work for all employee pets
  • Pet discounts on services and products
  • Pet food discount program

Workplace Benefits

  • Quarterly Team Rewards Bonus Program
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Continuing education allowance
  • Uniform allowance

Lifestyle Benefits

  • Six paid holidays (full-time only)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee discount program

Join Our Pack!

If you have experience working with dogs or in an equine/barn environment, understand dog body language, and want an active job where your work makes a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your cover letter and resume and include your personal email address and phone number.

Apply today and join the team at Great Bay Doggie Daycare!

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are core values at Great Bay Doggie Daycare and Vetcor. We are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working and learning environment for all employees. Every team member enriches our diversity by bringing different perspectives and ways of understanding and engaging with the world. That’s why we’re committed to a workplace culture where employees are comfortable being their authentic selves, experience a true sense of belonging, and are empowered to reach their highest potential.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton seeks a Project Coordinator to provide comprehensive administrative, technical, and project coordination support for the NASA Space Exploration Network Services and Evolution (SENSE) contract. This position is remote, with travel to other NASA locations as needed.

As prime contractor, Peraton is responsible for the development, operation, maintenance, sustainment and systems engineering of NASA’s worldwide satellite communication networks. In this position, you will conduct the day-to-day tactical duties for assigned tasking within the Chief Systems Engineering Organization. You will be an integral part of a world class team that builds and ensures NASA’s space-ground communications are reliable and meet mission requirements.

RESPONSIBLITIES

This position will be responsible for the following:

  • Meeting & Program Coordination
    • Manage Development Department meeting agendas and organize meeting logistics, including reserving conference facilities and scheduling teleconferences as required.
    • Coordinate with representatives from NASA, the SENSE program, and other Peraton civil space programs for all jointly held meetings, providing data as required.
    • Record, organize, and track meeting actions, recommendations, decisions, and any dissenting opinions through to closure.
    • Coordinate the development and review of directives used to document decisions.
    • Provide status reports on upcoming agenda items, open actions, and directives.
    • Maintain electronic records of presentations, action closures, and recommendations.
  • Documentation & Configuration Management
    • Identify, control, and manage program documentation to ensure information is readily accessible, retrievable, and preserved, including supporting internal and external audit functions.
    • Provide configuration management support, including technical and graphical document preparation, process editing, data entry, export control, process audits, metrics, and database management; may author, review, and edit complex written and graphical technical materials such as system configuration studies, reports, and presentation graphics.
    • Ensure structured document labeling and perform the release of electronic copies of documentation.
    • Organize and maintain the SENSE Development Department document library, SharePoint web pages, lists, and other web pages.
    • Create and maintain distribution lists and distribute deliverables and documents to identified parties.
    • Conduct research within various program support databases to create reports.
  • Administrative Support
    • Provide document preparation, calendar management, and general office management support.
    • Arrange travel and process expense reports, purchasing requests, and PCard procurement.
    • Provide general administrative support and routine secretarial functions.
  • Project Coordination Support
    • Support execution toward financial, delivery, and contractual performance targets for assigned projects.
    • Support mechanisms for monitoring project progress and problem-solving with project managers, line managers, and customers.
    • Support coordination between resource managers/supervisors and ensure all necessary documentation reviews and approvals are received.
    • Assist with the development of project presentations.
    • Perform vendor management and coordination functions as needed.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Degree in business management, finance, accounting, or related field and additional experience as follows: BS/BA degree & 2 years’ experience, AS/AA degree & 4 years’ experience; In lieu of degree, 6 years of related experience is allowable.
  • 2+ years of project management or finance support.
  • 2+ years of experience working on cross-functional teams.
  • 2+ years of experience in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Experience using Microsoft tools such as Project, Excel and Word.
  • Experience working in SharePoint and Google Workspace.
  • Security clearance - this position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance and to maintain the clearance thereafter.
  • Must be a US Citizen and show proof of citizenship.

DESIRED:

  • Experience in one or more related areas of expertise within civil space or a related industry.
  • Experience with calendar management for technical and management teams.
  • Experience organizing technical reviews and meetings and preparing detailed minutes for leadership.
  • Experience with AI tools.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. title: BA-1070 Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work as part of the Digital Shared Services team to support the analysis, implementation, testing, and adoption of digital health solutions across the provincial healthcare sector.

The resource will act as a bridge between clinical/business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business requirements are clearly understood, documented, translated into system requirements, tested, and successfully implemented.

The role requires extensive healthcare business analysis experience, with particular emphasis on clinical workflows, homecare systems, Sunrise Altera, PROCURA mobile software, clinical documentation, client registration, and digital dictation solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements

  • Work directly with clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to understand business needs and current-state workflows.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, requirements-gathering sessions, and process reviews.
  • Document business, functional, and system requirements.
  • Analyze current-state and future-state processes.
  • Develop process maps, workflow diagrams, business requirements, and related documentation.
  • Identify business, process, system, and capability gaps.
  • Translate clinical and operational requirements into actionable technology requirements.
  • Validate requirements with stakeholders and obtain appropriate approvals.

Healthcare Workflow Analysis

  • Analyze healthcare workflows and identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Work with clinical stakeholders to understand the impact of proposed technology changes.
  • Assess workflow dependencies, operational impacts, and implementation considerations.
  • Support the design and implementation of solutions that improve healthcare delivery and information management.

Software Implementation

  • Support the implementation of healthcare information systems and software solutions.
  • Participate in solution design, configuration, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-implementation activities.
  • Work with technical teams, vendors, clinical users, and project stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Identify and document issues, risks, dependencies, and requirements.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Lead and coordinate software testing activities.
  • Develop test strategies, test plans, testing estimates, test scenarios, and test cases.
  • Coordinate testing with business and clinical stakeholders.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing as appropriate.
  • Document test results, defects, issues, and resolutions.
  • Support defect triage and resolution activities.
  • Validate that implemented solutions meet approved business and clinical requirements.

Change Management & Adoption

  • Support change management and organizational readiness activities.
  • Work with stakeholders to assess the impact of system and workflow changes.
  • Support communications, training, stakeholder engagement, and implementation activities.
  • Apply change management practices to support successful adoption of new technologies and processes.

Project & Implementation Support

  • Participate in project planning and implementation activities.
  • Work within established project management and governance methodologies.
  • Provide status updates and identify issues requiring escalation.
  • Maintain accurate project and business analysis documentation.
  • Collaborate with project managers, technical teams, vendors, clinical stakeholders, and other business analysts.

title: SharePoint Administrator
description:
The SharePoint Administrator is the hands-on owner of the SharePoint Online environment at PACT (Pearson Accelerator Construction Team), a General Partnership of Alberici, Amico, Kenaidan and Obayashi, and keeps sites, permissions, content structure and workflows stable, governed and usable for program delivery. The role combines disciplined administration and a genuine front-line support component with contribution to SharePoint and collaboration platform architecture, standards and roadmap. The role works the IT ticket queue and resolves SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams-files issues through to root cause, while shaping the design patterns and information architecture that keep the platform supportable. The position supports document throughput and automation for Document Control, the external collaboration and data access model, enterprise dashboards, permission hygiene for safe Microsoft Copilot use, and ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control requirements.



RESPONSIBILITIES


SharePoint Administration and Automation

  • Administer SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business day to day across the PACT tenant
  • Provision sites, libraries and lists from standard templates for consistent, supportable workspaces
  • Maintain site collection settings, features, storage allocation and quotas across the environment
  • Manage site lifecycle across the environment, including archiving and decommissioning of inactive workspaces
  • Monitor Microsoft 365 service health and advisories, and communicate impact and workarounds to affected users
  • Apply tenant-level and site-level changes through controlled change management, with documented testing and rollback
  • Build and maintain Power Automate flows and Power Apps forms on SharePoint lists for approvals and document routing
  • Monitor flow health, hold automation connections on service accounts, and document automations for supportable hand-over

Platform Architecture and Strategy Contribution

  • Contribute to the information architecture standard and site taxonomy applied across the program
  • Define and maintain platform design patterns, templates and governance guardrails that keep collaboration work within the supported platform
  • Recommend platform capability adoption and roadmap items for the SharePoint and collaboration estate
  • Contribute to migration and consolidation planning for content moving into the platform
  • Advise on integration points between SharePoint, Autodesk Construction Cloud and the wider Microsoft 365 estate
  • Provide input to lifecycle, retention and archiving strategy for collaboration content across the estate
  • Support the Data & Innovation team on dashboard data sources and data ownership hosted in SharePoint

Information Architecture and Document Control Interface

  • Maintain standardized site and library patterns so workspace structure remains predictable to support
  • Administer metadata, the managed term store, content types, document sets and library views
  • Maintain naming and numbering conventions aligned to Document Control work instructions and the document-numbering system
  • Configure version control, check-in and check-out behaviour, and retention settings on controlled libraries
  • Administer the SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud interface, including confidentiality and access-permission requirements
  • Support Document Control platform needs, including work instructions, transmittals and controlled-document processes
  • Document and consistently apply locations, permissions and hand-off points between the two platforms
  • Coordinate site structure, access and workflow requirements with business owners across the program

Permissions and External Collaboration

  • Design and maintain group-based permission models and security group structures in preference to individual grants
  • Execute joiner, mover and leaver access changes driven by HR-system and Entra ID provisioning signals
  • Administer guest and external-user access to SharePoint content at the resource level, including sharing scope and site membership
  • Own periodic recertification of SharePoint content access held by external collaborators and guest accounts
  • Refer Entra guest identity object lifecycle to the Azure 365 Administrator, who owns identity provisioning
  • Enforce sharing-link policy and correct non-compliant sharing across sites, libraries and Teams-connected workspaces
  • Maintain permission hygiene across sites, libraries and Teams to support safe Microsoft Copilot use

Support and Service Delivery (L1–L3)

  • Work the ticket queue through the IT helpdesk intake and reinforce intake procedures so requests are logged and tracked
  • Triage and resolve SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams-files and sharing issues from first contact through to root-cause resolution
  • Escalate to Microsoft support or third-party vendors where required, and manage those cases to closure
  • Share the service desk queue with the System Support Analysts and Azure 365 Administrator, coordinating escalations
  • Provide platform support to both office-based and field-based staff for day-to-day operational needs
  • Deliver user guidance and short training sessions on SharePoint and document handling
  • Maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures and how-to material for the IT Operations & Support group

Governance, Security and Compliance

  • Execute the SharePoint-scope portion of the quarterly access review cycle coordinated by the Manager, Security & Compliance
  • Produce access-review evidence for the SharePoint estate supporting ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control requirements
  • Report on sharing activity, permission changes and external access using Microsoft 365 audit logs
  • Apply retention, records and archiving requirements to controlled content held in SharePoint and OneDrive
  • Support data-loss-prevention and sensitivity-labelling on SharePoint content against requirements set by the Manager, Security & Compliance
  • Coordinate label and policy configuration with the Azure 365 Administrator, who performs the tenant-level configuration


WORKING CONDITIONS

The position will be based at our office in Mississauga, Ontario, with visits to the Airport site as required. Your work schedule will be Monday to Friday during regular office or site hours. At times, operational needs may require work outside these hours, with reasonable notice provided. All schedule or on‑call adjustments will comply with applicable employment standards legislation. It is mandatory for all employees to complete a Criminal Background check and successfully attain a Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) upon joining the company.

DESIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, COMPETENCIES

  • Three to five or more years of hands-on SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business administration
  • Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience across the SharePoint admin centre, Teams files and OneDrive
  • Three or more years of solution design and information architecture experience on collaboration platforms
  • Demonstrated contribution to platform standards, design patterns or technology roadmaps, with migration planning experience preferred
  • Demonstrated experience governing permissions, sharing policy and external collaboration at enterprise scale
  • Practical build experience with Power Automate and Power Apps, with Power BI literacy considered an asset
  • PowerShell scripting, including PnP PowerShell, for bulk administration, reporting and Entra ID group management
  • Document management or records management experience gained in a structured, controlled document environment
  • Ticket-based service desk experience at L1 to L3, with strong customer service skills
  • Documentation discipline covering standard operating procedures, runbooks and change records kept current
  • Post-secondary education in information technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • Construction, engineering or major capital program experience, including support of large external-collaborator populations, preferred
  • Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, PL-400 or SC-400 preferred, with Autodesk Construction Cloud administration experience an asset
  • Exposure to SharePoint Premium / Syntex, Purview retention and sensitivity labels, or ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control environments considered an asset

PACT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free candidate experience and work environment. If you require accommodation to apply or if selected to participate in an assessment process, please advise Human Resources.

The role combines customer research, product design, overseas manufacturing, commercial decision-making, and post-launch performance management.
You will use evidence from reviews, search behavior, social content, surveys, interviews, and testing to determine what products should be built and how they should be positioned.
You will also establish a disciplined feedback loop between launch predictions and actual commercial results.
Alongside individual product ownership, you will lead a small team and shape the research, analysis, and scoring systems that support product decisions.
The position is fully remote, with flexibility around a required daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

Accountabilities

  • Own the complete product development lifecycle, from identifying customer needs and opportunities through product specification, manufacturing, launch, pricing, and post-launch performance.
  • Build and maintain a detailed understanding of target customers, including purchase motivations, customer segments, purchase occasions, price and quality perceptions, trust signals, complaints, and return drivers.
  • Use customer reviews, search behavior, social media, surveys, interviews, concept testing, and pricing research to generate actionable product insights and continuously validate assumptions.
  • Define and prioritize the new product pipeline, determining which opportunities should move forward, wait, or be discontinued based on customer and commercial evidence.
  • Own product and offer design decisions, including materials, construction, specifications, packaging, sizing, color assortment, and market positioning.
  • Manage product development with overseas factories and manufacturing partners, including specifications, samples, quality standards, and production requirements.
  • Monitor live products and lead continuous improvement initiatives, investigating negative feedback to identify root causes and determining when products should be redesigned, relaunched, expanded, or discontinued.
  • Establish a results-oriented feedback loop comparing launch forecasts and assumptions with actual product performance and using those learnings to improve future decisions.
  • Balance pricing, product costs, and expected margins when evaluating product and offer opportunities.
  • Lead and develop the product analysts and sourcing/production coordinator, set priorities, review their work, and raise the overall quality and effectiveness of the team.
  • Guide the development and use of research and scoring tools, including AI-supported workflows, while maintaining appropriate human oversight and validation.

    • Requirements:

    • Demonstrated experience developing and launching at least three physical consumer products sold to US consumers, with ownership of customer insights, product and offer decisions, and commercial results.
    • Experience launching at least one product primarily through an online channel, such as direct-to-consumer, Amazon, or another marketplace.
    • At least five years of experience within a consumer products company, brand, or retailer serving US consumers.
    • Evidence of making difficult product decisions based on customer insights, including having stopped, redesigned, or challenged a product or concept because of research or customer feedback.
    • Strong understanding of customer research methodologies, including interviews, surveys, concept testing, pricing tests, review analysis, and social listening, as well as the strengths and limitations of each approach.
    • Strong understanding of how US consumers evaluate products online, including imagery, reviews, ratings, pricing and price anchors, comparisons, and social proof.
    • Hands-on product development expertise covering specifications, materials, samples, quality standards, and manufacturing relationships, including overseas production.
    • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to evaluate price, cost, margin, customer value, and product quality together.
    • Experience leading at least three people, with a demonstrated ability to improve the quality and effectiveness of their work.
    • Practical experience using AI tools in research or product development, combined with appropriate human review and validation.
    • Excellent written English and the ability to communicate product insights, decisions, specifications, and recommendations clearly and precisely.
    • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment with required overlap from 9 AM to 1 PM US Eastern Time, while maintaining flexibility outside those hours.
    • This role is specifically focused on physical consumer products; backgrounds centered exclusively on software or digital product management, marketing or brand management without product ownership, sourcing or merchandising without customer and offer ownership, or product development exclusively for non-US markets are not aligned with the role.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position.
      • Flexible working schedule outside the required 9 AM–1 PM Eastern Time overlap.
      • Direct reporting relationship with the CEO and significant visibility within the organization.
      • End-to-end ownership of product development and commercial outcomes.
      • Opportunity to shape a newly created product development function and establish its processes, tools, and standards.
      • Leadership responsibility for a dedicated product and sourcing/production team.
      • Opportunity to work across customer research, product development, manufacturing, pricing, and commercial strategy.
      • Ability to use and shape AI-supported research and product development workflows.
      • International exposure through collaboration with overseas manufacturing partners.
