Primary Function: We are seeking an experienced and proactive Buyer to join our team! As a Buyer, you will be responsible for assisting in the purchasing of materials, supplies, and services at the most favorable terms for the organization. You will manage a dedicated supplier list, coordinate with vendors, track purchases, and ensure vendor quality while supporting internal and external stakeholders. You will also work with the company’s ERP system (Costpoint) to create and submit RFQs, convert PREQs to POs, and address supplier inquiries.

Communicate with suppliers regarding order status, expedite deliveries, and manage project coordination. 3. Oversee Open Purchase Orders and overdue POs, prioritizing work and managing order placement and follow-ups as needed. 4. Track and report on supplier performance, both individually and across top-line summaries, during daily, weekly, and monthly meetings. 5. Lead efforts to resolve supplier performance and delivery issues, acting as the primary interface between the organization and its suppliers. 6. Support cost reduction initiatives, contribute to revenue planning, and assist in identifying engineering solutions for alternative parts. 7. Assist in forecasting, bids support, and reporting activities. 8. Collaborate closely with the team of Buyers, Category Managers, and Purchasing Manager to develop strategies for improving supplier relationships and obtaining best-value solutions. 9. Continuously evaluate and improve internal processes to achieve efficiency in sourcing and purchasing. 10. Participate in cross-functional meetings to ensure information flows smoothly to internal customers.

Work Conditions: The employee will be working in an office setting and may be required to travel occasionally.

Job Requirements: Minimum Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in supply chain management or a similar role, preferably in a complex, low-volume industrial sector such as Aerospace or Defense.
  • Experience working with ERP systems, particularly Costpoint, is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in Excel and other data-driven tools, with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence others and foster strong supplier relationships.
  • Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, as well as part of a collaborative team.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on meeting deadlines.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience in evaluating bids, vendor performance, and cost reduction activities.

Preferred Requirements: • DoD Active Clearance • Understanding of aerospace contracts, materials, and technologies employed in large systems environments. • CIPS qualification or working towards it is an advantage. • Previous experience in a cross-functional team is a plus. • A valid driving license may be required for occasional travel

title: Project Enablers Lead
description:
Hames Sharley is a national interdisciplinary design practice specialising in Architecture, Interior Design, Town Planning and Urban Design. Our mission is to create sustainable and inclusive places that enable communities to flourish.

We are seeking a Project Enablers Lead to join our Sydney Studio located on Gadigal Land. The Project Enablers Lead plays a critical role in supporting our Project Leaders throughout the project lifecycle, from resource planning through to close-out. It ensures projects are set up for success by managing complex, sensitive and technology-driven technical processes that enable efficient project delivery.

Key Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate with Project Leaders and Studio Leaders to plan team capacity and maintain operational efficiency, and forecast future resource needs by analysing project scopes, programs and timelines.

  • Establish project foundations, including model setup, ACC configuration, workflows and project documentation.

  • Work as a hands-on member of assigned project teams, undertaking the complex, sensitive, high-skill or automation-dependent modelling and documentation tasks that would otherwise lead to resource burn.

  • Lead the development and ongoing refinement of the practice’s BIM and digital design systems, protocols, standards and policies, ensuring they align with the practice’s objectives and industry standards.

  • Coordinate and manage model reviews, clash detection and reporting through ACC Model Coordination and Navisworks, providing clear outcomes to Project Leaders.

  • Perform quality assessments on models and documentation before distribution, cross-checking markups received against completed work to verify completion.

  • Contribute to the practice’s design technology roadmap and inform software licensing needs and vendor discussions.

To be successful in this role, you should have the below skills set:

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in architecture or a closely related built environment discipline (architecture, engineering or construction).

  • Registration as an architect, or eligibility for registration, is desirable.

  • Preferred: 6-8+ years of relevant experience, however applications from candidates with less experience will also be considered.

  • Advanced in Revit

  • Proficient in Rhino, Grasshopper, Dynamo and Auto desk Forma

Why join Hames Sharley:

At Hames Sharley, you’ll join a practice that champions design excellence and creates places that make a meaningful difference in our communities. We foster an inclusive and supportive culture, with clear career progression pathways, flexible work arrangements, and the opportunity to work from our other studios across the country. Supported by progressive policies and beautiful CBD studio environments, it’s a place where your career can thrive while your work creates real impact.

As part of the Hames Sharley team, you’ll enjoy a range of benefits:

  • Funded Professional memberships

  • Flexible working options

  • HS+ Benefits including salary sacrificing, Access to paid parental leave, novated leasing etc.

Join us – apply below!

If you’re ready to join a collaborative team that is shaping the future of Australia’s built environment, we’d love to hear from you. We warmly encourage people of all cultures, backgrounds and genders to apply.

We acknowledge Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the continuous Traditional Custodians of the lands where we live and work. These lands have never been ceded. In doing so, we recognise an imperfect past. We commit to growing and contributing to a deeper understanding and learning of community and Country and a healed future, while promoting an amplified and equitable Australia that is culturally inclusive.

title: Senior Director Electronic Security Systems Engineering, Estimation & CAD
description:
Evolver is an information technology, cybersecurity, and digital transformation company supporting national defense, federal civilian agencies, and Fortune 500 organizations. We help customers secure critical systems, modernize enterprise technology, and solve complex operational challenges through integrated technology capabilities spanning cybersecurity, enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud, software development, data analytics, legal technology and eDiscovery, applied AI, and electronic security systems. Our teams combine deep technical expertise with mission understanding to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that advance performance in high-stakes environments.

Evolver seeking an accomplished Senior Director Electronic Security Systems Engineering, Estimation & CAD to lead the organization's electronic security systems engineering, estimation, technical design, and CAD functions. This position serves as the senior technical authority for developing, reviewing, pricing, and supporting the execution of complex integrated security solutions across federal, commercial, and critical-infrastructure environments.

This Senior Director will lead multidisciplinary teams throughout the project lifecycle, from opportunity development and estimating through design, installation, commissioning, acceptance testing, and closeout. The position works closely with Business Development, Operations, Project Management, Procurement, Field Services, and Executive Leadership to deliver technically sound, accurately estimated, constructible, compliant solutions aligned with customer mission requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Engineering, Estimation, and CAD functions, including staffing, resource allocation, budgeting, performance management, and professional development.
  • Establish and improve engineering standards, estimating methodologies, CAD conventions, quality procedures, review gates, performance metrics, and repeatable design processes.
  • Serve as the senior subject matter expert for complex electronic and physical security system designs and integrated system architectures.
  • Oversee and approve design packages, shop drawings, device and cable schedules, block and riser diagrams, network diagrams, wiring details, equipment layouts, sequences of operation, compliance matrices, test plans, and as-built documentation.
  • Direct estimating for federal, commercial, and critical-infrastructure opportunities, including labor, materials, equipment, subcontractor costs, travel, procurement strategy, and risk contingencies.
  • Review and approve designs, technical solutions, and estimates before proposal or customer submission.
  • Partner with Operations and Project Management to transition projects effectively from sales and engineering into installation and execution.
  • Support field teams during installation, integration, testing, commissioning, system acceptance, and project closeout.
  • Oversee engineering quality assurance, drawing control, design revisions, engineering changes, and installation compliance.
  • Support proposal development, customer presentations, design reviews, RFIs, ROM estimates, compliance responses, and technical evaluations.
  • Evaluate technologies, manufacturers, and system architectures to strengthen technical capabilities and improve customer outcomes.
  • Provide Executive Leadership with visibility into workload, staffing needs, estimating accuracy, design quality, project risk, and departmental performance.
  • Set, measure, and report goals for estimate accuracy, on-time design release, design quality, change-order drivers, utilization, backlog, and team development.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 10 years of experience in electronic security systems design, engineering, integration, installation, and implementation.
  • 8 years of leadership experience managing engineering, design, estimating, CAD, or technical services groups.
  • 3 years of experience leading large-scale federal, commercial, or critical-infrastructure security projects.
  • 5 years of experience with Solutions Engineering, Requirements-Driven Design, and Systems Engineering.
  • 5 years of experience supporting estimating, proposal development, engineering execution, field installation, commissioning, and project delivery.
  • 5 years of experience leading technical teams, balancing proposal and project priorities, and clearly communicating technical and commercial risks to executives and customers.
  • 5 years of experience with access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercom, and communications systems.
  • 5 years of experience with structured cabling, fiber-optic infrastructure, enterprise networking, routing, switching, and firewalls.
  • 5 years of experience with power distribution, UPS systems, and supporting data infrastructure.
  • 5 years of experience with engineering calculations for power loading, voltage drop, battery sizing, bandwidth, heat loading, conduit sizing, and rack planning.
  • 5 years of hands-on experience with platforms such as: Identiv/Hirsch, LenelS2, Software House C•CURE, Genetec, Avigilon, Honeywell Pro-Watch, Gallagher, Milestone, Bosch, Axis, Hanwha, DMP, Commend, Zenitel, Aiphone, and 2N is highly desirable.
  • 2 Years of experience with NEC and NFPA requirements, UL 294, UL 1076, UL 2050, NISPOM, ICD 705, Trade Agreements Act compliance, Buy America and Buy American requirements, Federal agency and customer-specific security standards

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong leadership, communication, customer engagement, technical problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Preferred experience includes AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Excel, electronic security estimating platforms, and enterprise resource planning and project management systems.
  • PSP, CPP, PMP, NICET, CSEIP, and relevant manufacturer certifications are preferred.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will build and lead a high-performing technical organization that consistently delivers accurate estimates, coordinated design packages, constructible solutions, effective field support, and compliant electronic security systems. This leader will connect Business Development, Engineering, Project Management, Operations, and field execution while advancing technical capabilities and supporting long-term growth.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Salary: $80,000 – $85,000 per year

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for bridging Australian Home Care operations, business requirements, software development, quality assurance, customer implementation and training. The position exists to ensure that CMP functionality is based on clearly understood operational requirements, complete and testable business rules, sound software specifications and practical customer outcomes. This is a specialist role rather than a conventional generic IT Business Analyst position. The successful person must combine substantial practical Home Care operational knowledge with strong business analysis, UAT, customer-facing, technology and training capability.

Key responsibilities

  • Analyse and document end-to-end Australian Home Care operational processes, including referral and intake, assessment, care planning, service planning, rostering, service delivery, client contributions, provider charges, budgets, funding, claiming, invoicing, statements, reconciliation, reporting, care management, client exits, changes in circumstances and exception handling
  • Develop and maintain Business Requirements Documents, Business Rules, Functional Requirements, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Process Maps, Workflow Specifications, Data Requirements, Exception Scenarios, Business Rule Matrices, Requirements Traceability Matrices and UAT requirements
  • Work directly with developers to explain requirements and business rules, review proposed solutions for alignment with business requirements, and identify gaps, unintended consequences, data implications and integration requirements
  • Design and execute comprehensive UAT covering positive, negative, boundary, exception, calculation, workflow, data integrity, permission, role and end-to-end scenarios
  • Act as a professional liaison between CMP and Home Care providers, conduct requirements discussions, demonstrate CMP functionality in terms of real provider workflows, and gather, assess and document customer feedback
  • Develop onboarding programs, user guides, process guides, quick-reference guides, presentations, FAQs, knowledge-base content, demonstration scripts, exercises and workflow explanations
  • Conduct product demonstrations for prospective and existing providers, explaining why a function is required, what information is entered, how information flows through the system, and what downstream operational or financial impacts may occur
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve product functionality, business processes, customer experience, onboarding, training, UAT, requirements documentation, quality controls and operational workflows
  • Own the quality and completeness of assigned business analysis deliverables and challenge requirements, proposed solutions or test outcomes where evidence indicates they do not satisfy the business need
  • Escalate unresolved business-rule, compliance, customer or product risks to the appropriate CMP decision-maker

About you

  • Substantial practical experience in the Australian Home Care sector, including genuine operational experience rather than only general aged-care knowledge
  • Demonstrated business analysis experience covering requirements gathering, process analysis, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, functional requirements and traceability
  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop and execute meaningful UAT
  • Experience working directly with customers, providers, stakeholders or operational users
  • Strong IT literacy across SaaS applications, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, data concepts, web applications, workflow systems, screen-recording/video tools and software development teams
  • Demonstrated ability to develop training and explain complex software processes clearly to non-technical users
  • Exceptional written communication and documentation skills
  • Analytical and methodical; able to break complex operational requirements into precise rules and system requirements
  • Self-directed, accountable and capable of progressing work without continuous supervision
  • Collaborative, respectful and professional when dealing with customers and colleagues

About us

Carer Manager Plus Pty Ltd (CMP) is a growing technology company providing software solutions for the Australian Home Care sector.

title: Privacy Counsel
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Privacy Counsel to join our Legal team. You'll counsel on complex privacy issues and build the processes and programs that address privacy and data protection in a global context. This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team, where you will have the chance to shape the company's privacy and data protection strategy and compliance program.

You will work at the intersection of novel legal questions, fast-moving product development, and a high-profile regulatory environment, partnering cross-functionally with Legal, Integrity & Compliance, Safeguards, Security, Policy, Research and Product.

Key responsibilities

  • Counsel product, research and engineering teams across the model and product lifecycles, applying laws written before frontier AI with clarity and fresh thinking
  • Translate complex technical architecture into clear, actionable risk advice
  • Deliver integrated guidance on safety, security and data protection
  • Lead privacy on Anthropic's most strategic deals and partnerships, opening creative paths for novel technologies
  • Negotiate privacy and data protection terms in enterprise, platform and partnership commercial agreements, including DPAs, BAAs, data sharing agreements and cross-border transfer terms
  • Lead privacy diligence on mergers and acquisitions, and support corporate governance
  • Collaborate closely with counsel and privacy colleagues on joint analysis, bringing competing views together into a single, well-reasoned position

Minimum qualifications

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar
  • Hands-on experience advising a technology business (in-house or at a leading law firm) on privacy and data protection
  • Experience drafting and negotiating data protection agreements, such as DPAs, BAAs and data sharing agreements
  • Working knowledge of key global privacy laws, including those of the Americas, EEA and APAC
  • Ability to read and engage with technical documentation, such as system designs and architecture diagrams
  • Excellent legal writing, including clear, concise advice

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 8 years of privacy and data protection legal experience
  • Deep familiarity with software and model development and architecture
  • Proven ability to build privacy processes, playbooks and templates that scale with a fast-growing business
  • Direct engagement with privacy regulators, including providing briefings and responding to inquiries
  • Privacy and data protection work on mergers, acquisitions, and similar transactions
  • Background advising safety, security or trust and safety teams, including on privacy incidents and notification decisions

Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$265,000—$335,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Overview

The Office of Strategic Analysis is Yale’s internal management consultancy and works on some of the most complex strategic opportunities and challenges facing Yale. The team provides guidance and analysis that enables University leaders (president, provost, deans, VPs) to make decisions that best advance Yale’s mission. The team works across all areas of the University’s mission.

The Strategic Analysis team is led by the Director, Strategic Analysis, and reports to the Senior Associate Provost for Strategy and Data Analysis. The team consists of the Director, the Associate Director, and six Swensen Fellows. The Swensen Fellowship is a 2-year consulting analyst program in the Office of Strategic Analysis, staffed by graduates of both Yale College and graduate programs at Yale.

Reporting to the Director, the Associate Director will serve as a member of the Strategic Analysis leadership team and will be expected to work as a close partner to the Director in managing the team’s portfolio of projects. The Associate Director will manage the first-year Swensen Fellows, holding accountability for outstanding project results and stewarding the first-year Swensen Fellows’ professional development and growth. The Associate Director will also directly support their own projects from time to time, typically those that are more complex or fast-moving, as an individual contributor. The Director will provide regular feedback to the Associate Director on their portfolio of projects and support the Associate Director’s professional development.

Success in the Associate Director role will be measured with respect to two primary outcomes: project results that advance Yale’s mission and development of first-year Swensen Fellows into exceptional consultants capable of themselves driving results. The Associate Director will bring a strong analytical and problem-solving skillset to a broad range of client needs, an aptitude for client relationship-building and driving project outcomes, and a proven ability to mentor and inflect the professional development of others.

title: BI Engineer
description:
Looking for a BI Engineer who wants ownership over reporting that actually gets used. This role owns the dbt-built data layer and Power BI semantic models behind commercial reporting - diagnosing issues, shipping fixes, and levelling up how the business sees its own numbers.

  • Advanced SQL and dimensional modelling
  • Hands-on production experience with dbt

description:

Meet the Smart Safety Company

At Safe Fleet our name says it all. We make fleet vehicles – and everyone in and around them – safer. Our fleet safety platform brings together best-in-class products, ground-breaking technology, and a 100-year history of fleet know-how and innovation to solve the world’s biggest fleet safety problems.

Our core value is safety. Without safety first, efficiency and productivity are not possible. This is true for our products, our culture, and our relationship with our community. Our vision is to reduce preventable deaths and injuries in and around fleet vehicles with a goal of ZERO accidents.

We are re-defining what safety means for fleets of every type – from school buses to waste collection trucks, firefighting to utility vehicles, police cruisers to delivery vans.

Whether you work in our Charlotte plant to build life-saving stop arms for school buses, or design advanced camera vision products in our Vancouver office, forge valves and high-quality nozzles to fight fires, or dream up new ways to protect fleet operators in our Corporate HQ in Kansas City, you’ll contribute to our goal to keep everyone safe.

Position Summary

As an Electronics Engineer, you will lead the design and development of telematics and sensing products from concept through production. You will serve as the technical expert for PCB design and layout, driving hardware architecture, design verification, regulatory compliance, and manufacturing readiness. Working closely with cross-functional teams and external development partners, you will solve complex engineering challenges, support product launches, investigate field issues, and contribute to the development of next-generation connected device technologies.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design telematics and sensory devices, and solve the engineering problems that come up as they move from prototype into production, including whether they can be built at volume.
  • Be the team's expert on PCB layout. Set the layout standards, review other engineers' boards against them, and mentor the people doing the work.
  • Oversee hardware development at our ODM partner. Hold their designs to our requirements, confirm they have been verified, and check compliance against performance, reliability, safety, and regulatory targets.
  • Write and review product requirements, then design to the performance and regulatory specifications they set.
  • Design printed circuit boards and work with Mechanical Design Engineering to produce PCBA drawings and the bill of materials.
  • Work with Project Engineering to set the timelines and tasks.
  • Write and execute Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R), review the test results, and close out corrective actions.
  • Provide technical design support to customer-facing groups, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality.
  • Resolve component supply problems for Procurement or Manufacturing and qualify replacement parts or redesign around them.
  • Troubleshoot field issues and warranty failures, find the root cause, and see the corrective action through.
  • Track new semiconductor technology and propose what it makes possible in our products.


Compensation: $100,000 - $115,000/yr CAD

﻿

﻿﻿The final offer will be determined based on a combination of factors including skills, experience, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities.

  • Candidates at the lower end of the range will meet the core qualifications and demonstrate strong potential to grow within the role.
  • Mid-range offers reflect a solid match with the role’s technical and collaborative requirements.
  • Offers at the top of the range are reserved for candidates who bring exceptional qualifications, specialized expertise, or unique value that significantly exceeds the baseline expectations

Our core values of integrity, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and safety guide our efforts to provide a workplace where all employees can thrive and reach their full potential.

﻿

Requirements

  • Proven hardware design experience with demonstrable products that you can discuss in detail.

  • Passport and ability to travel to Canada required.
  • Experience with electrical harness and system design preferred.
  • Experience with RF - Developing products using BLE, Wi-Fi and Cellular protocols.
  • Experience with Altium software preferred.

title: GTM & CS Ops Engineer
description:
Why This Role Exists:

Most companies split revenue systems work into two roles: a GTM Engineer who instruments and automates the front of the funnel and a CS Operations Engineer who does the same for everything after the customer says yes. Splitting them is usually how the seam gets created - gaiia doesn’t have that seam yet and this role exists to keep it that way. Instead of pipeline data living one way and customer data living another way, reconciled by hand where a deal closes, this person splits time between the GTM team (data, scoring, automations) and the CS team (handoffs, delivery, visibility) so both sides work off the same clean data and signals from day one. This isn’t a purely behind-the-scenes systems role - this person also carries some direct pipeline generation responsibility. Using the same signals and tools they build and maintain to directly influence pipeline build.

What You're Going to Do:

1. Go-to-Market Operations

  • Support the design and upkeep of lead and account scoring models, incorporating new signals - intent, engagement, technographic, trigger events (funding, hiring, leadership changes, etc.) - as they become available.
  • Track how scores correlate with actual outcomes (pipeline, win rates, cycle time) and flag when signals stop being predictive.
  • Maintain and continuously audit data quality across systems and tools - catch drift, duplicates, and gaps before they break a report or handoff, not after.
  • Document the sales process, train against it, and follow through until it is actually adopted.
  • Leverage signals to build micro-campaigns that directly correlate to pipeline generation.
  • Carry a direct pipeline generation target - use scoring models, enrichment and signals you build to directly influence pipeline generation.

2. Systems and Automation

  • Build and refine automated enrichment flows so account and contact records stay complete without manual list-building.
  • Build and maintain lead routing, sequence triggers, task creation and stakeholder notifications across the GTM stack.
  • Own the orchestration layer connecting HubSpot, Clay, Gong, and Amplemarket so records move and update automatically instead of being re-entered by hand between tools - including into the handoff records CS depends on.
  • Instrument the lifecycle so stage transitions, ownership changes, and milestones are captured as data rather than reconstructed later.
  • Document how automations work so they stay maintainable and never depend on any one person.

3. Customer Success and Delivery Operations

  • Define and enforce the handoff standard so CSMs and PMO inherit complete, structured context instead of chasing the AE.
  • Build assignment and routing logic across lifecycle stages so no account sits unclaimed between teams.
  • Stand up a working change order process so scope movement after signature gets recorded and priced rather than absorbed.
  • Give PMO the capacity and resourcing view needed to plan staffing against pipeline instead of reacting.
  • Surface adoption and delivery signals into account plans so CSMs see risk and expansion early rather than at renewal.

4. Reporting & Forecasting

  • Build the forecasting mechanics needed to accurately predict achievement
  • Build the models to drive future pipeline and revenue goals
  • Build the standard status and cycle time reporting that gives leadership visibility without a status meeting.
  • Maintain the internal documentation layer so process knowledge lives in a system rather than in people's heads.
  • Assist with compensation planning, models and payouts

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or a similar systems-facing GTM role, ideally within B2B SaaS.
  • Hands-on CRM administration: workflows, custom properties, data model design, and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills - able to build the reporting view rather than request it.
  • Proven ability to design a cross-team process, document it, get people to follow it and hold that standard with a sales team without becoming a blocker.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong judgment about what to fix or automate before being asked.
  • Excellent communications skills, comfortable working with sales, CS, PMO and leadership teams as partners
  • Hands on experience with Clay and Hubspot

Nice-to-have:

  • Exposure to outbound engagement platforms (Amplemarket).
  • Experience building a sales to post-sales handoff process from scratch at a company under 200 people.
  • SQL or reporting fluency beyond dashboard configuration.
  • Experience in telecom or OSS/BSS domains.

Benefits:

  • Flexible 25-days of vacation.
  • Stock Options Plan.
  • Group Insurance.
  • Flexible working hours & all-remote work.


We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Our workplace is fully remote and boasts accessible technologies, ensuring all team members can thrive. Should you require accommodations due to a disability during the application process, please contact us at (418) 317-9497‬ or people@gaiia.com as per the Accessible Canada Act and human rights legislation. We're here to support you every step of the way. #LI-DNI

description:
Deep-Water Intake Group,
a joint venture of multiple subsidiaries of the VINCI Group, construction worldwide leader, specialized in the design and construction of major civil engineering and building works in Canada is hiring an


Document Controller


What is the project?


The Pickering Nuclear Generating Station refurbishment program involves designing and building a new deep-water intake in Lake Ontario to improve the plant's cooling system. This will involve:

  • A5 km-long tunnel, built by a pressurized TBM (10.5 m diameter slurry TBM);
  • Two vertical shafts (onshore and offshore);
  • An offshore modular intake structure, resting on the lake bed.


The project is distinguished by its proximity to an active nuclear site, requiring rigorous standards of safety, planning and coordination.


What you will do:



The Document Controller implements, manages and ensures the control of documents in the EDMS ensuring their security, accessibility, and distribution. They will ensure the data is accurate and complete for use by construction personnel throughout the project.


Concretely your tasks will be:

  • Manage the document management process in EDMS parameterization (workflow, codification, architecture, interfaces with Designer, Client...).

  • Ensure that internal document controls procedures are established and followed.
  • Distribute electronic documents, submittals, transmittals, and correspondence to defined recipients.
  • Compile and maintain control of records and related files to release reports, drawings, and engineering documents to production and other operating departments.
  • Examine documents, such as drawings, procedures, management plans, reports, change orders, and specifications for general completeness and accuracy of data.
  • Post changes to documents, especially construction drawings and related construction documents to maintain the most up-do-date construction documents for use by construction personnel (internal field personnel, client, and lower-tier contractors).
  • Assists and works in conjunction with the Document Control Team for the efficient operation and maintenance of the document management system.

  • 5-7 years of experience in document control
  • Proven experience designing, implementing and managing inclusive DEI programs
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, administration, or related fields

  • Construction industry (large infrastructure projects) experience

  • Autonomous, organized and attention to detail (record-keeping and filing discipline)
  • Heightened ability to work under deadlines

  • Group Health Insurance (premium participation including virtual health care system);

title: Litigation Counsel
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Legal team is looking for an experienced litigator to join our Litigation and Regulatory team. You'll manage a broad docket of litigation files and pre-litigation disputes with a high degree of autonomy, advise the business on litigation risk, and help build the systems and processes that let a growing litigation function operate well at scale.

The matters you'll handle span intellectual property (particularly copyright), class actions, commercial disputes, and could include securities and shareholder disputes, in both first-party and third-party matters, in the U.S. and abroad. You'll partner closely with colleagues across Legal and teams throughout the company to resolve matters thoughtfully and with minimal disruption to the business. You may also support regulatory investigations and inquiries as needed.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage a broad range of litigation matters that could include intellectual property (particularly copyright) matters, class actions, regulatory and commercial disputes, and securities cases
  • Direct outside counsel across all stages of litigation, from pre-suit response through discovery, dispositive briefing, trial or resolution and appeal, with a focus on strategic decision-making and filing excellent legal briefs
  • Manage small disputes and escalations to limit business friction and minimize risk
  • Advise company leadership and cross-functional partners on litigation risk, and develop appropriate strategic litigation plans, including matter-resolution proposals
  • Design and implement processes, policies, and tools that help the litigation and regulatory team handle matters efficiently and at scale, such as matter intake, outside counsel budgeting, contingency reporting, and pre-litigation escalation run books
  • Work cross-functionally to gather information efficiently and evaluate risk
  • Support responses to regulatory investigations and inquiries as needed
  • Stay up to date on relevant laws, litigation trends, and AI-related case law, and share developments with key stakeholders
  • Mentor and develop team members through hands-on work on active matters

Minimum qualifications

  • Hold a JD and are an active member of at least one U.S. state bar (California preferred)
  • Have litigated some combination of copyright, class action, securities, and regulatory matters
  • Have broad experience handling complex civil litigation, with deep knowledge of litigation practice and procedure, discovery, and federal and/or CA state court rules
  • Have managed litigation matters with significant independence, including setting case strategy, managing discovery, writing and improving legal briefs, and directing outside counsel
  • Write and communicate clearly, with the ability to explain litigation risk and strategy, particularly for non-legal audiences at all levels of seniority
  • Exhibit poise and judgment under pressure while balancing legal risk with business priorities

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 12 years of litigation experience with a combination of experience at a global-focused law firm and in-house
  • Experience representing technology companies, particularly companies working in emerging technologies
  • Experience building systems, processes, or tools for an in-house legal team, such as matter management, outside counsel budgeting, or litigation reporting
  • Experience managing regulatory responses or investigations, including both first-party and third-party responses
  • Creativity and openness to novel solutions when advancing business priorities while addressing legal risk
  • Ability to think and work quickly, have a flexible risk tolerance, and a good sense of humor
  • Low ego and a real willingness to roll up your sleeves to solve problems whether mundane or complex
  • A thoughtful and empathetic colleague who works well with legal colleagues, outside counsel, and business partners
  • A genuine interest in the development of AI that is both innovative and trustworthy, including the opportunities it creates and the risks and limitations that must be addressed


Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$385,000—$460,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:

This position will also perform routine X-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. Also will ensure that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

X-ray Technician Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety

  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director

Medical Support Specialist Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including taking vital signs and any required or requested ancillary testing including but not limited to vaccines and injections, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiogram testing and respirator fit testing
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.)
  • Assist providers during examination and treatment
  • Responsible for performing routine medical procedures as ordered by treating clinician as well as triaging emergent patients as needed
  • Prepare and assist clinician with procedure set up and injury care
  • Apply bandages, dressings and splints as ordered by the treating clinician
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered by the treating clinician in accordance with state regulations
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and medical devices as well as testing processes used in the center
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms and equipment, and stock exam rooms
  • Maintain and operate all medical devices and equipment, including calibration and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures
  • Notify supervisor immediately if equipment is not functioning properly, supplies are needed, or facility is not operating as expected
  • In partnership with center leadership, assist with patient flow and volume
  • Keep patients informed of expected wait times during all aspects of the center visit
  • Responsible for clerical tasks in both the front and back office associated with patient care and proper record keeping
  • Ensure accuracy in documentation
  • Perform front office duties: greet patients, obtain authorization, check in/out, communicate wait times, answer multi-line telephone system, and distribute employer results/paperwork as needed
  • Follow HIPAA guidelines and safety rules
  • Attend center staff meetings or huddles as required
  • Assist in maintaining a neat, clean, and orderly appearance throughout the facility
  • Complete any applicable training including but not limited to clinical competency training that occurs monthly.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

description:

Basketball - Elementary School

Part-time, non-exempt, non-benefitted position

Open until filled. Application screening will begin immediately.

Anticipated start date is 11/2/26.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

General Statement of Duties: Provide instruction, leadership and supervision to participants in athletic programs. Lead skill workouts, practices and competitions in an organized structure; does related work as required.

Distinguishing Features of the Class: An employee in this classification is responsible for coaching and teaching youth and adults in athletic programs. Work is under the general supervision of the Recreation Supervisor, who reviews work primarily based on results attained and on the accomplishment of outlined objectives and goals. Supervision is not normally a responsibility of positions in this classification; however, incumbents are responsible for confirming participation paperwork is received and schedules are distributed.

Examples Of Essential Duties Performed: (Illustrative only. Any single position of a class will not necessarily involve all of the duties listed, and many positions will involve duties that are not listed.)

  • Assumes primary responsibilities for program-assigned tasks including, but not limited to, planning, organizing and scheduling of practice and games for participants.
  • Assumes primary responsibilities to secure practice areas are safe and absent of all hazards and non-approved individuals.
  • Report all participant injuries at practice and competition to the Recreation Supervisor.
  • Provides first aid care as necessary.
  • Carry necessary paperwork including emergency forms, medical and parent/guardian information to all practices and competitions.
  • Ensure locker rooms are checked and cleaned on a daily basis.
  • Oversee students leaving competition site with a parent or guardian and secure the students are signed out when applicable.
  • Attend all coaches meetings and trainings necessary to facilitate program.
  • Perform other job-related duties or tasks as required.



DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS:

Knowledge: Considerable knowledge of methods involved in coordinating, scheduling and implementing a program of recreational activities, coaching methods and techniques, skills and safety precaution involved in athletic programs, and record keeping; knowledge of computers and basic word processing.

Skills: First Aid and CPR


Abilities: Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing; work successfully with youth, parents, co-workers and supervisor; work independently; act calmly and effectively in emergency situations.


Physical Demands of Position: While performing the duties of this position, the employee is frequently required to sit, stand, bend, kneel, stoop, communicate, reach, and manipulate objects. The position requires mobility including the ability to move materials weighing up to 25 pounds on a regular basis such as sports equipment, uniforms, and written materials. Manual dexterity and coordination are required over 25% of the work period while working with youth in activities. Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this class with reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis and depends, in part, on the specific requirements for the job, the limitations related to the disability and the ability of the hiring department to accommodate the limitation.

Required Experience and Training: High school graduation or equivalency and four years of experience in community education, parks and recreation, or related area which included working closely with youth and the general public; or any satisfactory combination of experience and training which demonstrates the knowledge, skills and ability to perform above-described duties.

Preferred Experience and Training: Individuals bilingual in Spanish or ASL are encouraged to apply; a bilingual rate adjustment for Spanish or ASL is contingent upon passing a proficiency test.

Necessary Special Requirements: Concussion certification. Possession of current First Aid, AED and CPR certificates. Because this job is considered safety sensitive, a drug screen test will be required prior to employment. Must be at least 16 years of age.

Drug Free Workplace

title: Head of Contracts
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Head of Contracts to lead the company’s Contracts function and serve as the senior subject matter expert for federal contracting and acquisition matters. This director-level role will manage JMA’s federal prime contracts and subcontracts, support commercial and technology-related agreements, and advise leadership on contractual risk, acquisition strategy, and compliance. The role will work closely with the Executive Vice President and partners across Business Development, Delivery, Finance, Technology, Innovation/R&D, and outside counsel


Responsibilities:

  • Federal Contracts & Subcontracts
    • Serve as JMA’s primary contracts resource for significant contractual matters involving federal customers, prime contractors, subcontractors, and teaming partners.
    • Review solicitations and proposal terms and identify contractual requirements and risks before submission.
    • Draft, review, negotiate, and administer prime contracts, subcontracts, task orders, modifications, teaming agreements, NDAs, and related agreements.
    • Manage contract activities throughout the lifecycle, including award, funding, scope changes, options, amendments, disputes, and closeout.
    • Provide guidance on FAR, DFARS, agency supplements, flow-down requirements, cost and pricing requirements, and other federal contracting requirements.
    • Support audits, fact-finding, government reviews, and contract-related compliance inquiries while maintaining complete and accurate contract records.
  • Acquisition Strategy & Growth
    • Partner with Business Development and leadership during the pursuit process to identify contractual, acquisition, and teaming considerations.
    • Provide guidance on acquisition approaches, contract vehicles, contract types, subcontracting structures, teaming arrangements, and other factors that may affect an opportunity.
    • Review priority opportunities for contractual and acquisition risks before proposal submission.
    • Support strategic teaming arrangements, partnerships, and negotiations.
    • Support contract-related due diligence for potential acquisitions and other strategic transactions.
  • Commercial Agreements, Intellectual Property & Technology
    • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, including master services, supplier, sales, distribution, reseller, SaaS, licensing, and other technology-related agreements.
    • Develop and maintain standard contract terms, templates, negotiation positions, and escalation procedures.
    • Review agreements involving software, technology, intellectual property, and technical data rights.
    • Coordinate with outside counsel when specialized legal support is needed.
    • Support JMA’s contractual needs as its technology, product, and innovation work develops.
  • Contracts Compliance & Operations
    • Lead and continue to develop JMA’s Contracts function, including policies, procedures, templates, approval practices, and contract-management processes.
    • Maintain current knowledge of FAR, DFARS, applicable agency supplements, ITAR/EAR, and other requirements relevant to JMA’s contracting environment.
    • Identify contractual and compliance risks and provide clear recommendations to leadership.
    • Establish appropriate escalation processes for contractual matters requiring executive leadership or outside legal counsel.
    • Provide leadership and internal stakeholders with clear guidance on complex contractual and acquisition matters.
    • Carry out other related duties as assigned to support evolving customer and company needs.

Clearance Level:

  • Current or ability to obtain a Department of Defense (DoD) clearance. Note: To obtain a security clearance, you must be a U.S. citizen and meet the 13 adjudicative guidelines.



Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in federal government contracts.
    • Experience supporting Department of Defense and/or other federal government contracting organizations.
    • Demonstrated experience with federal prime contracts, subcontracts, teaming agreements, NDAs, and related agreements.
    • Experience working with multiple federal contract types, including FFP, T&M, cost-reimbursement, IDIQ, and task-order environments.
  • Education/Certification:
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Skills:
    • Strong working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, and federal procurement requirements.
    • Strong contract review, interpretation, drafting, and negotiation skills.
    • Ability to identify contractual and compliance risks and provide practical recommendations.
    • Ability to work independently and manage complex contractual matters with appropriate judgment.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex contractual and acquisition matters clearly to business leaders and other stakeholders.
    • Ability to work effectively across Business Development, Delivery, Finance, Technology, and other areas of the business.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 15 or more years of federal government contracts or acquisition experience.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or prior experience supporting government contracts in a legal capacity.
  • Prior experience with a federal government contractor, federal agency, or law firm supporting government contractors.
  • Prior experience as a federal Contracting Officer, acquisition professional, government contracts attorney, or senior contracts professional.
  • DAWIA certification, NCMA credential, or comparable federal acquisition certification.
  • Navy and/or Department of Defense contracting experience.
  • Experience supporting small businesses participating in federal socioeconomic programs.
  • Experience supporting contract-related due diligence, novation's, organizational conflicts of interest, or other complex federal contracting matters.
  • Experience with intellectual property, technical data rights, software licensing, SaaS, or commercial technology agreements.
  • Familiarity with CMMC and federal cybersecurity contractual requirements.
  • Experience establishing or improving Contracts processes, systems, and procedures.


Location & Commitments:

  • Position: Full Time
  • Work Arrangement:
    • Hybrid – Employees who live more than 50 miles from JMA’s Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania headquarters are required to work onsite one week per month.
  • Travel Requirements: May be required
  • Location Preference: Prefer candidates within a 50-mile radius of Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania.
  • Work Hours: A typical workday consists of eight hours, totaling a forty-hour workweek. We understand that there may be times when employees will need to adjust their work hours due to client needs or personal reasons. To help balance these demands, we offer some flexibility in work schedules.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and discretionary bonuses.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and holidays to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Hybrid/remote work arrangement with flexible hours.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Employee recognition programs and company events.

title: Universal Banker - Anna
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION

Accepts retail banking transactions from customers, including deposits of cash and/or checks, check cashing, loan payments, cashier's checks, etc. In the course of accepting these transactions, examines checks for proper endorsements, verifies legality of documents, and ensures positive identification of customers. Opens new accounts accurately and in compliance with bank policies and procedures. Accepts loan applications. Prepares and reviews all loan documentation for new and renewed consumer and commercial loans in a timely and efficient manner. Performs other services for customers as needed.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Accepts cash and check transaction deposits, cashes checks, takes loan payments, and sells cashier's checks. During the course of processing these transactions, examines checks for proper endorsements, verifies legality of documents and makes positive identification of customers. Assists customers with running coin through coin counters and exchanging for credit. Records all transactions promptly, accurately and in compliance with bank procedures. Balances currency, coin, checks in cash drawers and assists with ATM balancing as applicable. Answers customer inquiries regarding interest rates, accounts, and products and services. Resolves customer issues with transaction discrepancies. Performs services for customers including address changes, issuance of debit cards, submission of debit card disputes, issuance of on-line banking sign-on credentials and helping with sign-on issues, ordering checks, and processing stop payments. Opens new accounts accurately and in compliance with bank policies and procedures. Build relationships with customers and non-customers, offering products and services that are best suited for their needs. Make referrals to other departments such as new accounts, treasury management, loans, mortgage, trust and wealth management services. Participate in activities to generate new business including business calls and attending and/or working at special events. Represent the bank at community events and civic organizations. Maintain a working knowledge of all bank products and services. Accept and process consumer and commercial loan applications, assisting with full loan origination process. Provide assistance with any other loan duties as needed. Serve as a subject matter expert for customers and/or other employees regarding bank products and services.

title: Insights and Measurement Consultant, Amazon Ads
description:
Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising, offering unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We offer advertisers premium brand placements on our owned and operated properties, including Prime Video ads, Twitch, and a rich slate of retail media solutions.

As an Insights and Measurement Consultant, you will work as an individual contributor to accelerate our advertising business growth in the Benelux and Nordics regions. With Prime Video's launch in Netherlands and Sweden, you'll have a pivotal role in shaping the streaming TV and video landscape in the region. You will lead Ad measurement discussions, create actionable insights, and present clear recommendations to executive stakeholders.

• Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, third-party research, and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights
• Own senior-level measurement and insights customer relationships, partnering across strategic learning objectives that influence business decision-making
• Collaborate cross-functionally to influence sales and marketing initiatives across multiple business functions and geographies
• Advocate for data-driven decision-making and guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions


A day in the life
On a daily basis, the Insights and Measurement Lead performs hands-on data extraction and analysis using SQL and Python, leveraging Amazon measurement solutions to build insights and track success metrics for advertisers' businesses and industries. The role requires developing data-driven recommendations for executive client leadership and communicating those insights in a clear and compelling manner.


About the team
The Analytics & Insights (A&I) organization leverages Amazon's data to develop actionable insights for advertisers, enhancing marketers' decision-making and measurably improving their success both on and off Amazon.

Docusign brings agreements to life. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



We are building a cutting-edge ecosystem for Docusign that will empower developers to seamlessly integrate and extend Docusign's features and applications by implementing custom APIs. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for leading medium to large initiatives and scaling the Developer platform, ensuring that it is robust, secure, and easy to use for builders looking to plug into Docusign's growing IAM ecosystem.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, driving platform architecture and feature development. Your work will impact multiple engineering and product teams as you lead the development of the platform's foundational features. Additionally, guiding architectural decisions, and managing incident response processes that require being on rotational on-call, and coordination both within the team and other teams within the organization.

description:

This is a senior product leadership opportunity focused on building analytics products that help app businesses make better monetization decisions.
You will own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for a suite of analytics capabilities, including dashboards, charts, benchmarking, and predictive LTV.
The role combines product strategy with deep analytical and technical problem-solving in a highly data-driven environment.
You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to turn complex data into actionable customer insights.
You will also investigate data issues, develop meaningful metrics and benchmarks, and identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
The position offers significant autonomy, with responsibility for making product decisions, experimenting rapidly, and delivering measurable business impact.
You will join a fully remote, international environment where ownership, customer focus, systems thinking, and a strong bias toward shipping are highly valued.

  • Own the product strategy, vision, roadmap, and prioritization for the analytics product portfolio, ensuring initiatives are cohesive, scalable, and aligned with broader product objectives.
  • Lead the development and evolution of analytics capabilities, including charts, dashboards, benchmarking, metrics, and predictive lifetime value features.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their needs, investigate complex analytics and data problems, distinguish meaningful signals from noise, and translate insights into impactful product opportunities.
  • Develop, recommend, and maintain benchmarks and metrics that help app developers understand performance, identify opportunities, and improve monetization.
  • Act as a key point of expertise when data or metrics appear incorrect, investigating underlying causes and edge cases rather than relying solely on engineering teams.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, data science, design, leadership, and go-to-market teams to evaluate feasibility, define solutions, and bring robust analytics and experimentation capabilities to market.
  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, breaking complex initiatives into meaningful deliverables and realistic timelines.
  • Drive product discovery, experimentation, and delivery while balancing quality, customer value, technical complexity, and speed of execution.
  • Independently make product decisions within your area, contribute to broader product strategy, and identify new opportunities to create customer and business value.
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and help teams develop deeper customer empathy and understanding of industry trends.
  • Continuously evaluate product performance and be willing to discontinue or rethink initiatives when evidence shows they are not delivering the expected value.
  • During the first year, establish ownership of your product area, deliver meaningful customer impact, develop a longer-term product vision, and contribute to the evolution of the overall product strategy.

    • 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, with significant experience delivering complex products from concept through launch.

    • Strong understanding of analytics products, data visualization, metrics, experimentation, and how data can be translated into actionable insights.
    • A strong customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and turn feedback into scalable product solutions.

    • Systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to move beyond individual customer requests and design solutions that scale across products and users.
    • Strong attention to product and user experience details, including a passion for high-quality data visualization and the ability to connect visual presentation with meaningful insights.
    • Pragmatic approach to product development, balancing a high standard of quality with a strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and iteration.

description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Escalations Resolution External 팀은 쿠팡을 이용하면서 발생하는 CS 최상위 민원(High risk) 을 중재하고 해결합니다.
더불어 CS와 관련된 소비자 중재기관, 규제기관 민원을 대응하며, 민원해결 과정에서 발견된 문제의 재발방지 및 구조적 개선을 실현하고 전체에 적용하여 고객과 회사의 Risk Management를 실현합니다.

업무 내용

  • CS 최상위 민원(High risk) 민원을 중재하고 해결
  • 소비자 중재 기관, 규제 기관의 민원 대응
  • 민원해결 과정에서 발견된 문제의 재발 방지/구조적 개선
  • 개선된 내용을 고객센터 전체에 적용하여 고객 경험을 개선
  • 발생한 문제에 대한 해결을 넘어선 고객 경험을 고려한 Risk Management 실현

자격 요건

  • CS민원 대응 업무 3년 이상(민원 담당자 경험)이 있으신 분
  • 이커머스 업무 경험이 있으신 분
  • 소비자 기관에 대한 이해 및 소비자기관 CS 공문에 대한 문서 답변 경험이 있으신 분
  • 민원 해결과정에서 고객과 회사의 리스크를 감지하실 수 있는 분

우대 사항

  • 규제기관 민원 대응 경험이 있으신 분
  • 전자상거래법 및 소비자 관련 법률에 대한 지식이 있으신 분
  • IT 시스템에 대한 구조를 이해하고 어려워하지 않는 분
  • 새로운 것을 배우기를 즐기시는 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.
