title: Senior Digital Product Designer
description:
Salary: Competitive | Benefits including gym

About Fitness & Lifestyle Group

Fitness & Lifestyle Group (FLG) is Asia Pacific's largest group of corporately owned health and wellness clubs — 310+ locations, 600,000+ members, and five of the region's most recognised fitness brands: Fitness First Australia, Goodlife Health Clubs, Jetts Fitness, Zap Fitness and Barry's.

We're headquartered in Australia with regional offices across South East Asia, and we're on a mission to help our global community live stronger, happier lives.


The Opportunity

Own the digital journey from discovering a club to becoming a member. As Senior Digital Product Designer (Ecommerce), you will lead the design and optimisation of our web experiences across Goodlife, Fitness First, Zap and Jetts, with a clear focus on making our value proposition compelling and converting interest into membership.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for an experienced product designer who can hit the ground running. You will design web pages, ecommerce journeys and reusable components, bringing them to life through Contentful and our development teams. You will rethink how we communicate the value of our products, memberships and offers online, making complex information easier to understand and helping customers confidently choose the right option.

You will work closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, club teams and our offshore development partner, leading workshops, challenging assumptions and turning customer and business problems into effective digital solutions. Using research, analytics, experimentation and your understanding of ecommerce and conversion, you will continuously identify opportunities to improve the journey and demonstrate the impact of your work.

Reporting to the Lead Digital Product Designer, this is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the ecommerce experience and help shape how our brands sell memberships through digital channels.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end ecommerce journey, from club discovery and membership comparison through to pricing, sign-up and conversion.

  • Redesign and optimise web experiences to clearly communicate product value, benefits, pricing and offers and drive conversion.

  • Lead the design of responsive web pages and experiences across multiple devices and screen sizes.

  • Design and evolve reusable web components and patterns within our multi-brand design system.

  • Design modular Contentful experiences that allow Marketing to create, update and launch pages efficiently without developer dependency.

  • Lead discovery and design-thinking workshops, framing problems, exploring solutions and aligning stakeholders around customer and business outcomes.

  • Use customer research, funnel data, analytics, session recordings and experimentation to identify friction and continuously improve conversion.

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales and club teams to understand customer and operational needs and translate them into effective digital experiences.

  • Work closely with our offshore development partner from design through to implementation, providing clear specifications, solving design and technology challenges and QAing the final experience.

  • Stay curious and proactive about new tools, technologies and ways of working, including AI-enabled design and CMS capabilities.


About You

You are an experienced product designer who is comfortable taking ownership - with the experience to form a view, back it and take us towards a new design future. You are proactive by nature, actively seeking out the information, context and solutions you need to get the job done rather than waiting for answers to come to you.

You combine strong design craft with commercial thinking. You understand how to communicate the value of a product through a digital experience and are motivated by improving conversion, not simply creating something that looks good. You are curious about how things work, including the technology behind your designs, and enjoy working closely with developers to bring ideas to life.

You hold yourself to a high standard, take initiative and are confident facilitating workshops and bringing stakeholders along with you. You are comfortable challenging the status quo and reimagining existing experiences when there is a better solution.


Key Experience

  • Experience as a Product, UX or UI Designer, with strong experience in ecommerce, subscription, membership or another conversion-focused digital environment.

  • A strong portfolio is required, demonstrating end-to-end product design thinking, including the problem, discovery process, design decisions and measurable outcomes.

  • Proven experience designing and optimising ecommerce or joiner journeys, including sign-up, checkout, pricing and product or plan comparison.

  • Experience designing digital experiences that communicate complex product benefits, value propositions, pricing and offers clearly.

  • Strong responsive and mobile-first design experience across multiple devices and screen sizes.

  • Experience designing and evolving reusable components within a design system.

  • Hands-on experience designing for a CMS, ideally Contentful or another headless CMS, including modular page structures and components.

  • Experience working closely with development teams to bring designs to life, including understanding technical constraints and conducting QA of implemented experiences.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to bring diverse teams together around a problem and a solution.

  • Experience using research, analytics, experimentation, session recordings or other evidence to inform design decisions and improve conversion.

  • Proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools, with a strong understanding of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience using AI tools within the design process, or a strong curiosity and appetite to explore how AI can improve design and CMS workflows.

  • Experience across multi-brand, membership, subscription, fitness, wellness or other consumer environments is highly regarded.


In return we offer you

  • Complementary all access Goodlife Gym Membership, plus one for a friend

  • FLG is committed to promoting a healthy work-life balance. We offer a hybrid work model, mixing 60/40 office (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday) and work-from-home responsibilities.

  • Modern open-plan office with onsite cafe and complimentary barista coffee

  • Anniversary leave days and additional complimentary memberships through FLG's Recognition of Service Program

  • Be recognised and rewarded by your peers for living our values with FLG's People's Champion awards

  • Enjoy exclusive employee discounts with industry leading fitness, travel, fashion and retail brands through FLG's partner discount program

  • Employee Assistance Program


Our commitment to diversity & inclusion

At Fitness and Lifestyle Group we bring positive energy and attitude to work every day, we are proud of who we are and who we work for. We don't just accept individuality; we encourage it and acknowledge the value diversity and inclusivity brings to our organisation. We pride ourselves on empowering our team to be their authentic selves at work.

We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People, people of all ages, race, sex, intersex status, gender identity, sexual orientation, people with a disability and from other diverse backgrounds.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Medical Imaging
description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with a strong foundation in both statistical data analysis and deep learning to drive our data-centric AI initiatives. In this role, you will be at the forefront of understanding how diverse real-world imaging conditions and technical variables affect image appearance and, in turn, the accuracy and reproducibility of deep learning algorithms.

You will own the analytical pipeline to quantify these effects and explore data-driven methods to address them. You will work cross-functionally to translate these insights into downstream algorithm development and product decision-making, including development of annotation protocols to curate high quality annotations for training and validation. If you are drawn to deriving insight from large and messy real-world imaging data, and to communicating and crystalizing solutions from these insights, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tooling & Pipelines: Build robust, reproducible analytical pipelines and visualizations over population-scale data, to characterise dataset distributions and model vulnerabilities across diverse patient populations.
  • Correction & Harmonization: Explore, develop, and validate methods for harmonizing complex data-related factors and image variations.
  • Data-Centric Deep Learning: Translate findings about data variance and model behaviour into actionable data curation requirements, training-time robustness strategies, and architectural recommendations for downstream algorithm development.
  • Data Curation and Annotation: Develop annotation protocols for algorithm training and validation for internal product development and FDA submissions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Partner with Research Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Systems Engineers, Process Engineers, Product and Regulatory teams. Derive and present clear analyses from messy data to drive decision-making, and provide artifacts other functions consume.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Masters or PhD Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Medical Image Analysis, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience: 5+ years (or 3+ with a PhD) of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Image Analysis.
  • Measurement Science: Working command of reproducibility and agreement statistics — variance components, Gage R&R, intraclass correlation, repeatability and reproducibility coefficients, Bland-Altman — and the judgement to separate correctable bias from irreducible variance.
  • Medical Imaging Expertise: Deep understanding of medical image data structures and the physical/clinical realities of imaging. Familiarity with image processing tools and building algorithms for medical imaging data.
  • Data Analysis & Statistics: Expert proficiency in Python and statistical data analysis ecosystems (e.g., pandas, scipy, statsmodels, seaborn/matplotlib). Proven ability with large, complex, and messy datasets.
  • Deep Learning Experience: Hands-on experience developing or fine-tuning deep learning algorithms (preferably using PyTorch) for computer vision tasks (segmentation, classification, detection) applied to medical images.
  • AI-Augmented Workflow: Demonstrated proficiency using modern agentic tools and LLMs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude) as a daily force multiplier to accelerate software development, rapidly prototype data solutions, and build reproducible pipelines.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to distill complex, multi-dimensional data analyses into clear, strategic insights for cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Published research specifically related to domain generalization, image harmonization, or out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging.
  • Experience working with large multi-vendor CT imaging datasets, with an understanding of acquisition and reconstruction protocols.
  • Proven track-record in diagnosing data- and annotation-related algorithm performance gaps, and designing data-driven solutions.
  • Experience with large-scale data querying and cloud storage (e.g., AWS, SQL).
  • Experience developing SaMD products and contributing to regulatory filings.
  • Experience with biostats to support FDA submissions.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $170,000 to $240,000, bonus, and equity. #LI-IB1 #LI-Hybrid

title: Automotive Shop Foreman
description:

Non-Working Shop Foreman | Middle Tennessee Area

Location: Middle Tennessee Area | Specific dealership location confidential
Schedule: Monday through Saturday
Compensation: Competitive Salary + Bonus, DOE
Relocation Assistance: Moving expenses provided for qualified candidates

About Us

Our success is built on the belief that people are the key to our success, along with a commitment to building trusting and lasting relationships, continuously improving, and providing an exceptional experience for our customers. We have also earned manufacturer recognition for outstanding customer service and dedication to excellence.

We offer the resources, stability, and career opportunities of a automotive organization while maintaining a strong focus on our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Non-Working Shop Foreman to lead and support a high-performing automotive service department in the Middle Tennessee Area

The ideal candidate will be a Toyota Master Diagnostic Technician (MDT) with extensive Toyota technical knowledge, exceptional leadership abilities, and a proven track record of developing technicians and improving overall shop performance.

This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished Toyota technician who is ready to utilize their technical expertise in a full-time leadership capacity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide daily leadership, direction, and technical support to the technician team.
  • Oversee shop workflow and assist in ensuring work is distributed effectively and efficiently.
  • Monitor technician productivity, efficiency, performance, and repair quality.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop technicians at various skill and experience levels.
  • Identify technician training and professional development opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Service Advisors and Service Management to maintain an efficient flow of vehicles through the service department.
  • Help reduce comebacks and repeat repairs by maintaining strong quality-control standards.
  • Promote accountability, teamwork, communication, and professional standards throughout the shop.
  • Assist management with identifying opportunities to improve overall shop productivity and efficiency.
  • Help maintain a safe, clean, organized, and productive service environment.
  • Serve as a trusted technical and leadership resource for the entire service team.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be Toyota Master Diagnostic Technician (MDT) certified.
  • Extensive Toyota technical, repair, and diagnostic experience.
  • Strong advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of dealership service operations and shop workflow.
  • Exceptional leadership, coaching, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively mentor and develop technicians at varying skill levels.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced automotive service environment.
  • Commitment to repair quality, customer satisfaction, and technician development.
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous Shop Foreman, Team Leader, Lead Technician, or similar service department leadership experience.
  • Previous Toyota dealership experience.
  • Experience managing technician workflow, productivity, and efficiency.
  • Demonstrated success in technician coaching, mentoring, training, and development.
  • Proven track record of maintaining high repair-quality standards and reducing comebacks.
  • Experience working closely with service management to improve overall department performance.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Bonus opportunity
  • Moving/relocation expenses provided for qualified candidates
  • A true non-working Shop Foreman position focused on leadership rather than individual production
  • Opportunity to lead, mentor, and develop a team of automotive technicians
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities
  • Support and resources of a automotive organization
  • Team-oriented culture focused on people, relationships, continuous improvement, and customer service

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Toyota Master Diagnostic Technician who is ready to take the next step in their career and focus on leadership rather than personally turning hours.

As Shop Foreman, you will have the opportunity to use your Toyota expertise to develop technicians, oversee repair quality, improve productivity, manage workflow, provide advanced diagnostic support, and help drive the overall performance of the service department.

For qualified candidates interested in making a career move to the Middle Tennessee Area, moving and relocation expenses will be provided.

title: Traffic Control Assistant
description:
Who We Are?

Aspire Communications is a startup, turn-key technology integration company based in Orlando, Florida with roots in Southern California. Formed in September of 2019, Aspire has quickly grown into a 200+ person operation in less than five years and continues to rapidly expand.


About the Role

The Traffic Control Assistant plays a key role in keeping telecommunications construction sites safe and traffic moving smoothly. You'll set up and maintain traffic control devices, protect workers and the public, and support crews installing underground and aerial telecom infrastructure, including fiber optic and cable lines.


Who Trives in This Role

This job is a great fit for someone who:

• Stays calm and alert in fast-moving environments — you're often the first line of safety between traffic and a live work zone

• Takes pride in the details — a cone placed a few feet off, or a missed hazard, can matter

• Communicates clearly and confidently, whether directing a driver, coordinating with crew over radio, or answering a curious passerby

• Doesn't mind being on their feet outdoors in sun, heat, or cold — and treats that as just part of the job

• Works well independently but also as part of a tight-knit crew

• Takes safety seriously without needing to be reminded — for themselves, coworkers, and the public

• Is dependable and punctual, since crews rely on traffic control being in place before work can start


Responsbilities

• Set up, maintain, and remove traffic control devices — cones, signs, barricades, and flagging stations — in compliance with local and federal regulations (e.g., MUTCD guidelines)

• Direct traffic safely using hand signals, flags, or stop/slow paddles

• Monitor traffic flow and adjust control measures to minimize congestion and hazards

• Communicate with crew members via radio or hand signals to coordinate safe vehicle and pedestrian movement

• Support telecom construction crews with basic tasks during light traffic (e.g., carrying materials, spotting equipment)

• Maintain compliant, safe work zones and report hazards immediately

• Stay alert and visible at all times, particularly in high-risk or high-traffic areas

• Interact professionally with the public, responding to questions or concerns as needed


Qualifications

• Prior experience in traffic control, construction, or a related field preferred; will train the right candidate

• Flagger certification (or willingness to obtain one)

• Ability to stand for extended periods and work outdoors in varying weather conditions

• Ability to bend, squat, and lift up to [X] lbs

• Strong communication skills and situational awareness

• Reliable transportation and a valid driver's license

• Comfortable working near vehicle traffic and heavy equipment


Job Type: Full-Time


Schedule

• 8- or 10-hour shifts, Monday–Friday

• Day shift

• Overtime and weekend availability as needed


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Short-term and long-term disability, plus voluntary life insurance buy-up

• Paid time off and parental leave

• Team-building events

• Career growth opportunities within a fast-growing telecommunications company

• A collaborative, dynamic work environment

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Cotiviti is consolidating several client-facing portals into one unified Client Performance Portal — spanning executive, analyst, and operations views, and covering SLA reporting, benchmarking, case detail, enhancement requests, roadmap visibility, regulatory insights, and billing self-service. One module already exists in production (Support/ticketing, built on Blazor/.NET, Azure PaaS, Okta, and Jira) and will be folded in rather than rebuilt from scratch.

We're looking for a hands-on, full-stack Principal Software Engineer to architect and help build this platform: assess and integrate the existing Support module, design how the portal connects to internal systems (claims, payment integrity, risk adjustment, billing, ITSM), and set the patterns the rest of the team will build against. As the first hire on the program, expect real code alongside architecture decisions from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Assess the existing Support/ticketing module (Blazor, Azure PaaS, Okta, Jira) and make — and defend — the call on whether it's absorbed as-is, wrapped behind an API, or re-platformed to match the unified portal's target stack.
  • Lead technical discovery: inventory the systems behind each legacy client portal and assesswhat it takes to expose their data to a unified, client-facing layer.
  • Define and personally help build the overall architecture for the platform — API/aggregation layer, data pipelines, authentication/authorization model, and integration patterns with source-of-record systems.
  • Make and document build-vs-integrate calls for major components (e.g., enhancement-request workflow, document repository) with clear tradeoffs.
  • Design the role-based access control and data segmentation model so Executive/Analyst/Operations personas — and different client organizations — see only what they should, reconciling with the existing Okta/SCIM setup already in production.
  • Partner with Product, Security/Compliance, and Data teams to ensure the architecture supports regulatory and PHI/PII handling requirements from day one.
  • Write production code across the frontend and backend to establish the patterns (component structure, API conventions, integration approach) the rest of the engineering team will build against.
  • Produce architecture documentation and decision records for the engineering team that follows.
  • Advise on sequencing/phasing of the build given technical dependencies and risk.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact through the discovery and early build phases.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a principal/staff-level or senior technical lead role, with hands-on full-stack delivery (not purely a design/architecture-only track record).
  • Strong C#/.NET experience, including exposure to Blazor or comparable component-based .NET web frameworks — enough depth to evaluate, integrate, or replatform an existing Blazor application, not just read about it.
  • Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Azure PaaS services: App Service/Web Apps, API Management, Logic Apps (or equivalent workflow/integration orchestration), Key Vault, and Azure-managed relational databases (Postgres or SQL).
  • Experience with enterprise identity platforms (Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, or similar) — specifically SSO, MFA, and SCIM-based provisioning, not just "RBAC in general."
  • Experience integrating with third-party SaaS systems via REST APIs and webhooks (e.g., ticketing/ITSM platforms like Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk) — bidirectional sync patterns specifically.
  • Track record of producing clear architecture documentation and driving technical decisions with cross-functional stakeholders (product, security, compliance, not just engineering).
  • Experience scoping and sequencing a multi-phase technical program, including making explicit build-vs-integrate-vs-replatform calls on existing systems.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.
  • Completing tasks independently.
  • Interpreting data.
  • Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
  • Maintaining focus.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
  • Learning new tasks and completing tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.
  • Remembering and adhering to processes and protocols.
  • Applying established protocols in a timely manner.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Base compensation ranges from $130,000 to $176,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

title: Quality Technician
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The primary focus of the Quality Technician is to support the activities that ensure compliance to all customers and regulatory requirements through the Merchants Metals QMS (Quality Management System). The technician will perform quality control checks and daily inspections on company products to ensure they meet required safety and quality standards. Gathers and prepares data, helps create and implement process’, and drive actions centered around quality control improvement.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS, DUTIES, AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Works safely by following all EHS procedures. Identifies potentially unsafe situations and immediately resolves and/or raises awareness to the appropriate individual(s).

· Conducts testing and inspections during manufacturing processes to ensure that products comply with ASTM quality standards.

· Completes all tests required for each product and records results for every sample tested. Conducts re-testing of product as needed to support quality investigations.

· Participate in both internal and external audits to verify conformance of activities to quality assurance standards.

· Gathers CTQ data (specifications, measurements, weights) from the manufacturing process and inputs onto an online database. Helps lead and execute actions on the shop floor as it relates to quality control improvement.

· Tracks and maintain key process control parameters.

· Tracks and maintains specifications to ensure compliance with the lower end of the specifications in accordance with ASTM standards

· Collect and summarize technical information and trends. Prepare reports on key shop metrics and help drive quality initiatives and projects

· Understands product specifications and decides whether to certify or reject specific products

· Leads real time root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality issues as they arise on the shop floor.

· Ability to troubleshoot equipment issues as it relates to quality and facilitate maintenance (mechanical aptitude).

· Create, maintain, and/or revise specialized quality documentation (e.g., procedures, work instructions, etc.)

· Is a leader in training and implementing process’ and procedures.

· Reports all equipment problems to maintenance and QC leaders

· Maintains excellent housekeeping in all QC areas

· Builds strong working relationships with team members, internal and external departments as necessary

title: Newborn Hearing Screen Technician - Per Diem
description:
Overview

Join us in making a difference in the early detection of hearing loss in newborns as a

Newborn Hearing Screen Technician!

As a newborn hearing screen technician, you will provide hearing screens in the hospital after a baby is born. You will work on-site at one or more hospital locations to screen newborns for hearing loss. At Pediatrix, you will receive on-the-job training. This includes annual certification accredited by the American Academy of Audiology. By offering this certification, we strive to ensure our employees are adept in improving early detection of hearing impairments and encouraging timely intervention. St Anthony Hospital

Responsibilities

The Hearing Screen Technician (HST) performs hearing screens and provides education to parents on the relevance of hearing screens and the importance of early intervention.

  • Comply with all company and facility policies and procedures including, but not limited to, appropriate PPE, required vaccinations and other safety/security protocols, Company and Hospital Orientations and annual compliance modules; Raise any questions or concerns from hospital staff and/or leadership as appropriate to HS Manager.
  • Evaluate each patient for “screen readiness” prior to performing a screen; the technician will only screen patients that are in the appropriate state to achieve a reliable result (fed, quiet, not moving/agitated, calm)
  • Collect all necessary data/demographics for each baby. Perform the hearing screen and all screen-related services on all eligible babies during each shift. Ensure documentation protocol is followed for every screen.
  • Treat each screened baby (and his/her family) with the care and consideration required at this important development milestone.
  • Upload all screen results/billing/state reporting by the end of each shift and ensure the stats for each screen are complete and reconciled, unless otherwise instructed by Site Supervisor.
  • Perform all screens in an efficient manner and follow the appropriate process to minimize time in the patient room, without sacrificing quality or patient education / satisfaction.
  • Ensure all relevant information is provided to the party responsible for each screened baby, and the parent/guardian receives appropriate education about the necessity of the screen, and what to do with the results.
  • Notify Site Supervisor of all missed and final refer babies.
  • Schedule Outpatient appointment for refer babies, where appropriate. Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED).

  • Flexibility to work on weekends and national holidays required

  • Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

.

title: Patient Financial Counselor
location: IDX Coppell TX Site - Coppell, TX 75019
description:
About Us

Inform Diagnostics, a Fulgent Genetics Company, is a nationally recognized diagnostics laboratory focused on anatomic pathology subspecialties, including gastrointestinal pathology, dermatopathology, urologic pathology, hematopathology, and breast pathology.

Founded in 2011, our parent entity, Fulgent Genetics, has evolved into a premier, full-service genomic testing company built around a foundational technology platform.

Through our diverse testing menu, Fulgent is focused on transforming patient care in oncology, anatomic pathology, infectious and rare diseases, and reproductive health. We believe that by providing a wide range of effective, flexible testing options in conjunction with best-in-class service and support, we can redefine the way medicine is managed for patients and clinicians alike.

Since integrating with our therapeutic development business, Fulgent is also developing drug candidates for treating a broad range of cancers using a novel nanoencapsulation and targeted therapy platform. By merging our fields of expertise, we aim to become a fully integrated precision medicine company.

Summary of Position

Inform Diagnostics is looking for an experienced Patient Financial Counselor who works well independently and supports their co-workers in running a successful revenue cycle and patient benefits department.

The Patient Financial Counselor will interact with patients, insurance carriers, medical facilities, and providers daily to ensure seamless front-end benefits verification, coordination, and authorization process for all tests. The Counselor is responsible for providing excellent service by responding to questions from patients, clerical staff, and insurance companies, as well as identifying and resolving patient billing complaints.

Qualified candidates must be able to review accounts for billing accuracy to maximize reimbursement. The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail with the aptitude to learn our medical billing and collections process, specifically eligibility verification and prior authorization processes. The Counselor is responsible for the work required to research and resolve front-end errors. The mission of the Counselor is to provide excellent customer service and perform a wide variety of complex patient benefits investigation, coordination, and billing duties.

Key Job Elements

  • Communicates with various regional and national payers, including Federal, State, and Third Party (HMO, PPO, IPA, TPA Indemnity), to validate health plan eligibility, benefits, and deductibles.
  • Maintains accurate documentation.
  • Serves as the point of contact for patients to ensure accurate communication of health plan benefits and eligibility, and answers all patient concerns regarding coverage and billing details.
  • Coordinates all patient and insurance billing for the medical laboratory; ensures that patient information is entered accurately, verifies patient insurance eligibility and benefits, submits prior authorizations and clean claims to insurance companies daily.
  • Reviews physician referrals for completeness and accuracy, ensuring the referral includes required patient information, diagnosis code, type of service, physician signature, date and authorization number; Faxes referral to referring physician if information is incomplete.
  • Establishes payment plans to help patients manage their payments, while providing exceptional customer service to patients.
  • Prepares, reviews, and transmits claims using billing software, including electronic and paper claim processing.
  • Confirms patient demographic, insurance and referring physician information is accurately entered into system.
  • Identifies and bills secondary or tertiary insurances.
  • Provides case progress, insurance inquiry and reimbursement report to management.
  • Maintains contact with patients and medical facilities and provides updates on authorization progress and case processing status.
  • Maintains patient confidentiality as per the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).
  • Performs other related duties or special projects as assigned.
